items.text: Dear Metas,

After the version update and maintenance on November 18, 2026 （PT）, the Visional Wheel will rotate once more, changing to Dissonant Resonance. To help Metas prepare, here is the related server opening schedule.
For details on the Dissonant Resonance game mode, please check the Dev Blog: https://www.oncehuman.game/news/devBlog/20261113/40781_1319568.html

notes.title: 1. Additional Vision Worlds for Isles of Abyss Servers

items.text: Existing Isles of Abyss servers will add an appropriate number of Vision Worlds based on activity levels, so Metas can experience the Dissonant Resonance game mode right away without transferring servers.
After the version update on November 18, 2026 PT, newly opened Isles of Abyss servers will come with 8 Vision Worlds and 4 Basic Worlds.

For existing servers that already have Vision Worlds, Gravity Abyss within those Vision Worlds will automatically switch to Dissonant Resonance, so Metas can experience it without transferring servers.
To ensure a quality gameplay experience for Metas and maintain healthy server ecosystems, the server opening schedule has also been adjusted as follows:

notes.title: 3. Isles of Abyss Permanent Server Opening Schedule

items.text: To meet everyone's long-term need to play on the Isles of Abyss, each region will open 1 Permanent Server on November 18, 2026 （PT）: Isles of Abyss (Permanent Server). Metas from the Isles of Abyss server will eventually all gather on this server.

Isles of Abyss (Permanent Server) will open a sufficient number of Basic Worlds and Vision Worlds to ensure a smooth experience for Metas. Vision Worlds will synchronize with the Visional Wheel "Dissonant Resonance" game mode. The official team will subsequently evaluate adding more worlds based on server operation conditions and Metas' gameplay needs; any adjustments will be explained through future announcements.

To ensure a smooth and stable experience for Metas participating in wilderness gameplay, territory construction, and resource gathering, certain mechanics within the same world currently have capacity limits. The relevant rules are as follows:

1) When the number of online players in a world reaches its cap, subsequent Metas will temporarily be unable to enter that world. You may switch to another world to play. If your territory is located in the world that has reached its player cap, you can still enter that world and will not be affected by this restriction.

2) Within the same world, certain game modes will also have a limit on how many can be active simultaneously. If the mode you want to play in your current world has reached its activation cap, you can switch to another world to experience it.
3) When the number of territories placed within the same world reaches the limit, no more territories can be placed. At that point, Metas will need to switch to another world to place territories.

notes.title: 3.2 How to Enter Isles of Abyss (Permanent Server)

items.text: 1) Automatic system merge (for characters already in the Isles of Abyss scenario)

After the Isles of Abyss server has been running for 31 days, players on the server will automatically be merged into Isles of Abyss (Permanent Server). After the merge, data such as Hives, backpack supplies, and territories will be retained according to the rules, and Metas can continue to play on the permanent server.
2) Enter via Server List (for new characters or signing up to enter)

Once the Isles of Abyss (Permanent Server) opens, it will appear in the server selection list. Metas can go to Scenario Selection - Isles of Abyss - More Server Options - Permanent Server, select Isles of Abyss (Permanent Server), and enter that server.

Note: The gameplay of Isles of Abyss (Permanent Server) runs by default according to the \[End of Storm\] phase rules of the Isles of Abyss scenario. The overall challenge intensity is relatively high. If you use a new character or sign up to enter, please familiarize yourself with the rules and difficulty of this phase in advance, and choose carefully based on your own situation.

notes.title: 3.3 Isles of Abyss (Permanent Server) Game Mode Description

items.text: The Isles of Abyss Permanent Server stays permanently in the \[End of Storm\] phase. The relevant gameplay rules are as follows:
1) The Sunken Lord: Can be unlocked directly without reaching the Purification Progress. Metas can go to the entrance and enter the challenge directly.
2) Calamity Tower: Calamity Tower - Abyss difficulty is unlocked directly and refreshes on a specific cycle. Each World can refresh at most 1 Calamity Tower - Abyss.

3) Scenario Challenge: After the system automatically merges you into the permanent server, your progress will be uniformly reset to the current new permanent server's scenario challenge tasks and rewards, ensuring a consistent experience for both new and veteran players after the merge.

notes.title: IV. Custom Server Adds New \[Dissonant Resonance\] Scenario Selection

items.text: As the Visional Wheel turns, Custom Server simultaneously adds new configurable scenarios: Manibus (Vision: Dissonant Resonance), Endless Dream (Vision: Gravity Abyss), The Way of Winter (Vision: Dissonant Resonance), Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve (Vision: Gravity Abyss), Prismverse's Clash (Vision: Dissonant Resonance), and Isles of Abyss (Vision: Dissonant Resonance). Metas can choose to experience others' servers in Custom Server, or open 1 Custom Server of their own to experience.

That's all for this announcement. For actual server opening times, please check in-game. If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out to us via the Feedback Platform （Once Human Feedback Platform).
Once Human Development Team

releases.displayName: Dev Blog | Visional Wheel S5 "Dissonant Resonance" Foresight

items.text: Dear Metas,

Deep in the Nova, a colossal face gazes down upon the land. An unfamiliar frequency pierces through the ruins, weaving joy, enrage, sorrow, and fear into a single score—not a blessing for this world, but the final movement of destruction that the new Great One, "The Echo," seeks to perform.

The Visional Wheel spins once more. This time, the clue to confronting the Vision lies hidden within scattered Notes. Defeat the Deviants modified by the power of notes, rearrange and purify the broken Score, and turn the enemy's power into your own melody. As the Gulped in the sky casts its gaze, brave Metas will respond to this "performance" from the unknown in their own way.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/12/798ba4a810be46398256ac2bd891e2d8.png&code=YjRzVmgzdEtfMTc5NDU2MzY2MzUxMg==" style="max-width:100%;"]
Opening Time
Opens after the November 18, 2026 （PT ）version update

Manibus (excluding Novice Scenario), Evolution's Call, Prismverse's Clash, The Way of Winter, Endless Dream, Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve, and Isles of Abyss. Metas can switch to the "Vision" world via the Worldstone to experience it.

Where The Echo's "Gospel" spreads, the will of fallen beings clings desperately to this land, transforming into a colossal calamity that yearns to speak—the Dissonant Husk. This Gulped suspended in the sky is composed of structures resembling copper pipes, its human-like yet inhuman face sending chills down the spine. Its massive form looms over the earth like a false god, and occasionally it notices the ant-like Metas below. Who says a "god" can't be amused by ants?

When Metas enter the Fundamental Tone Range and activate the Echo Bell, the Dissonant Husk reveals four faces across different regions—Delight, Wrath, Lament, and Terror—gazing upon every Meta who dares to intrude beneath an alien sky.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/10/874c66d4584349728de6613fdd1d3885.gif&code=U2tENHZwaTlfMTc5NDU2MzY2MzUxMw==" style="max-width:100%;"]

"The Echo" was originally an ancient relic slumbering in the ruins. After the Nova Vision descended, the surface was vaporized and Stardust poured underground; the relic awakened within the Stardust, merging with collapsed pipes and ancient instruments to become what it is now. No one can establish contact with it—all researchers who entered the region have gone missing. It merely emits a low, repeating hum, as if performing an unfinished overture.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/13/6fffc37367f3457287500f7f4c377f08.png&code=OGtaanNNeW1fMTc5NDU2MzY2MzUxMw==" style="max-width:100%;"]

notes.title: Game Mode 1 - Resonant Movements: Use the reticle to pick up Notes and let the melody fall into place line by line

items.text: Ever since Stardust poured into the Pioneer's acoustic ruins, the awakened "Echo" has loathed the clamor of the world. With storming sounds, it tears through space-time, condensing Phase Anchor Fundamental Tone Ranges, and drives the Dissonant Army—infused with dissonant notes—through the passages into Nalcott, spreading its "gospel" everywhere in an attempt to drag all beings into a hall of extreme emotion and destruction.
1. Ring the Echo Bell to begin your Movement

During the Vision, four types of Resonant Movements game mode regions will appear across Nalcott: Movement of Delight, Movement of Wrath, Movement of Lament, and Movement of Terror. Each movement region differs in difficulty and rules.
After entering the region, interact with the \[Echo Bell] to start the Movement challenge. At this point, Metas will also receive a Score awaiting tuning.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/12/b056e855aa0c48c39cbce20ac9b4fa71.gif&code=WlJNRnc4ZHdfMTc5NDU2MzY2MzUxMw==" style="max-width:100%;"]
2. Defeat the Dissonant Army and Tune the Score

Defeat Dissonant Army enemies carrying notes, and the corresponding notes will appear in the scene. Metas must refer to the prompts on the current score and fire at the required notes to fill them in sequence.

Notes will remain in the scene for a period of time and will give a prompt when they are about to disappear. When different notes appear simultaneously, accurately identifying and selecting them is just as important as killing speed.

Each Meta obtains their own notes and progresses their own score independently—they won't lose their chance to obtain notes because another Meta shot them. Everyone can clear enemies together, then each complete their own melody.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/13/9ee29a3ed9d14432a533df0e0df74e0f.png&code=azlueGJYVURfMTc5NDU2MzY2MzUxMw==" style="max-width:100%;"]
3. Protect your Score Progress and complete the final signature
Each time you complete a line of the score, you'll receive the corresponding Phase Rewards. As the blanks are gradually filled in, the originally dissonant movement will become whole once again.

As the battle reaches its final stage, the Dissonant Emissary carrying the Movement Signature will become an opponent you must face. That is the key to completing the entire movement, and also an extension of The Echo's will within the soundscape.

After achieving victory on the battlefield and completing your personal score, Metas will receive a Legendary Movement. Use it to listen to the full piece and claim rewards; if your personal score is not yet complete when you achieve battlefield victory, you will receive an Incomplete Movement and claim a smaller corresponding reward.

notes.title: Game Mode 2 - The Echo War: Face The Echo in Nova

items.text: [img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/13/f0beaa13d9a54b6cbd270f7bece560d8.png&code=UjlmQ2ppSnpfMTc5NDU2MzY2MzUxMw==" style="max-width:100%;"]
Fifteen minutes after the Vision begins, The Echo will descend directly upon Nalcott in avatar form. Metas can enter The Echo War through The Echo's portal shown on the map.

The Echo War supports up to 4 players in a team and takes the form of a separate Dungeon. Metas, please make full preparations before entering. The Echo War also has two difficulty levels: Basic and Hard. Please choose the difficulty that suits you.

The Echo has multiple attack forms, such as sound wave attacks, summoning minions, wide-area impacts, and more. Metas must watch for battlefield cues, use the interactions in the arena to counter threats, and seize the moments when The Echo reveals its weakspots to focus fire. Promptly handling interference and responding to mechanics, then unleashing firepower during key windows, is a crucial part of this confrontation.
1. Dissonant Dust

Dissonant Dust is the crystallized form of The Echo's dissonant movement fragments, retaining lingering traces of bygone noise. This item can be used to open the Resonance Box, and can also be exchanged for certain items in the Visional Redemption Shop.

Metas can obtain Dissonant Dust through Vision-related game modes such as Resonant Movements and The Echo War, as well as the Visional Wheel event. This item has a weekly acquisition cap; once the cap is reached, the acquisition rate will decrease.
2. Resonance Box

The Resonance Box is a sonic crystallization left in the world by The Echo. It comes in three rarities: Epic, Legendary, and Mythic. The higher the rarity, the more precious the rewards. Opening a Resonance Box guarantees Divine Rhythm, though the exact amount varies. There is also a chance to obtain rare rewards such as precious Mods and high-level Deviations.
Metas can also consume varying amounts of Dissonant Dust to perform different tiers of Resonance. Among them, \[Deep Resonance] has a chance to grant double rewards!
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/13/8c138cda801f4776810047e77ac540af.png&code=UmxQVllwWVlfMTc5NDU2MzY2MzUxMw==" style="max-width:100%;"]
3. Divine Rhythm

Divine Rhythm is an exclusive item obtained when opening Resonance Boxes. After collecting Divine Rhythm, you can visit Event - Visional Redemption - Redeem Shop to redeem precious rewards such as Lightforge Ingots, selected Shop Fashion/Furniture/Weapon Skins, Shiny Mods, top-tier Deviations, and more.
4. Special Adjustments to This Season's Visional Shop
To meet Metas' redemption needs, this season's Visional Redemption Shop will add limited redemption opportunities for select past Visional Mod Crates.
New Combat Deviation: Silent Statue O-079

Deviation O-079 is a grayish-white stone humanoid statue, approximately 1.7 meters tall and weighing about 480 kg. The entire statue is covered in fine radial patterns that begin at O-079-A and spread along both arms across the whole body. Material analysis identifies it as ordinary granite, but all sampling attempts have ended in failure: drill bits shatter approximately 2 mm into the surface, with the fracture surfaces alternately showing traces of high-temperature melting and rapid freezing. The face is a blank, uncarved surface.

A spherical silence zone with a radius of approximately 15 meters surrounds O-079. Sound waves cannot propagate within this zone, and those who enter immediately notice that "the world has been muted". However, personnel inside the silence zone can still converse normally—post-incident interviews indicate that what they heard was not each other's voices. The vast majority of those affected describe the experience as "a choir without lyrics" and unanimously agree that its source is "in the sky".

O-079's primary Deviation trait is its periodic spreading fluctuation. From time to time, O-079-A emits a ring of visible ripples outward (hereinafter referred to as O-079-B). Wherever the ripples pass, all things briefly experience a violent Wrath of Nature—be it scorching heat, extreme cold, or crawling lightning. These three calamities cycle endlessly, with their order and intervals entirely unpredictable. Living targets touched by O-079-B are often left covered in wounds, yet those who have long accompanied it remain unharmed, as if the ripples recognize them.

Note that O-079 continuously spreads its "gospel" indiscriminately. Personnel who remain within its area of influence for extended periods will hear the lyrics of a choir in their dreams and report thoughts such as "Mother is watching us from the sky" along with an impulse to reach toward the sky. This mental influence subsides within approximately 3 weeks after breaking contact, with no permanent cases recorded.
Battle Skill "Elemental Shift"

Automatically cycles among three Keyword Effects: Burn, Power Surge, and Frost Vortex. When the battle skill is cast, a spreading wave is emitted centered on the target, dealing corresponding Status DMG and applying the Keyword Effect;
Ultimate "Elemental Resonance"

Summons a Silent Statue to bestow blessings upon the Metas. Each time an enemy receives an Elemental Keyword Effect, the Statue gains the corresponding Elemental Resonance, increasing Status DMG for the summoner and their teammates within range. Collecting all three Resonances greatly increases the Keyword DMG Rate.
How to Obtain
The Silent Statue can mainly be obtained by participating in The Echo War, and can also be obtained through the Visional Shop (current season) and by opening the Resonance Box.
After the current Vision season ends, this Deviation will be added to the standard Game Mode drop pool. Please refer to future announcements for details.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/10/7f78c565b388468a9b60978154785b2a.gif&code=NVJrOU9IOExfMTc5NDU2MzY2MzUxMw==" style="max-width:100%;"]
Morphed Deviation
This update adds three new Morphed Deviations: Artisan's Touch - Dissonant Resonance, Wish Box - Dissonant Resonance, and Gazocchio - Dissonant Resonance.
How to Obtain

Morphed Deviations can mainly be obtained by participating in Resonant Movements, The Echo War, and Vision events. They can also be obtained through the Visional Shop (current season) and by opening the Resonance Box.

Previously, the Bastille Set had harsh trigger and maintenance conditions, making it difficult to perform reliably in common combat. This adjustment relaxes the trigger and maintenance conditions for the Bastille state and adds a continuous recovery effect during combat, alleviating the HP cap suppression caused by low sanity and allowing Metas to handle certain combat environments with greater ease.

We have observed that the synergy between Tactical Combat Boots and the SN700 - Finale allows Finale to continuously fire multiple enhanced tail bullets, which somewhat exceeded our expectations for Finale's power ceiling. Events accompanying the Vision will also revolve around gameplay experience and phase objectives, allowing everyone to accumulate rewards as they gradually become familiar with the Movements. Metas can challenge different emotional Echoes in the Tone Range combat, complete the hero's challenge, or collect various Echo Scores to complete the scattered Scores of "The Echo".
Click "Event Interface - Visional Wheel" to participate in the current Vision-related events. The following content will be available this season:
Dissonant Resonance: Metas can learn about the basic rules for this Vision and claim rewards on this page.

Movement Rotation: A weekly event. Challenge each region of the main game mode of this Vision, "Resonant Movements," to accumulate Active Progress and earn rewards such as Weapon Skins and Lightforge Ingots.
Movement Collection: Collect and listen to various scores from different emotional Movements through the Resonant Movements Game Mode. Earn rare rewards based on Collection Progress.
Echoes into Verses: Accumulate Progress by collecting Dissonant Dust to obtain precious rewards such as rare Territory Collectibles and Character Namecard Themes.
Tuning Journey: Complete the Vision's achievement challenges to earn rare rewards such as Mod Crates and Deviations.
Specific event rules, reward content, and claim conditions will be explained in subsequent announcements and on the in-game event page.

As the S5 Visional Wheel opens, the S4 Vision \[Gravity Abyss] will also come to an end. The S4 Visional Redemption Shop will close on December 2 PT. Metas, please make sure to open your corresponding \[Abyssal Cores] in time and redeem your remaining \[Gravity Crystals] and \[Abyssal Essence].
After the Shop closes, unredeemed \[Abyssal Essence] and \[Gravity Crystals] can no longer be used. Please keep track of the time to avoid any losses.
On November 18（ PT）, Visional Wheel S5 \[Dissonant Resonance] opens. Let us rescore the lost movement in the frequency of The Echo.

That's all for this Dev Blog. Metas, you are welcome to share your experiences and thoughts with us through the Feedback Platform (Once Human Feedback Platform). Thank you all for your continued support, and we look forward to meeting you again in \[Dissonant Resonance].
Once Human Development Team

releases.displayName: Dev Blog | Radiance Update, Identity Indicators Rework & Expansion

items.text: Dear Metas,

Since the radiance system launched, it has been the identity mark of every Meta in this wasteland—it records your pursuit of beauty across Nalcott and preserves each Meta's unique accumulation. We have continued to notice that, because past cosmetics and radiance-related content were released in batches, the radiance presentation of some special cosmetics does not match the current latest standards. At the same time, the visual presentation of identity indicators and nickname displays makes it difficult to reflect the value of radiance, and there is still significant room for improvement in high-frequency scenes such as team play and dungeons.

Therefore, we plan a comprehensive update to the Radiance Benefits experience: unify radiance values, rework identity indicators, add new Radiance Shop content, and extend nickname color changes to more scenes, so that identity indicators truly follow you everywhere.

This update will go live after the November 18 (PT) version update. If you have any thoughts or suggestions, Metas, please feel free to share them with us via the Feedback Platform (Once Human Feedback Platform). Below is a detailed introduction.

notes.title: 1. Unified Update of "Team Name Decor" and "Personalized Badges"

items.text: "Team Name Decor" and "Personalized Badges" are the iconic representations of different radiance levels. In the previous design, the designs of "Team Name Decor" and "Personalized Badges" were not sufficiently unified with the radiance system, the hierarchy was not clear enough, and recognizability was low. This update will apply a unified update to all "Team Name Decor" and "Personalized Badges" effects, improving both recognizability and presentation:
Improved Recognizability: much easier to identify in the team list and at close camera angles.
Enhanced Visuals: motion effect layers and radiance texture are enhanced together for a more striking display.
More Unified Style: consistent visual style with the new radiance system for a more cohesive overall presentation.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/11/a5cff70e386e49dab4f9c8e517315a23.png&code=dUR5R1hXWGtfMTc5NDQ1MDk5Mzg1MA==" style="max-width:100%;"]
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/10/e6a38640ef2b47ab9ea0aeaab65bd7cd.gif&code=dGFvakhZcUZfMTc5NDQ1MDk5Mzg1MA==" style="max-width:100%;"]

notes.title: 2. More Scenes for Exclusive Nickname Color Display

items.text: Previously, nickname color changes only took effect in certain scenes. With this update, nickname color changes will now also be supported in more scenes, including the Team interface, Dungeons interface, (RaidZone and other) Defeated interfaces, and the Wilderness, allowing Metas to maintain a more consistent nickname color during team play, challenges, and exploration, and giving exclusive nickname colors more actual display scenarios.

notes.title: III. New Arrivals in the Radiance Shop

items.text: With this update, the Radiance Shop will be synchronized with new redeemable content, giving Metas more ways to showcase their accumulated radiance.
New Exclusive Settlement Animations Added

Settlement Animations are a new appearance scene for Metas when completing dungeons. This update adds multiple exclusive settlement animations. Metas who reach the corresponding radiance level threshold can redeem them with \[Colorful Badges] as needed. Specific redemption prices can be viewed in the Radiance Shop after the version update.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/11/b942bd12e8fd468ead1e959e10030a83.gif&code=QTFNMGlSbllfMTc5NDQ1MDk5Mzg1MA==" style="max-width:100%;"]
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/11/11/d0e36b936926499e91345dd05df24efc.gif&code=b200ZXdubmNfMTc5NDQ1MDk5Mzg1MA==" style="max-width:100%;"]
Character Standing Action Redemption Threshold Lowered

We have noticed that the redemption threshold for Character Standing Actions is too high for Metas in the mid-accumulation stage, resulting in a lack of clear redemption objectives during the intermediate phase. Therefore, this update will lower the radiance level required to redeem each Character's Standing Action, allowing more Metas to unlock exclusive poses earlier and showcase their own style.

You can view this in the Radiance Shop after the version update. In the future, we will continue to pay attention to everyone's feedback and keep optimizing the benefits and display experience of the Radiance Shop.

notes.title: IV. Explanation of Past Issues with Special Cosmetic Radiance

items.text: This time, in accordance with the final radiance value standards, we reviewed the radiance values of existing cosmetics and found 2 obvious issues:

1. Some Material Skin expansion packs were configured with the same radiance as the original Material Skin pack, resulting in them providing twice the amount of radiance compared to the design expectations.
2. There was a design error in the radiance for upgradable vehicles, where each phase individually added the radiance of its current total value.

After discussion, we believe that Metas should not bear the consequences of the above work errors, so we have decided to maintain the radiance values of these cosmetics. Future new cosmetics will be configured according to the standard radiance calculation method.

Once Human Development Team

releases.displayName: Meta Hotline | Hot Feedback and Optimization Progress Vol. 12

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/42aa5ccfbe91f25aad96094373261381aea95928.png"]
Dear Metas,

[p align="justify"]After the v2.3.7 update, we added the Feedback Hot Charts section to the Once Human Feedback Platform, listing recent popular requests from the community. After logging in to the Feedback Platform, you can like the feedback you support and dislike any feedback you disagree with. The Feedback Hot Charts will display likes and dislikes in real time, and our development team will use these results to help determine development priorities. (Feedback Platform link: Once Human Feedback Platform)

[p align="justify"]The Feedback Hot Charts will also be updated with each version update. After each update, we'll share our plans and progress for addressing the player requests featured in the previous list. We value your feedback and hope the Feedback Hot Charts will give us more opportunities to communicate with you and share our development plans and progress.
[p align="justify"]It's time to unveil the results of Meta Hotline Vol. 12! As of November 4, here's how the Feedback Hot Charts looks:
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ae32debed35b51d97805798e4d2dcb0a2c2a3685.png"]

[p align="justify"]Thank you all for taking part. Every piece of feedback, every like, and every dislike helps the dev team better understand which needs matter most from the players' perspective. Below are the follow-up details for this cycle's top suggestions.
[p align="justify"]\[Top Suggestion] Allow Lift-Off Energy Devices and Floating Aerogels to be dismantled

[p align="justify"]\[Optimization Progress] Optimized. The relevant adjustments went live with the October 27(PT) version update. Lift-Off Energy Devices and Floating Aerogels can now be dismantled, giving Metas more flexibility in managing these items and freeing up backpack and depot space. Thank you for your detailed feedback.
[p align="justify"]\[Top Suggestion] Increase General Mod output

\[Optimization Progress] Accepted. The relevant feature is currently in the planning and development stages. We recognize that the current availability of General Mods could be improved. We'll work on optimizing both how players obtain them and the quantities available, making Mod progression smoother for Metas. Once the specific plan is finalized, we will keep everyone informed through announcements.
[p align="justify"]\[Top Suggestion] Display the Last Played Time on the Character Page

[p align="justify"]\[Optimization Progress] Accepted. The relevant feature is currently in the planning and development stages. Displaying the last played time on the Character page will help Metas better review and manage their play history. We've included this feature in our development plans and are actively working on it. We'll share updates as soon as they're available.
[p align="justify"]\[Top Suggestion] Allow Bound Deviations with Remaining Uses in the Main Deviation Slot During Synthesis

\[Optimization Progress] Accepted. The relevant feature is currently in the planning and development stages. We understand the core issue raised by Metas: the main Deviation slot in the current synthesis system does not allow bound Deviations with remaining uses, meaning players must first transfer them out and wait before using them. Allowing these Deviations to be placed in the main slot will help Metas save both materials and time. We have included this in our development plan and will keep everyone informed of progress through announcements.
[p align="justify"]\[Top Suggestion] Improve the Readability of Animal Information

\[Optimization Progress] The overall UI layout limits the available space for text in certain fields on the animal information page. When text exceeds the available display area, it automatically scrolls to ensure that Metas can view the full content. We confirmed that in some languages, longer text means players must wait for information such as Energy and Breed Cooldown to scroll into view, making these details less convenient to access. We've shortened and refined some of the text on the animal information page to make it more concise without compromising clarity, reducing the time players need to wait for scrolling text. This adjustment has gone live with the November 4(PT) Version Update. If you still find the information difficult to read after this adjustment, please feel free to share your feedback through the Feedback Platform. We'll review any further suggestions and consider whether additional improvements are possible.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]\[Top Suggestion] Preview for Building Dismantling

\[Optimization Progress] Accepted. The relevant feature is currently in the planning and development stages. Being able to preview the scope and effects of building demolition beforehand can help prevent accidental demolitions, making Territory modifications safer and easier to manage for Metas. We've included this feature in our development plans and will share further updates through announcements. Please stay tuned for the official release date.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]That's all for this Meta Hotline. Your feedback, including your likes and dislikes, is the foundation of Once Human's continued development. We will continue to monitor the Feedback Platform and listen closely to your views. Please keep sharing your honest opinions via the Feedback Platform. Your suggestion may make the next Hot Charts!
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Once Human Development Team

We have scheduled server maintenance and an update for November 4, 2026, at 3:00 PM (PT). The maintenance is expected to last about 2 hours (the actual server reopening time is subject to change). Please plan your gameplay accordingly.

notes.title: 2. Smoother Ladder Climbing Upgrade Across All Views

items.text: Reworked the ladder climbing mechanics in first person view. Say goodbye to the rigid fixed-distance movement of the past! Metas can now move up and down ladders smoothly and continuously, making the experience more fluid and flexible.

Optimized the climbing mechanics and visual presentation for low obstacles in first-person view. Metas can now climb and climb over obstacles in any direction, making tactical maneuvering through complex terrain more fluid and natural.

First person view now includes a "Camera Switch" animation! Metas who prefer holding weapons in the left hand or need to fire from left-side cover can now press the "Camera Switch" button to position their weapon on the left side of the screen, catering to more hardcore and diverse shooting preferences.

notes.title: Territory Construction Batch Replacement & Holographic Construction Optimization

items.text: 1. New \[Batch Replace] Cosmetics Feature

Metas, your Territory is yours to command! We deeply understand the frustration of painstakingly decorating your home only to have to swap skins on building materials one by one. With this Update, we're bringing you a silkier "one-tap replace" experience:

1) Within your Territory, \[entire connected buildings] now support batch replacement and removal of material skins! Metas can seamlessly switch between preferred materials and styles with a single click—unleash your architectural creativity.

2) Within your Territory, Facilities of the same type in \[an entire building] also support batch replacement and removal of Cosmetics. Unify your home style with one click—a dream come true for perfectionist Metas!
3) Optimized the inheritance logic for single skin replacement within a Territory, now supporting replacement of all structures.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/be6b29825015fc73fdbd07d7e85511b527eb1072.gif"]
1) Houses within a Territory can now be moved as a whole.
2) When placing a design layout, you can now select a snap point when moving an entire house.
3) Design layout holographic construction now displays the material consumption for the target structure when it is selected.

4) The design layout holographic construction allows you to select individual structures for construction. When the selected structure is a floating building, the system will automatically calculate the optimal support path for construction.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ae9e6507b284c283df6f2a7317558d26170086b3.gif"]

notes.title: \[Isles of Abyss] Scenario: New Facilities for Water Territory Construction

items.text: In the \[Isles of Abyss] scenario, where the seas are full of unknowns and challenges, ships are the Metas' most reliable companions. To make survival and exploration at sea easier, this update introduces several new practical facilities for ship construction:
1. New Facility: Straight Ladder
We have added the "Straight Ladder" to Water Territory facilities. This facility allows direct interaction and climbing while in swimming status.
2. New Facility: Rolling Shutter Door
The "Rolling Shutter Door" can now be built on ships. Metas can use Rolling Shutter Doors to divide the ship's interior spaces more flexibly.

New servers in North America and Europe open every Tuesday and Saturday at 8:00. The number of new servers opened each time depends on the number of pre-registrations, with at least one server opening each time.

1) New additions to Blueprints, Weapons, Gear, and Custom Weapons: Snowline Elite Vest and SOCR Cosmic Visitor.

6. The new comment feature for Custom Servers is now live! Metas who have played on a server for a total of at least 10 minutes can visit the \[Server Details Page] to post reviews and share their genuine gameplay experiences, helping more players discover high-quality servers!

You can also browse other Metas' ratings and reviews to get a better sense of each server, like helpful reviews, and find the server that's right for you more quickly. Every genuine piece of feedback also motivates Server Hosts to improve their game modes!

To address this, we conducted a systematic rebalance of Voyager stats based on the actual damage output of various Ship Cannons. After multiple rounds of internal testing, we confirmed that the adjusted combat duration better aligns with our intended experience.

[p align="justify"]Regarding the issue of crocodile patterns being lost when transferring out of Eternaland

We have received numerous reports from players about the issue of crocodile patterns being lost when transferring out of Eternaland. We have identified the cause of this issue; however, since the fix involves some model changes, it will need to be completed with the next version update (November 5).
We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused by the above issues. Thank you for your understanding and patience.
Once Human Development Team

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/42aa5ccfbe91f25aad96094373261381aea95928.png"]
Dear Metas,

After the v2.3.7 update, we added the Feedback Hot Charts section to the Once Human Feedback Platform, listing recent popular requests from the community. After logging in to the Feedback Platform, you can like the feedback you support and dislike any feedback you disagree with. The Feedback Hot Charts will display the likes and dislikes of each piece of feedback in real time, and our development team will reference it when deciding on future development priorities. (Feedback Platform link: Once Human Feedback Platform)

With each version update, the Feedback Hot Charts will also be updated, after which we will announce our optimization plans and progress for issues that charted during the previous cycle. Your suggestions are important to us, and we hope the Feedback Hot Charts will help us communicate and share our development plans and progress more openly.
Today is the release day of the 11th Meta Hotline! As of October 21, the Feedback Hot Charts standings are as follows:
[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/866b0e998d4509beef2d058ed159d09abdc25f81.png"]

Thank you all for taking part. Every piece of feedback, every like, and every dislike helps the dev team better understand which needs matter most from the player perspective. Below are the follow-up details for this cycle's top suggestions.
\[Top Suggestion] Add more flight vehicle types

\[Optimization Progress] Adopted. The related content is currently planned and in development. We also look forward to Metas enjoying a richer aerial travel experience—in the upcoming "Manibus 2.0" scenario launching next year, new flight vehicles will be added, along with flight vehicle aerial combat game mode content. More details will be shared through future official announcements. Stay tuned.
\[Top Suggestion] Map pins automatically disappear upon arrival

\[Optimization Progress] Adopted. The related feature is currently planned and in development. Automatically clearing pins upon reaching the destination keeps the map interface clean and reduces the hassle of manual deletion—this is a great suggestion. We have included it in our development plan, and subsequent progress will be promptly shared with Metas through announcements.
\[Top Suggestion] Add a one-click switch button to the Hotbar

\[Optimization Progress] Not adopted for now. After evaluation, we determined that this feature is not currently a high-frequency, must-have function. The existing hotbar and backpack already meet the daily needs of most players. Additionally, the current operation layout lacks spare keybinds suitable for a new binding. Forcing this feature in could disrupt existing operation logic and overall gameplay feel. Therefore, this suggestion will not be implemented for now. We will continue to monitor optimization opportunities related to the hotbar and operation interactions. Thank you for your understanding and feedback.
\[Top Suggestion] Add furniture usable in the wilderness

\[Optimization Progress] Adopted. The related feature is currently planned and in development. This is a very interesting suggestion. Coming across or using more scene furniture while exploring the wilderness would definitely add more fun and surprise to the experience. We'll consider adding this type of wilderness furniture to our development plans for next year, so players can have more engaging interactions while exploring.
\[Top Suggestion] Increase the garage placement limit

\[Optimization Progress] Under evaluation. We are aware that some Metas have requested an increase to the garage placement limit, and we've also noticed that a fair number of players do not support this suggestion. Considering that this adjustment could impact territory space planning and server performance, we have not yet included it in our definitive development plans. Moving forward, we will continue to monitor community feedback and, based on actual needs and technical evaluations, determine whether to proceed with this optimization.
\[Top Suggestion] Add a notification when reaching the Starchrom cap from opening crates
\[Optimization Progress] Adopted. This feature is expected to go live after the November 4(PT) version update. Please refer to the version update announcement for details.

That's all for this Meta Hotline. Your feedback, including your likes and dislikes, is the foundation of Once Human's continued development. We will continue to monitor the Feedback Platform and listen closely to your views. Please keep sharing your honest opinions via the Feedback Platform. Your suggestion may make the next Hot Charts!
Once Human Development Team

items.text: Dear Metas,
After the October 21(PT) version update, we'll be bringing you 1 brand-new weapon and 1 brand-new armor.

This update centers around the "Frost Vortex" and "Ice Spear" mechanics, further enriching the combat performance and build options for Frost-related playstyles. We also hope to add some new changes and freshness to your combat experience.
I. New Weapon
SOCR - Cosmic Visitor
▪ When a weapon hit occurs, there is a chance to generate a Frost Vortex. The first hit after reloading is guaranteed to trigger it.
▪ After hitting enemies a certain number of times, fire an \[Ice Spear] that locks onto the target. After the \[Ice Spear] hits, it explodes and deals damage.
▪ When a Frost Vortex is generated, fire a certain number of \[Ice Spears] that automatically attack targets within sight.
▪ When a target is killed, fire a certain number of \[Ice Spears] that automatically attack targets within sight. Has a short cooldown.
\[Ice Spear] is an Ice Construct and benefits from the corresponding Keyword VFX.
II. New Gear
New Armor: Snowline Elite Vest

Key Effect: When a Frost Vortex is generated, its triggered effects activate 1 extra time. No additional Frost Vortex is generated. Each Frost Vortex generated increases Frost Vortex damage, up to 5 stacks for 5 seconds.
That's all for this Dev Blog. If you have any questions, feel free to let us know via in-game Customer Service or the Feedback Platform.(Feedback Platform link:Once Human Feedback Platform)
Once Human Development Team

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/42aa5ccfbe91f25aad96094373261381aea95928.png"]
Dear Metas,

After the v2.3.7 update, we added the Feedback Hot Charts section to the Once Human Feedback Platform, listing recent popular requests from the community. After logging in to the Feedback Platform, you can like the feedback you support and dislike any feedback you disagree with. The Feedback Hot Charts will display the likes and dislikes of each piece of feedback in real time, and our development team will reference it when deciding on future development priorities. (Feedback Platform link:Once Human Feedback Platform)

With each version update, the Feedback Hot Charts will also be updated, after which we will announce our optimization plans and progress for issues that charted during the previous cycle. Your suggestions are important to us, and we hope the Feedback Hot Charts will help us communicate and share our development plans and progress more openly.
Today is the release day of the 10th Meta Hotline! As of September 28, the Feedback Hot Charts standings are as follows:
[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/366e5098b5b181bbda963a77765ef71db2210aa6.png"]

Thank you all for taking part. Every piece of feedback, every like, and every dislike helps the dev team better understand which needs matter most from the player perspective. Below are the follow-up details for this cycle's top suggestions.
\[Top Suggestion] Allow firing while riding a vehicle

\[Optimization Progress] Accepted. The related feature is now in planning and development. Passengers being unable to fire on Two-Wheelers does limit combat coordination during team travel. We agree with this optimization direction and have significantly moved up its schedule. Once the feature is complete, we will synchronize the details with Metas via announcements as soon as possible.
\[Top Suggestion] Visualize breeding cooldown for animals

\[Optimization Progress] A related feature is already available in-game. Currently, after summoning an animal, you can check its Breeding Cooldown in the Detail Panel. We have also noticed that Metas would like to check the cooldown directly from the backpack. This has been approved and is being significantly advanced. Future progress will be synchronized via announcements in a timely manner.
[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d296b07ee8eb7a7822e64ba1b1378316134ca979.png"]
\[Top Suggestion] Add a Mod Guarantee lock
\[Optimization Progress] Under optimization. Timing will be announced once the plan is confirmed.

We fully understand that Metas want greater flexibility in Mod Guarantee acquisition and want to reduce the uncertainty of obtaining Mods. In the previous design stage, we also planned to add interactive controls on the interface to determine whether the guarantee is triggered.

However, after multiple rounds of discussion and review, we believe that adding interface controls further increases the game's complexity, makes Mod Guarantee harder to understand, and is highly prone to misoperation (forgetting to turn it on or off can both lead to losses). Therefore, after careful evaluation, we decided not to adopt this "Patch"-style fix, but instead address the root cause of the difficulty in numerical progression. The overall optimization approach is:
1. Reduce ineffective numerical components and Mod types to lower progression difficulty and the understanding threshold;
2. Narrow the numerical gap between players while making the final challenge more challenging, so that progression has objectives to pursue and validate.

The optimization of Mod Guarantee acquisition will be carried out together with the overall numerical progression optimization. Once the plan is finalized, we will announce the optimization plan and timeline as soon as possible.
\[Top Suggestion] Add vibration feedback to the controller

\[Optimization Progress] Accepted. The related feature is already in the plan and being worked on. We will add vibration feedback to the controller, and will gradually cover various scenarios such as weapons, melee, and vehicle operations, making controller gameplay more immersive. More details will be continuously synchronized with everyone during development.
\[Top Suggestion] Recycling tool can be used directly from the backpack

\[Optimization Progress] Accepted. The related feature is expected to go live in October. At that time, Metas will no longer need to switch operations and can use the recycling tool directly from the backpack, simplifying the recycling process. The exact launch time is subject to the version update announcement.
\[Top Suggestion] Increase the weekly Starchrom cap

\[Optimization Progress] Under evaluation. The current weekly Starchrom obtain cap is set based on the current evolve pacing and overall balance. We understand that some Metas want to accumulate faster, and will address this alongside the overall stat growth optimization to make the growth pacing more reasonable. We will also continue to pay attention to everyone's feedback in this regard. Thank you, Metas, for your understanding and support.

That's all for this Meta Hotline. Your feedback, including your likes and dislikes, is the foundation of Once Human's continued development. We will continue to monitor the Feedback Platform and listen closely to your views. Please keep sharing your honest opinions via the Feedback Platform. Your suggestion may make the next Hot Charts!
Once Human Development Team

releases.displayName: Special Notes on Beastmaster Beast Whistle Feature and Future Optimization Plans

items.text: [p align="justify"]Dear Metas,

[p align="justify"]We have observed that since the class update on September 16(PT, all dates in this announcement are in PT), players have continuously reported an issue where beast whistles fail to summon animals. This is due to adjustments we made to the way animals are summoned and Beast Whistle is used in this Beastmaster riding ability update. The specific rule changes are as follows:

[p align="justify"]Before the adjustment: Beastmasters needed to first raise animals in the territory, then bind the corresponding animal via beast whistle, and finally use the beast whistle in the wild to summon animals for exploration and combat.
[p align="justify"]After the adjustment: Beastmasters carry the corresponding animal with them and can directly use the corresponding animal item to summon it.

[p align="justify"]The original three types of beast whistles have now been merged into one "Beast Whistle". The whistle no longer needs to be bound to a specific animal and only serves to command animals. After summoning an animal, using the "Beast Whistle" again will issue commands to the summoned animal. The original Red Beast Whistle has been directly renamed to "Beast Whistle" and retained; the other two types of whistles have not been uniformly recalled, and Beastmasters can actively use them to transform them into the new "Beast Whistle".[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/9bd35c7ddffe3a80a51e4c984e41fa0d1ecf9517.png"]
[p align="center"]
[p align="justify"]We also noticed that the current Beastmaster experience still has room for continuous optimization. Here we'd like to share the upcoming optimization plan:

[p align="justify"]1. After the September 28 version update, Beastmaster players can use a single Beast Whistle to command multiple animals simultaneously. We will continue to optimize the behavior logic of summoned animals so that they respond to Beast Whistle commands more naturally and reasonably.

[p align="justify"]2. Considering the future increase in the number of summonable animals and how the Beast Whistle is used alongside them, we will further improve how Beast Whistle works in the November 4 version update. When carrying a Beast Whistle, Beastmasters can directly use the tag button (defaults: Middle Mouse Button on PC, Tag button on mobile, double-tap Up on the D-pad for controller) to directly issue commands to animals.

[p align="justify"]3. After actual testing, we found that the current "Nimble" trait's effect does not match expectations. Due to difficulties in identifying and fixing the root cause, we expect to resolve this issue in the October 21 version Update.

[p align="justify"]4. In the current version, we've noticed a large number of Metas reporting issues regarding "Beastmaster animal carry load." After investigation, the weight-reduction buff for Beastmaster-carried animals is working correctly, but the load value is not displaying properly in the item details (for example, a Bear's load is actually 10.5, but it still displays as 35). We will fix this display issue in the September 28 version update so that it matches the actual reduced weight.

[p align="justify"]That's the end of this announcement. If you have any questions, please contact us via the Feedback Platform (Once Human Feedback Platform) or in-game Customer Service. Thank you for your continued understanding and support.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Once Human Development Team

We have scheduled server maintenance and an update for September 16, 2026, at 4:00 PM (PT). The maintenance is expected to last about 3 hours, but the actual server opening time may differ. Please manage your time wisely.

This update brings: Beast Riding Goes Live, Gardener Combat Improvements and Animal Ranching System Optimizations, Permanent Scenario Server Merge Plan, Isles of Abyss Pioneer Test, Lightforge Loot Crate "Moon That Lingers", combat balance adjustments, and more, along with recent bug fixes.

notes.title: Beast Riding Goes Live, Gardener Combat Improvements, and Animal Ranching System Optimizations

items.text: In this version update, we will roll out a major overhaul to the Class system: the Beastmaster class will be fully revamped with the Beast Riding ability, and the animal ranching system will also see synchronized improvements to ranching rules and info display. Additionally, we will make balance adjustments to the Gardeners' combat capabilities.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/743dd454bd250cfbaa8d1d007266f91164137852.jpg"]
I. Beastmaster Comprehensive Revamp
1. New Core Ability: Beast Riding
After this update, Beastmasters will gain a new core ability: Beast Riding.

Beastmasters can directly summon animals and mount eligible ones. Centered around summoning, riding, commanding, evolving, and trading, this update will systematically expand the Beastmaster's abilities.
2. Changes to the Animal Summoning Rules

In this update, we will simplify the animal summoning rules: Metas can use animal items directly from their backpack or hotbar to summon the corresponding animal; using the animal item again will recall the animal (summoning animals has a 10-second shared cooldown).

Regarding the summon count, since the Beastmaster's abilities have undergone a full overhaul, we originally planned for each Beastmaster to only be able to summon 1 animal at a time. However, after the change was announced in the Dev Blog, we received a large amount of feedback from Metas in the community, so we decided to keep the setting where Beastmasters can summon 3 animals simultaneously.
At the same time, we need to be upfront with everyone about the timeline for this adjustment:

1) After the September 16 version update (PT): Due to version development and testing schedules, and to ensure version stability, when this iteration goes live, each Beastmaster will only be able to summon 1 animal at a time;
2) After the September 28 version update (PT): This will be adjusted so that the Beastmaster can summon 3 animals simultaneously (the simultaneous summon limit for non-Beastmaster classes is 1).

This means that From September 16 to September 28 (PT)【原：from September 17 to September 28 (PT)】, Beastmasters will still briefly be subject to the summon count restriction. We know this arrangement will continue to cause inconvenience during this period, and this is the result of our previous plan's lack of foresight. We offer our sincere apologies to all Metas.

notes.title: Regarding animal summon rules, please note the following

items.text: 1) Only adult animals with sufficient Energy (>20%) can be summoned.
2) Summoned animals will default to an idle state, and Beastmasters can issue commands to them via Beast Whistle.
3) Each time an animal dies, it will lose a certain amount of Energy.
4) Non-Beastmaster classes can also summon animals with saddles equipped in the wild for riding, but cannot summon them inside dungeons or during combat.
3. Riding Rules
Bareback Riding
When encountering unoccupied wild animals in the wild, or summoning animals without saddles, Beastmasters can mount them directly through interactions.

Each bareback riding consumes a certain amount of character Stamina; Bareback riding is not possible when stamina is insufficient. Animals without saddles will resist the Beastmaster: while mounted, the animal's max stamina will be limited, its special abilities cannot be used, and the animal will attempt to break free.
Saddle Riding

After equipping an animal with a saddle, the beastmaster can ride it stably. Beastmasters can use saddle items from their backpack, drag the saddle onto the animal, modify the gear in the animal's details, or directly equip the saddle while the animal is anesthetized.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/3374422b05c82182d175cec96b8342ec5314a6f4.gif"]

While riding, Metas can fire using weapons, perform melee attacks, and engage in gathering, interactions, using consumables, and using Deviation ability without special animations. Performing actions with special animations (such as opening weapon crates, teleporting, or switching worlds) will immediately dismount you.
4. Animal Mount Ability
For Beastmasters, the animal's special ability can be used while mounted with a saddle.
Triggered with the Ctrl key on PC, by tapping the dedicated button on Mobile, and with the R1+X/RB+A button combination on console.

*Non-Beastmaster classes cannot use animal special abilities or benefit from their effects. In the current version, the animals supported for riding are Deer, Boar, Bear, and Wild Buffalo. We will continue to expand the types of ridable animals in the future. Wild animals do not possess active/passive skills themselves; only Beastmasters can utilize these abilities when riding with a saddle.
5. Class Trait Adjustments
Beast Partner

When a Beastmaster approaches an animal, the animal will not flee or attack, and the Beastmaster can directly listen to the animal's thoughts and check its Stats and Traits. The Beastmaster can also use the Beast Whistle to issue commands to summoned beast partners, directing them to perform specific actions such as combat and gathering.

A Beastmaster cannot issue commands to animals that are more than 10 levels above their own level. Animals summoned using animal items default to a waiting-to-mount state and will only enter an assisting state after the Beastmaster issues a command via the Beast Whistle. Non-Beastmaster classes can also summon combat animals, but the summoned animals do not possess combat abilities.

The original three types of Beast Whistles will be merged into one. The whistle is no longer bound to a specific animal and only serves to command animals. Beastmasters will learn its crafting formula by default. The original red beast whistle will be directly renamed to "Beast Whistle" and retained; the other two types of whistles will not be uniformly recalled, and Beastmasters can actively use them to transform them into the new "Beast Whistle". This update will not uniformly recall old whistles, nor will it uniformly distribute new whistles.
Breeding Expert

Beastmasters can craft gene items to perform targeted modifications on animal genes, granting animals unique traits; they can also gradually improve the level of animal trait attributes through breeding and exploration.
This update will also adjust animal trait attributes, adding 7 new attribute groups and adjusting 2 existing attribute groups.

The movement speed bonus for animals while mounted is a separate stat from the movement speed bonus for animals in normal state. The default animal movement speed bonus does not apply to animals while mounted, but it still applies to animals summoned to assist in combat and exploration. (An animal's mounted state and combat state are separate behavioral states; traits that apply to the combat state cannot take effect in the mounted state.)
Wilderness Master

Beastmasters can craft and replace gear and saddles for animals, providing ability bonuses for animals in normal and mounted states respectively; they can also sell saddled animals to other Metas, allowing other classes to ride animals as well. When Beastmasters carry animals, they can also significantly reduce the animals' weight.

*Only Beastmasters can craft and replace animal gear and saddles. Metas of non-Beastmaster classes can only check the gear and saddles currently equipped on animals and cannot replace or change them, but they can still benefit from existing saddle effects. After a Beastmaster trades an animal wearing a saddle to another Meta, the ownership permissions for the corresponding animal and saddle will be adjusted accordingly.
6. Class Starting Items and Default Formula Adjustments

notes.title: Beastmasters start with the following items

items.text: Starting Partner: Choose one animal from Deer, Boar, or Bear.
Beast Whistle: Issue commands to summoned Beast Partners.
Basic Saddle: Equip it on an animal to unlock mounting ability.

Beastmasters start with mastery of saddle, animal ranching, animal breeding, and tranquilizer throwing needle-related tech formulas without needing to unlock them separately. They also master the crafting formulas for tranquilizer throwing needles, animal troughs, and youngling huts .
7. Beastmaster Usability Optimization
Manual Feeding

To make it easier for Metas to ride animals in the wild, this update adds a manual feeding feature. After summoning an animal, Metas can interact with it to feed it manually. The feedable content matches the animal's preferred food.
Animals with insufficient Energy cannot be summoned. If a Meta attempts to summon such an animal through the backpack interface, the system will automatically open the feeding interface.
Please note: Animals in ranching state within a territory do not support manual feeding.
II. Animal Ranching System Optimization
This update will also synchronize adjustments to the animal ranching system, with the core objective of reducing daily maintenance burden and making ranching rules clearer.
1. Simplified Ranching Maintenance Rules
In the current version, Metas need to simultaneously monitor multiple stats such as Tameness, Energy, and Hydration, which results in high maintenance costs and a lack of intuitiveness.
After this adjustment, the core judgment for animal ranching will focus on Energy:
(1) Animals will no longer have Tameness or Hydration stats.
(2) Rules for growth, breeding, byproduct production, and slaughter yields will all be governed by Energy.
(3) The "Docile" trait related to Tameness will lose its effect and be replaced with a new one—increasing the growth speed of younglings.
(4) Trait attributes will be unlocked sequentially when animals reach Lv. 20, 30, 40, and 50. Traits already unlocked before the update will not be affected.
(5) After this update, feeding Mixed Meat Feed, Mixed Grain Feed, or Mixed Herb Feed will only increase Energy.
After the adjustment, animal Energy will be divided into the following three tiers:
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,,"]
Energy
Byproduct Production
Slaughter Yields

Breeding Conditions
Efficient byproduct production
Rewards large supplies
Normal growth

Normal byproduct production

Not ready to breed
Pause byproduct production

Pause growth
Not ready to breed
In simple terms, if you want animals to grow, produce, and breed steadily, maintaining a higher Energy level is more important.
2. Animal Status Display and Offline Feeding Optimization

To make farming status more intuitive, the animal list will now include icons for Energy status, Courtship status, and Breeding Cooldown status. Breeding-related statuses will also be more clearly displayed in animal info, making it easier for Metas to quickly assess an animal's current production, growth, and breeding state.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4a324a34040a6bcac0995aa7d359d0221b17809a.png"]
This update also optimizes offline feeding logic so that animal food consumption during offline periods behaves as expected:
(1) Offline feeding only consumes items from the animal trough; items discarded on the ground will not be consumed.
(2) Body Boost Feed will not be consumed during offline periods.
3. Animal Distribution Tracking

In response to popular demand from Metas, this update adds animal tracking to the World Map. All Metas can check the distribution of all animals in the current scenario under the World Map's \[Filter - Resource Tracking] Tab. The relevant rules are the same as those for crops and ores tracking.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/32540e6031691ad5576aa929f1f262cea8a45e70.png"]
III. Gardener Combat Optimization
1. Portable Planter Box and Biomechanical Crop Adjustments

This update will enhance the Gardeners' combat capabilities: the Portable Planter Box can now hold different types of biomechanical crops simultaneously, and the abilities of each biomechanical crop will also be strengthened, giving Gardeners stronger sustained damage and field control in combat. To ensure the enhanced strength remains within a reasonable range, we have simultaneously introduced a durability rule as a new usage cost.

Portable Planter Box Usage Rule Adjustment: Portable Planter Boxes loaded with different types of biomechanical crops can now be placed independently, with cooldowns calculated separately. This means Metas can deploy multiple biomechanical units on the field at the same time, enabling richer tactical combinations.

Portable Planter Box Durability Rule Adjustment: The Portable Planter Box will be adjusted to an item with durability, consuming a certain amount of durability with each use. This rule is a usage cost introduced alongside this ability enhancement, used to balance the strengthened biomechanical strength. When durability is depleted, the Portable Planter Box will be consumed along with the biomechanical crops inside.

Biomechanical Crop Grafting Rule Adjustment: After the update, the abilities of Balloon, Rainfall Reaper, Flare Bulbfly, Watcher, The Portal, and Agent biomechanical units will be strengthened and will no longer be differentiated based on grafted crops. Grafting different crops will only affect the cosmetic appearance of the biomechanical units, allowing Metas more freedom in cosmetic matching.
Biomechanical Crop Ability Adjustments (overall enhancements) are as follows:

2. Additional Notes on Usability Optimization
Portable Planter Box Display Optimization: Portable Planter Boxes loaded with different biomechanical crops will now be clearly distinguished on item pins.
Biomechanical Part and Facility Description Optimization: All Biomechanical Parts and Facilities will now have their functions and post-grafting ability effects detailed in their item descriptions.

notes.title: The Way of Winter & Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve Scenario Permanent Server Merge

items.text: Since the launch of permanent servers, we have received a lot of feedback regarding the permanent server experience, including issues such as low populations on some servers, Metas in the same scenario being scattered across multiple permanent servers, and returning players being assigned to different permanent servers where they cannot reunite with friends. Additionally, a considerable number of permanent servers have low active populations, making some game modes impossible to participate in or start. To truly bring Metas in the same scenario together in one world and make the permanent server experience more complete and lively, we hope to move forward with permanent server merges.

After the release of the "Permanent Scenario Server Merge Notice," we received a large amount of feedback and questions from Metas. The dev team is reviewing the scope of impact and plans item by item to ensure a better experience after the merge. After discussion and surveys with Metas, the permanent servers for the "The Way of Winter" and "Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve" will bring a better experience to Metas on permanent servers after merging, as the population is moderate and the gameplay mechanics will not be affected by an increased number of worlds. Therefore, we will proceed with merging the permanent servers for these two scenarios. For "Manibus" and "Endless Dream", as the population is relatively large and the mechanics are more complex, we will evaluate whether to proceed with server merges after refining the plan. During this period, we welcome suggestions from all Metas.

notes.title: The permanent server merge plan has been updated as follows

items.text: 1. "The Way of Winter": Will take place during the version maintenance on September 16 (PT) (covering North America, Europe, South America, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, and HK & MO & TW regions).

2. "Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve": The South America region will proceed at 05:00 server time on September 17, and is expected to be completed within 1 hour. Other regions (North America, Europe, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, HK & MO & TW) will be handled in subsequent batches, with specific times to be announced in advance via official announcements.
3. "Manibus" and "Endless Dream" permanent servers currently have no merge plans. If there are specific merge plans, they will be announced in advance via official announcements.

*Please note: To ensure data security during the server merge, some Metas may be forcibly logged out during the merge. Please wait a moment, and you can sign in again to continue playing once the merge is complete.

After the merge, when your character is migrated to the new permanent server, your character level, supplies, tech level, and more will be transferred to the new permanent server without any loss. The task progress on the original server will be uniformly reset to the scenario challenge tasks and rewards of the current new permanent server, ensuring a consistent experience for both veteran and new Metas after the merge. Your hive relationships will also be synchronized to the new permanent server. For specific merge rules and details, refer to the dev blog: >>>Dev Blog | Permanent Scenario Server Merge Notice

notes.title: \[Update Preview] Character Customization and Hairstyle Dye Will Soon Be Free

items.text: The freedom of personal expression is an important part of the cosmetic experience in Once Human. To let Metas shape their image more freely, we will make the following adjustments to the character customization experience after the September 28 version update (PT). We'd like to give all Metas a heads-up:

1. Free Reshape and Hair Dyeing: Facial and body reshaping, as well as palette hair dyeing, will no longer consume any items such as Chrysalis Tokens or Butterfly Dyes. Metas can visit the floor mirror in the territory at any time to freely reshape their face and body and change hair color without any item consumption requirements.

2. Chrysalis Tokens and Butterfly Dyes Withdrawn from all Channels: Items already obtained will not become invalid. After the update, they can be converted into Colorful Badges (each Chrysalis Token converts to Colorful Badge ×120, each Butterfly Dye converts to Colorful Badge ×60).
3. Price Reduction for Metamorphosis Token: The price of the gender-change item "Metamorphosis Token" will be reduced from 880 Crystgins to 300 Crystgins.

4. Compensation for Recent Purchasers: Metas who purchased Chrysalis Tokens or Butterfly Dyes from the Shop using Crystgin or Colorful Badges within 3 months before the September 28 version update (PT) will receive a full refund of the currency spent at the time of purchase. Metas who purchased Metamorphosis Tokens during this period will receive a Crystgin refund of 70% of the price difference (580 Crystgins each). Compensation will be automatically distributed via in-game Mail after the version update, with no manual claiming required.

For the complete explanation of these adjustments (including conversion rules for existing items and compensation details), please check the dev blog >>>Dev Blog | Character Customization and Hair Dye Are Now Free!

notes.title: First Person Mode on Mobile Added Auto-Fire Setting: Bow Auto-Fire Charge

items.text: We've noticed that Metas who enjoy using bows have experienced pain points when auto-fire is enabled. To significantly improve the DMG per shot and combat feel of bows under auto-fire, after this update, a bow auto-fire charge option has been added to settings. When this feature is enabled, bow-type weapons in auto-fire will prioritize charging and will only automatically fire once fully charged.

notes.title: New Survival Scenario: Isles of Abyss Coming Soon

items.text: With this update, we will launch the pioneer test for the new survival scenario, Isles of Abyss. Metas who signed up through the earlier recruitment can switch to the pioneer server via the button in the top-left corner of the scenario selection interface after the test begins.
Final Pioneer Confidential Test for the New Survival Scenario: Isles of Abyss.
This ocean world full of mystery and adventure awaits Pioneer Metas to explore and share feedback. We welcome you to join!
Test Duration: September 16 at 9:00 PM (PT), expected to last for 22 days.

This scenario will present Metas with a brand-new maritime survival challenge, featuring the complete Isles of the Abyss map. You will need to explore a cluster of scattered islands, gather resources amidst dynamic weather and day-night cycles, build facilities, and confront threats from the environment and mysterious enemies.

This is the final test for the Isles of Abyss scenario, with the overall test objective focusing more on the complete scenario experience. The current phase is planned as "Phase I: 5 days, Phase II: 17 days" (the phase duration for this test is only applicable to the test schedule; the final scenario phase cycle is subject to the official release version). We are always committed to maintaining the dynamic balance of the combat system, keeping combat gameplay fresh and strategic, and delivering a continuously evolving combat experience for all players.

We plan to rework and adjust the mechanics of MG4 - Conflicting Memories in this update, and will continue to rework other weapons in subsequent updates. We will also adjust the Treacherous Tides Set in this update.

Since the release of the dev blog about balance, we have received much feedback regarding the adjustments to the Treacherous Tides Set. 1. New Core Ability: Beast Riding

releases.displayName: Dev Blog | Permanent Scenario Server Merge Notice

items.text: Dear Metas,

[p align="justify"]After the class system adjustment details were announced, we received a great deal of feedback and suggestions regarding changes to the Beastmaster, Gardener, and other classes. Over the past few days, the dev team has read through every comment from worldwide Metas. The discussion around how many animals a Beastmaster can summon was the most concentrated one and gave us the most to reflect on.

[p align="justify"]We realized that in our previous plan, we increased the strength of a single animal, but overlooked that having multiple animals fight alongside is the very reason many Metas chose and love Beastmasters. Whether it's teaming up with companions to explore, wandering the wilds with your animals taking photos, or spending hours breeding individuals with rare patterns and attributes, these are irreplaceable joys of the Beastmaster class.

[p align="justify"]After repeated discussion and evaluation, we have decided to adopt the Metas' feedback and revise this adjustment plan: the Beastmaster will retain the ability to summon 3 animals simultaneously.
[p align="justify"]At the same time, we need to be upfront with everyone about the timeline for this adjustment:

[p align="justify"]1) After the September 16(PT) version update: Due to version development and testing schedules, and to ensure version stability, when this iteration goes live, each Beastmaster will only be able to summon 1 animal at a time;

[p align="justify"]2) After the September 28(PT) version update: This will be adjusted so that the Beastmaster can summon 3 animals simultaneously (the simultaneous summon limit for non-Beastmaster classes is 1).

[p align="justify"]This means that from September 16(PT) to September 28(PT), Beastmasters will still briefly be subject to the summon count restriction. We know this arrangement will continue to cause inconvenience during this period, and this is the result of our previous plan's lack of foresight. We offer our sincere apologies to all Metas.

[p align="justify"]The newly added contents such as animal riding and animal active skills will also be rolled out gradually with version updates. We hope the Beastmaster class can retain its original gameplay fun while also having more stable and richer combat performances.
[p align="justify"]Below are the FAQ responses regarding this Class System adjustment.
[p align="justify"]I. Animal Summon Count and Schedule
[p align="justify"]Q1: How many animals can a Beastmaster summon at the same time? Why is it being split into two updates?

[p align="justify"]A: \[Expected to be optimized with the September 28(PT) version update] The final plan is: Beastmasters can summon 3 animals simultaneously in battle, and the summon quantity limit remains unchanged; the simultaneous summon limit for non-Beastmaster classes is 1.

[p align="justify"]This cannot go live with the September 16(PT) version due to version development and testing schedules. We understand it would not be pleasant to keep waiting during this period for Metas, so we will complete the adjustment as soon as possible after the September 28(PT) update.

[p align="justify"]At the same time, the newly added summon method will also be retained: Metas can directly use animal items from the backpack or hotbar to summon the corresponding animal, and using the item again will recall the animal (summoning animals has a 10-second cooldown). In addition, Beastmasters will enjoy a load reduction effect when carrying animals (Load -70%), making it easier to travel with more animals.
