[p align="justify"]Regarding existing cultivation and attributes: Since the setting of summoning up to 3 animals is retained, there will be no depreciation of previously cultivated animals, rare patterns, or attributes. Trait attributes that rely on multiple animals being present simultaneously (such as Pack Wolves, Alpha Wolf, Wrath of Nature, Tearer, etc.) will continue to function with their original effects; multiple animals previously bred by Metas will remain valid for deployment, production, or display purposes.

[p align="justify"]In the future, we will also make adaptive adjustments to related attribute effects based on combat balance conditions to ensure attributes remain usable and playable. If any adjustments involve numerical changes, we will synchronize with everyone in advance through dev blogs and announcements.
[p align="justify"]II. Animal Riding Ability Explanation
[p align="justify"]Q2: What exactly are an animal's active skill and passive skill?

[p align="justify"]A: Riding brings Beastmasters clear numerical enhancements. While riding with saddles on the animal, Beastmasters can not only use the animal's active skill, but also continuously receive the animal's passive skill bonuses — including increasing the rider's Weapon DMG and Status DMG, taking DMG in place of the rider, and increasing Movement Speed. For this reason, we highly recommend Beastmasters ride and fight in combat to fully leverage the benefits of animal abilities.
[p align="justify"]Animals currently supported for mounting in this version are Deer, Boar, Bear, and Wild Buffalo. Their specific abilities are as follows:
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][p align="justify"]Animal

[p align="justify"]Deer
[p align="justify"]Has faster riding Movement Speed. Based on current Movement Speed, proportionally increases the Weapon DMG and Status DMG (up to 37.5%).

[p align="justify"]Boar
[p align="justify"]Takes 20% of DMG in place of the rider, and the animal itself also gains a certain amount of DMG Reduction.

[p align="justify"]Continuously consumes Stamina to charge forward. Each enemy hit increases the boar's DMG Reduction by 5% (up to 20%), lasting for 10 seconds. This ability does not provide character bonuses. Cooldown: 8 seconds.
[p align="justify"]Bear
[p align="justify"]Increases the rider's Weapon DMG and Status DMG by 20%, and grants a certain amount of DMG Reduction to itself.

[p align="justify"]Swing to release a shockwave over a distance. Hitting enemy units deals 200% of Attack as DMG. Each objective hit increases the rider's Weapons and Status DMG by 5% (up to 15%), lasting 5 seconds.
[p align="justify"]Wild Buffalo

[p align="justify"]It should be noted that wild animals do not possess active/passive abilities by default; only Beastmasters can utilize the above abilities when riding an animal with a saddle. We will also continue to expand the types of rideable animals in the future.
[p align="justify"]III. Riding Gameplay
[p align="justify"]Q3: Will more animals be rideable in the future?

[p align="justify"]A: Yes. We will continue to expand the types of rideable animals in the future. The first batch to be released are aquatic animals, which will support movement on water surfaces, providing a new way to explore waters and islands. We are also evaluating other animals that Metas have highly requested. Please refer to future official announcements, and we will continue to synchronize development progress.
[p align="justify"]Q4: In which scenes is riding gameplay available, and what are the benefits and restrictions?

[p align="justify"]1) Riding is not restricted by scene. Metas can ride summoned animals for exploration and combat in all dungeons and public crisis events (non-Beastmaster classes still cannot summon inside dungeons or during combat);

[p align="justify"]2) While riding, all classes can use weapons to fire and can also use melee weapons for close-range attacks. Note that non-Beastmaster players cannot use animal active skills while riding, nor will they receive animal passive skills bonuses;

[p align="justify"]3) While riding, Metas can use certain Deviation skills that do not have special full-body animations (e.g., Zapamander's "Lightning Dash"). However, Deviation skills that require full-body animation performances for the character (e.g., Mitsuko's "Mitsuko's Guidance") cannot be used while riding for now;

[p align="justify"]4) When performing actions with special animations (e.g., opening a weapon crate) or certain special actions (e.g., teleporting, switching world), you will leave the riding state. After completing the action, you can still summon and continue to ride.
[p align="justify"]IV. Gardener Class
[p align="justify"]Q5: After the Tameness adjustment, is Director Fox still useful?

[p align="justify"]A: Yes. We will adapt and adjust Director Fox's effect: the original effect "Increases the Securement Progress of all bred animals in the territory by up to 20%" will be changed to "Reduces Energy consumption of all bred animals in the territory by up to 20%. Effects of the same type do not stack." Other effects remain unchanged. This adjustment is expected to go live with the September 16(PT) version update.
[p align="justify"]Q6: Why Gardener's Nature Affinity remains unchanged?

[p align="justify"]A: Our initial design mainly considered the Gardener's sustainability experience in pollution zones, wilderness gathering, and survival environments, but we indeed did not fully consider the impact of this effect on certain special builds, especially HP-control builds. Going forward, we will adjust Nature Affinity into a special item craftable by the Gardener. After use, it can provide controllable adjustment to sanity recovery or reduction based on the Metas' environment. This way, we can address the Gardener's survival needs in pollution zones while also accommodating certain Metas' needs for HP and sanity control under special builds.
[p align="justify"]Q7: Now that Biomechanicals have become consumables, is the Biomechanical grafting probability still this low?

[p align="justify"]A: In this adjustment, we have simultaneously increased the grafting success rate of some combat Biomechanical parts to reduce the usage cost for Gardeners. The specific adjustments are as follows:

[p align="justify"]We will continue to monitor the usage cost, strength performance, and maintenance experience of Biomechanicals in actual combat, and make further adjustments based on live server data and Metas' feedback.
[p align="justify"]V. Future Optimization Directions
[p align="justify"]Q8: When multiple animals are deployed simultaneously, will issues such as blocking shots, body blocking, and navigation error be resolved?

[p align="justify"]A: These issues are quite complex, involving underlying logic and extensive scene adaptation. We are working hard on these and once we have a clear timeline, we will share it with everyone as soon as possible.

[p align="justify"]We'd also like to share a tip with Metas: Some animals are quite large, and when multiple animals are deployed at once, they can block your view or affect your positioning. Therefore, we suggest Metas decide which and how many animals to summon based on the actual terrain and combat scene — for example, in narrower terrain, choosing smaller animals will make the overall experience smoother.

[p align="justify"]If you encounter specific problem scenarios, you're also welcome to submit a description through the Feedback Platform (screenshots or recordings are even better) to help us locate and reproduce the issue faster.
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]After the related features go live, we will continue to track the combat performance and usage data of classes like Beastmaster and Gardener, and keep optimizing based on feedback. That's all for this Dev Blog. If you have any suggestions or questions about these Class System adjustments, please feel free to reach out to us via the Feedback Platform (Once Human Feedback Platform) or in-game Customer Service.
[p align="justify"]Thank you all for your companionship, feedback, and support along the way.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Once Human Development Team

releases.displayName: Dev Blog | Beast Riding, Gardener Combat, and Ranching Updates

items.text: Dear Metas,

In the September 16(PT) version update, we will roll out a major overhaul to the Class system: the Beastmaster class will be fully revamped with the new Beast Riding ability, and the animal ranching system will also see synchronized improvements to rules and info display. Additionally, we will make balance adjustments to the Gardeners' combat capabilities.
Here are the details of this update.
I. Beastmaster Comprehensive Revamp
1. New Core Ability: Beast Riding
After this update, Beastmasters will gain a new core ability: Beast Riding.

Beastmasters can directly summon animals and mount eligible ones. Centered around summoning, riding, commanding, evolving, and trading, this update will systematically expand the Beastmaster's abilities.
2. Changes to the Animal Summoning Rules

In this update, we will simplify the animal summoning rules: Metas can use animal items directly from their backpack or hotbar to summon the corresponding animal; using the animal item again will recall the animal (summoning animals has a 10-second shared cooldown).
Due to the overall revamp of Beastmaster abilities, each Beastmaster can now only have 1 animal summoned at one time after the update.
Only adult animals with sufficient Energy (>20%) can be summoned.
Summoned animals will default to an idle state, and Beastmasters can issue commands to them via Beast Whistle.
Each time an animal dies, it will lose a certain amount of Energy.
Non-Beastmaster classes can also summon animals with saddles equipped in the wild for riding, but cannot summon them inside dungeons or during combat.
3. Riding Rules
Bareback Riding
When encountering unoccupied wild animals in the wild, or summoning animals without saddles, Beastmasters can mount them directly through interactions.

Each bareback riding consumes a certain amount of character Stamina; Bareback riding is not possible when stamina is insufficient. Animals without saddles will resist the Beastmaster: while mounted, the animal's special abilities cannot be used, and the animal will attempt to break free.
Saddle Riding

After equipping an animal with a saddle, the beastmaster can ride it stably. Beastmasters can use saddle items from their backpack, drag the saddle onto the animal, modify the gear in the animal's details, or directly equip the saddle while the animal is anesthetized.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/09/11/2ea26d4ff9954dc9a16d13403328d7c1.gif&code=eVNXeHMyWVFfMTc4OTU1NjQ3MDM0OQ==" style="max-width:100%;"]

While riding, Metas can fire using weapons, perform melee attacks, and engage in gathering, interactions, using consumables, and using Deviation ability without special animations. Performing actions with special animations (such as opening weapon crates, teleporting, or switching worlds) will immediately dismount you.
4. Animal Mount Ability
For Beastmasters, the animal's special ability can be used while mounted with a saddle.
(Triggered with Ctrl key on PC; the dedicated button on mobile, and the R1+X/RB+A button combination on console)
Non-Beastmaster classes cannot use animal special abilities or benefit from their effects.
Table 1 Animal Special Abilities

Animals currently supported for mounting in this version are Deer, Boar, Bear, and Wild Buffalo. We will continue to expand the variety of ridable animals in the future.
Wild animals do not possess active/passive abilities by default; only Beastmasters can utilize the above abilities when mounted with a saddle.
5. Class Trait Adjustments
Beast Partner

When a Beastmaster approaches an animal, the animal will not flee or attack, and the Beastmaster can directly listen to the animal's thoughts and check its Stats and Traits. The Beastmaster can also use the Beast Whistle to issue commands to summoned beast partners, directing them to perform specific actions such as combat and gathering.

A Beastmaster cannot issue commands to animals that are more than 10 levels above their own level. Animals summoned using animal items default to a waiting-to-mount state and will only enter an assisting state after the Beastmaster issues a command via the Beast Whistle. Non-Beastmaster classes can also summon combat animals, but the summoned animals do not possess combat abilities.

The original three types of Beast Whistles will be merged into one. The whistle is no longer bound to a specific animal and only serves to command animals. Beastmasters will learn its crafting formula by default. The original red beast whistle will be directly renamed to "Beast Whistle" and retained; the other two types of whistles will not be uniformly recalled, and Beastmasters can actively use them to transform them into the new "Beast Whistle". This update will not uniformly recall old whistles, nor will it uniformly distribute new whistles.
Breeding Expert

Beastmasters can craft gene items to perform targeted modifications on animal genes, granting animals unique traits; they can also gradually improve the level of animal trait attributes through breeding and exploration.
This update will also adjust animal trait attributes, adding 7 new attribute groups and adjusting 2 existing attribute groups.
Table 2: Animal Attribute Additions and Adjustments

The movement speed bonus for animals while mounted is a separate stat from the movement speed bonus for animals in normal state. The default animal movement speed bonus does not apply to animals while mounted, but it still applies to animals summoned to assist in combat and exploration.
Wilderness Master

Beastmasters can craft and replace gear and saddles for animals, providing ability bonuses for animals in normal and mounted states respectively; they can also sell saddled animals to other Metas, allowing other classes to ride animals as well. When Beastmasters carry animals, they can also significantly reduce the animals' weight.

Only Beastmasters can craft or replace animal gear and saddles.
Metas of non-Beastmaster classes can only view the gear and saddles currently worn by animals. They cannot replace or change them, but they can still enjoy the effects of existing saddles.
After a Beastmaster trades an animal with a saddle equipped to another Meta, the owner permissions for the animal and saddle will be synchronized accordingly.
6. Class Starting Items and Default Formula Adjustments

notes.title: Beastmasters start with the following items

items.text: Starting Partner: Choose one animal from Deer, Boar, or Bear.
Beast Whistle: Issue commands to summoned Beast Partners.
Basic Saddle: Equip it on an animal to unlock mounting ability.

Beastmasters start with mastery of saddle, animal husbandry, animal breeding, and tranquilizer throwing needle-related tech formulas without needing to unlock them separately. They also master the crafting formulas for tranquilizer throwing needles, animal troughs, and youngling huts .
7. Beastmaster Usability Optimization
Manual Feeding

To make it easier for Metas to ride animals in the wild, this update adds a manual feeding feature. After summoning an animal, Metas can interact with it to feed it manually. The feedable content matches the animal's preferred food.
Animals with insufficient Energy cannot be summoned. If a Meta attempts to summon such an animal through the backpack interface, the system will automatically open the feeding interface.
Please note: Animals in ranching state within a Territory do not support manual feeding.
II. Animal Ranching System Optimization
This update will also synchronize adjustments to the animal ranching system, with the core objective of reducing daily maintenance burden and making ranching rules clearer.
1. Simplified Ranching Maintenance Rules
In the current version, Metas need to simultaneously monitor multiple stats such as Tameness, Energy, and Hydration, which results in high maintenance costs and a lack of intuitiveness.
After this adjustment, the core judgment for animal ranching will focus on Energy:
(1) Animals will no longer have Tameness or Hydration stats.
(2) Rules for growth, breeding, byproduct production, and slaughter yields will all be governed by Energy.
(3) The "Docile" trait related to Tameness will lose its effect and be replaced with a new one—increasing the growth speed of younglings.
(4) Trait attributes will be unlocked sequentially when animals reach Lv. 20, 30, 40, and 50. Traits already unlocked before the update will not be affected.
(5) After this update, feeding Mixed Meat Feed, Mixed Grain Feed, or Mixed Herb Feed will only increase Energy.
After the adjustment, animal Energy will be divided into the following three tiers:

In simple terms, if you want animals to grow, produce, and breed steadily, maintaining a higher Energy level is more important.
2. Animal Status Display and Offline Feeding Optimization

To make farming status more intuitive, the animal list will now include icons for Energy status, Courtship status, and Breeding Cooldown status. Breeding-related statuses will also be more clearly displayed in animal info, making it easier for Metas to quickly assess an animal's current production, growth, and breeding state.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/09/11/df4ee71494154e4798e000c247b6f1b3.png&code=U2VqMkhTWkNfMTc4OTU1NjUyNzQ2MA==" style="max-width:100%;"]
This update also optimizes offline feeding logic so that animal food consumption during offline periods behaves as expected:
(1) Offline feeding only consumes items from the animal trough; items discarded on the ground will not be consumed.
(2) Body Boost Feed will not be consumed during offline periods.
3. Animal Distribution Tracking

In response to popular demand from Metas, this update adds animal tracking to the World Map. All Metas can check the distribution of all animals in the current Scenario under the World Map's \[Filter - Resource Tracking] Tab. The relevant rules are the same as those for crops and ores tracking.
[img src="https://office.netease.com/api/pub/file/download?path=popo/2026/09/10/69bcbe695fe74ec88dc70ac6bbef2cc5.png&code=dmJwc3p3RDZfMTc4OTU1NjU0NzAwNQ==" style="max-width:100%;"]
III. Gardener Combat Optimization
1. Portable Planter Box and Biomechanical Crop Adjustments

This update will enhance the Gardeners' combat capabilities: the Portable Planter Box can now hold different types of biomechanical crops simultaneously, and the abilities of each biomechanical crop will also be strengthened, giving Gardeners stronger sustained damage and field control in combat. To ensure the enhanced strength remains within a reasonable range, we have simultaneously introduced a durability rule as a new usage cost.

Portable Planter Box Usage Rule Adjustment: Portable Planter Boxes loaded with different types of biomechanical crops can now be placed independently, with cooldowns calculated separately. This means Metas can deploy multiple biomechanical units on the field at the same time, enabling richer tactical combinations.

Portable Planter Box Durability Rule Adjustment: The Portable Planter Box will be adjusted to an item with durability, consuming a certain amount of durability with each use. This rule is a usage cost introduced alongside this ability enhancement, used to balance the strengthened biomechanical strength. When durability is depleted, the Portable Planter Box will be consumed along with the biomechanical crops inside.

Biomechanical Crop Grafting Rule Adjustment: After the update, the abilities of Balloon, Rainfall Reaper, Flare Bulbfly, Watcher, The Portal, and Agent biomechanical units will be strengthened and will no longer be differentiated based on grafted crops. Grafting different crops will only affect the cosmetic appearance of the biomechanical units, allowing Metas more freedom in cosmetic matching.

2. Additional Notes on Usability Optimization

Biomechanical Part and Facility Description Optimization: All Biomechanical Parts and Facilities will now have their functions and post-grafting ability effects detailed in their item descriptions.

The above is the main content of this Developer Blog. We will continue to monitor the actual experience of each class and the animal farming system, and keep optimizing related gameplay. If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to share them with us via the Feedback Platform (Once Human Feedback Platform).
Once Human Development Team

releases.displayName: Dev Blog | September Combat Balance Adjustments

items.text: Dear Metas,

[p align="justify"]In Once Human, the diversity of weapons and builds has always been a key part of the combat experience. We are always committed to maintaining the dynamic balance of the combat system, keeping combat gameplay fresh and strategic, and delivering a continuously evolving combat experience for all players.

[p align="justify"]The dev team has continued to receive substantial feedback from Metas requesting effect reworks and numerical adjustments for some weapons less frequently used. We plan to rework and adjust the mechanics of MG4 - Conflicting Memories in the September 16(PT) Update, and will continue to rework other weapons in subsequent updates. We will also adjust the Treacherous Tides Set in this update.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]MG4 - Conflicting Memories

[p align="justify"]In this adjustment, we lowered the hit threshold for Conflicting Memories to trigger Shrapnel, allowing Shrapnel to activate faster and improving the damage rhythm and target-switching efficiency during sustained fire. At the same time, we added a periodic area Shrapnel effect, allowing Conflicting Memories to maintain its single-target output capability while also handling multi-target combat environments more comfortably.
[p align="justify"]Through this adjustment, we hope to further strengthen its combat identity of frequently triggering Shrapnel and continuously suppressing multiple targets.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][p align="justify"]Adjustment Details
[p align="justify"]After
[p align="justify"]Before
[p align="justify"]MG4 - Conflicting Memories
[p align="justify"]Every 6 hits triggers Shrapnel on the target.
[p align="justify"]After reloading, or every 12 cumulative hits, the next Shrapnel trigger is upgraded to \[Memory Storm]: dealing Shrapnel to targets within range simultaneously.
[p align="justify"]Each time a Shrapnel effect is applied to a target, gain Super Armor for 0.5s. This effect can stack.
[p align="justify"]Shrapnel parts +1, Shrapnel DMG rate increased.
[p align="justify"]Triggers Shrapnel after 12 hits.
[p align="justify"]For every 25 bullets in the magazine, Shrapnel trigger parts +1, up to +6.
[p align="justify"]When magazine capacity exceeds 90 bullets, every extra 15 bullets increases Shrapnel DMG rate by 10%.
[p align="justify"]Magazine capacity +40
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Treacherous Tides Set Adjustments

[p align="justify"]Treacherous Tides originally provided high output benefits for low sanity states, but in actual use, Metas needed to maintain or actively lower sanity to fully utilize the set effect.

[p align="justify"]This adjustment changes Treacherous Tides' DMG bonus from scaling with sanity to scaling with HP, removing the direct link between sanity and the DMG bonus. Metas no longer need to actively maintain low sanity for higher damage output—you can simply monitor your HP to gauge the current set's benefit.

[p align="justify"]Additionally, we've removed the fixed 10% DMG bonus from the Treacherous Tides 3-piece set and increased the Shield benefit of the 4-piece set. Our goal is to improve the set's usability while moderately reining in its DMG output, boosting survivability, and preserving Treacherous Tides' core identity of enhancing DMG based on HP changes.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][p align="justify"]Adjustment Details
[p align="justify"]After
[p align="justify"]Before
[p align="justify"]2-Piece Set
[p align="justify"]When HP is below 70%, Weapon DMG and Status DMG +10%.
[p align="justify"]When HP is below 70%, Weapon DMG and Status DMG +12%.
[p align="justify"]3-Piece Set
[p align="justify"]Low sanity reduces max HP by up to 60%. The lower your current HP, the higher your Weapon DMG and Status DMG, up to +28% (attained when HP is below 60%).
[p align="justify"]The max HP effect from low sanity is decreased by 40%. Weapon and Status DMG +10% and further increases as your sanity drops, up to +28% (attained at 30% of max sanity).
[p align="justify"]4-Piece Set
[p align="justify"]Generates a Shield equal to 30% of max HP when HP is below 40%. Cooldown: 8s.
[p align="justify"]Generates a Shield equal to 20% of max HP when HP is below 40%. Cooldown: 8s.
[p align="justify"]* The above values are for testing. There may be slight adjustments when implemented in-game.

[p align="justify"]That's the end of our developer update on upcoming balance adjustments. If you have any suggestions or questions, please contact us via the Feedback Platform (Once Human Feedback Platform) or our community channels. Thank you for your understanding and support!
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Below are the details of this update

items.text: Content/Feature Updates
Storage Search Feature Now Available

To make territory logistics management more efficient and convenient, we have added a "Search" feature to storage crates and storage Terminals. Now, simply enter a keyword in the interface to quickly locate the items you need stored in various crates. Say goodbye to the hassle of rummaging through boxes and easily manage your territory supplies![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/00f6c00dde60a4ab051fe00678efa11160abd564.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/b7e4017114d9a83b6ad17b28828bd7302cdeec41.png"]Fashion Dye Feature Fully Upgraded
To allow Metas to express their individuality more conveniently and freely, we have fully optimized and upgraded the fashion dye feature:

1. Clearer Indicators: Now, all fashion items that support custom dye will have a special indicator added to the top-left corner of their icons. It's now easy to see at a glance which cosmetics can be customized!
2. Visualized Status: New indicators have been added to the cosmetics interface and fashion outfit interface when a dye preset is equipped.

3. Batch Management: A quick-access entry for batch managing dye presets for each part has been added under the fashion set tab, allowing you to coordinate your entire outfit's color scheme with one click and say goodbye to tedious operations.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/b683e1a3d7c208366352647cab6fc55fb46aefbc.png"]

4. New "Simple Mode": In the fashion set full body dye mode, we've introduced a brand-new simple mode. Turning off "Expert Mode" activates simple mode, allowing Metas to quickly dye the currently selected part as a whole.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/13723527147f35e65d3eb4ca95378dd25d981b03.png"]\[Image of Enabling Simple Mode]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/9aec19d8b8896dab4ee916d3af5e3de2ba48f22a.png"]\[Image of Enabling Expert Mode]

Tradewind Ace Set, Winter Serenade Set, Ember Reaver Set, Furutaka Demeanor Set, Dino Strike Set, Combat Medic Set, Blazing Speed Set, Heat Storm Set, White Reaper Set, Human Barricade Academy Set, Scarlet Dragon Set, Teddy Warrior Set, Crimson Fantasy Set, Wasteland Sheriff Set, Artiste Set, Punk Puppy Set, Radiant Abyss Set, Brave Gladiator Set, Aerial Set, Nightmyth Graffiti Set, Swiftwing Ranger Set, Golden Years Set, Steel Claw Raid Set, Black Rhinoceros Set.
We will continue to add custom dye support for fashion items in batches. Stay tuned.
6. Added glove section partitioning for sets including Tideborn Dream, Stellar Elite, Midnight Kiss, Gilded Summer, and Stardust Mayfly.
RaidZone Adds Portable Crafting Feature
To make exploration and survival combat in the Wilderness more free and convenient for Metas, we have launched the new \[Portable Crafting] feature.
1. For items that originally required crafting at a campsite, you can now craft them on the spot by simply opening your backpack.
2. The portable crafting entry is located in your backpack, and the operation is exactly the same as crafting at a workbench.
3. The campsite remains, continuing to serve as a temporary respawn point and cooking area, providing Metas with a place to rest.
This feature will also be available in other modes in the future. Please stay tuned.

1. New Server Host Level "Excellent": Server hosts with an average daily engagement score of 200–599 per month will receive the Excellent level. This grants the privilege of a free 30-day server renewal for their current server size!

There's no upper limit on this dedicated incentive pool! The more the custom server ecosystem prospers and the higher your engagement score, the greater your final bonus! Server hosts, go build and promote your exclusive world!

The sign-up lock period has been shortened to 4 hours, giving Metas more time to sign up for preferred scenario servers.
Scenario Honor
To balance the difficulty of Scenario Honor, the following scenario rating metrics have been optimized:
1. \[The Way of Winter] Scenario: The score cap for submitting Chaosium Hearts has been raised to 200.
1) In Faction War, every 50 Prism Energy obtained increases the rating by 25;
2) The score cap for defeating players has been raised to 150.
First Person Mode
Optimized the shadow rendering of characters holding weapons in first person mode.
Wilderness
Parking lot points in the wilderness will now have a higher probability of refreshing with large garage-related facilities.
Vending Machine
Vending machines now support trading facility-type items.
Controller

Added shortcut key support for the territory hub interface on console. After this maintenance update, Metas can use the controller shortcut key "Y" in the territory hub interface to quickly perform territory upgrades.
Others

We have received feedback from some Metas that the cushion interaction hint disappears too quickly, making it hard to know how to exit the cushion. After this update, the cushion interaction hint will remain visible until you leave.
Bug Fixes
Cosmetics
Fixed an issue where self-luminous striplight effects on self-built furniture in territories could fail.
Deviation

1. Fixed an issue where the cooldown calculation for the Deviation "Soul Summoner" Phantom Radiance Sparrow was incorrect. Now, the cooldown for releasing Phantom Radiance Sparrow has been adjusted to 0.5 seconds, significantly increasing the trigger frequency.

2. Normally, each Deviation only provides one of three vulnerability types: "Weapon Vulnerability", "Status Vulnerability", or "Melee Vulnerability". We found that the Whalepup, positioned as a Status DMG Deviation, also contained a Weapon Vulnerability effect. To clarify the combat positioning of each Deviation and ensure the balance and standardization of the wilderness combat system, we have adjusted the Whalepup's vulnerability effect. After this maintenance update, its setting of "applying 15% Weapon Vulnerability to Metas and enemies" will be removed, and its Status Vulnerability value will be slightly increased. Its vulnerability effect will be fixed as follows: All damage dealt by the Whalepup applies 40% Status Vulnerability to the target for 5 seconds.
Territory Construction
Fixed an issue where animals could pass through certain door and door frame structures while moving within a territory.
Vending Machine
Fixed an issue where trait prompts could not be viewed when withdrawing Deviations from the harvest interface.
Others
1. Fixed an issue where key icons displayed incorrectly in the Survival Manual interface.
2. Fixed an issue where crashes could occur during loading on specific mobile device models.
3. Fixed an issue where occasional crashes could occur on specific mobile device models due to weapon vibration resources.
4. Fixed an issue where yellow notification dots appeared abnormally in certain situations.
Dear Metas,

The server maintenance and update is planned for August 24, 2026, at 4:00 PM (PT) and expected to last about 2 hours (actual server opening time may differ). Please manage your time wisely. The update size is approximately 22.38 GB on PC launchers, 119 MB on the PC client (NOTE: If the update is delayed on Steam, it may be downloaded more than once), 677 MB on Android, and 685 MB on iOS (actual size may differ). We recommend downloading the update over Wi-Fi. The next update is scheduled for September 2, 2026, at 4:00 PM (PT). Please keep track of the time, Metas.
The console version will officially launch on August 25 at 11:00 AM (PT). Link your account to sync your data across PC and mobile, making it easiser to play on multiple platforms.

This update brings the Global Heat limited-time event, Achievement Trophy System, comprehensive first person upgrade, fashion set custom dye optimization, the Lightforge Loot Crate "Celestial Anthem", and various new content, along with recent bug fixes.
After this maintenance, all players will receive the following rewards: Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Stardust Secret Crate: S14 (Epic) ×1, and Colorful Badge ×30!

notes.title: Below are the details of this update

items.text: Content/Feature Updates
Global Heat Limited-Time Event Now Live
The Global Heat limited-time event is now open—easily earn multiple rewards:

1. Global Heat: Starts at 11:00 AM (PT) on August 25. Metas across all platforms work together to accumulate Heat Points. Reach progress milestones to claim rewards including Starchrom, Stardust Secret Crate: S14 (Epic), the limited Vehicle Skin "Pyro Dino", and more.

2. Bonus Check-in: Log in and check in daily to claim gifts such as Stardust Secret Crate: S14 (Legendary) and Lightforge Ingot. On the 7th day, an exclusive grand prize awaits—the Epic cosmetic "Azure Glint - Blade".

3. Surprise Egg: Invite friends and stay active to accumulate hatch attempts for the Magic Egg. The Shiny Mod Selection Crate, the Epic cosmetic "Iron Fist Lord", and the Epic cosmetic "Azure Glint - Heavy Weapon" await you.

4. Play with Friends: Gather Friends event has received interface optimizations, with milestone rewards reworked and new redeemable items added to the Shop. Includes generous rewards such as the Epic cosmetics “Crimson Alert” and “Loyal Guardian Headwear”.

5. Returning Rewards: During the event, returning Metas can claim an exclusive gift pack containing a Shop coupon (100 off on purchases over 200), a Legendary Gear Blueprint selection (choose from three powerful weapon sets), and a Deviation Selection Supply Crate—all in one!
Achievement Trophy System is now live! Come unlock your exclusive trophy!

To enrich the adventures of all Metas and record every highlight you achieve in the game, we’ve simultaneously launched 35 challenging and fun new achievement trophies across all platforms in this update. Whether you’re a newcomer or a veteran Meta, you’ll find a challenge of your own on this achievement list!
Supported Platforms: Xbox, PlayStation, Steam, Google Play

Unlock Details: The achievement system will begin recording and synchronizing completion status after this maintenance update. Previously completed historical data will not be automatically loaded and applied.
First-Person Immersion Gets a Full Upgrade

We’ve received a lot of feedback asking for first person mode to support more actions and scenarios. In this maintenance update, the developers have carried out a large-scale expansion and rework of the underlying logic and presentation of the first-person perspective. From exploring the deep sea to gliding at high altitudes, from coordinated combat with Deviations to fierce melee fighting, we bring you an unprecedented ultimate immersive experience!
1. Added Supported Scenarios for First Person Mode
To give Metas a more seamless and immersive experience while exploring Nalcott, we have greatly expanded the states and scenarios supported by first person mode:
1) Land, Sea, and Air Exploration
a) Underwater Experience: You can now dive and explore underwater entirely from a first-person perspective, and all items usable underwater have been adapted with first-person use actions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/486697e4e3edb19b855ff2baa7ebe7465370e6ab.gif"]
b) High-Altitude Glide: Now supports entering and exiting the glide state in first-person throughout, letting you experience the exhilarating rush of a lightning-fast dive!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/139a20061fcaee5cfdc47aa46a389dddecbea375.gif"]
2) Deviations in Combat

After the update, the battle skills of certain Deviations can now be used directly in first-person! This update has implemented most Combat Deviations, including Invincible Sun, Pyro Dino, Polar Jelly, and more (excluding some Deviations with special mechanics, such as Whalepup).

Going forward, we will continue to refine the performance of Deviation ultimates, further highlight the unique traits of each Deviation, and gradually support unleashing ultimates in first-person. Stay tuned!
a) Invincible Sun
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c4269cb6d42c2dfd02171f041fd148bf047a69e2.gif"]
b) Pyro Dino
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/7ff3e8537ac89a1d5accba4e46ed0ae2a0ac08f5.gif"]
c) Polar Jelly
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d83b9ced5a2d9adc3a7761b861a6c1521b8471b0.gif"]
3) Tactical Maneuvers and Interactions

a) "Aero Leap" and "Slide": You can now use "Aero Leap" and "Slide" in first-person at any time, with full support for flexible movement in all 4 directions, making your gunfight positioning even smoother.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ed8eba5d00dd1493da7be78ff06af487602250ee.gif"]
b) Scene Interactions: Full support for first-person interactions such as climbing ladders, using ziplines, and opening doors with card swipes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/73870f46760d21350aaeee4c15704f5935e7c1fe.gif"]
c) Shield Generator: We have specifically updated the first-person use animation for Shield Generators in RaidZone.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e6e9212a3ee1065c8fdb64065bba8b778d348077.gif"]
2. Experience Optimizations
1) Combat and Controls

a) Melee Feel Optimization: We greatly improved the camera bobbing when moving with a melee weapon in first-person mode, and adjusted the transition animations between melee attacks, making every swing feel more impactful.

b) Screen Shake Optimization: Improved the screen shake feedback logic in first-person mode. Screen shake intensity in first-person will now strictly follow the "Screen Shake Intensity" option in the Settings panel.
*Note: Metas who experience 3D motion sickness can lower this option as needed.
2) Wilderness Exploration

Climbing Experience Optimization: We've optimized the trigger timing of climbing actions in first-person mode, reducing stutter and significantly improving the smoothness of parkour and movement in complex terrain.
3) System and Settings

New "First Person Model Offset" setting: This new option has been added to the Settings panel, allowing you to adjust the distance between the weapon model and the screen edge in First Person mode. Whether you're a hardcore shooter Metas who prefers the weapon snug against the edge of your view, or a cosmetics enthusiast who wants to showcase more weapon details, you can now freely customize the optimal position of your weapon model on screen!
Fashion Set Custom Dye Optimization
1. Comprehensive overhaul of the dyeing consumption logic: Dyeing charges will be adjusted from "charging after dyeing individual sections" to "charging after dyeing individual components."

After the update, Metas can freely adjust the dyeing of each section within a component, freely mix and match their preferred color schemes, and are no longer constrained by "separate consumptions for each section." You can freely combine multiple colors on a top, and you can also adjust detail sections at any time.
* The color tier classification remains unchanged; charges will be calculated based on the highest-tier color used in the component, and mixing is supported.

2. Along with the optimization of the charging logic, we have simultaneously lowered the overall pricing for dyeing. After the optimization, the price of a full dye set has dropped by approximately 60% compared to the previous version, making customization more accessible and easier.

3. Currently, only a limited number of sets support dyeing. In the September update (UTC+8), we will gradually release more dyeable sets across more rarities, allowing more of your favorite Fashion items to be dyed in colors that are uniquely yours. Stay tuned!

4. For Metas who have already dyed your items, we fully understand that you have invested time and resources under the previous rules. To protect everyone's existing investment, we will uniformly refund the price difference after the August 24 update (PT). Your existing dye effects will not change—please rest assured.

Due to the differences between the old and new consumption rules, it is difficult to calculate the exact price difference for each set, so we will uniformly refund 60% of the currency consumed. Refunds will be automatically issued via in-game mail within 3 business days after the August 25 update.

For example: Before the August 25 update, Metas A consumed a total of 7200 Crystgins and 2250 Colorful Badges while dyeing. After the August 25 update, at the 60% refund ratio of consumed currency, Metas A will receive a price difference refund of 4320 Crystgins (7200 × 60%) and 1350 Colorful Badges (2250 × 60%).
* If you have any questions regarding the compensation you receive, please contact in-game customer service, and we will verify and handle them for you.
For more information, refer to the dyeing dev blog: Dev Blog丨Fashion Set Custom Dye Optimization
Server Opening Schedule
To make it easier for Metas to play the Prismverse's Clash scenario, we will open 1 Prismverse's Clash Server every Saturday at 8:00 Server Time.
*If the number of sign-ups is too high, we will open additional servers.
After this maintenance update, go to Announcements >>> Once Human Console Launch: Server Opening Announcement and Launch Schedule
Custom Server Updates
1. Added in-game guidance on how to use Server Host privileges, Custom Server events, and the In-Server Shop.
1) Server Hosts can send their location in the chat channel, and other players can click the coordinates to teleport.
2) Delete server members' territories.
3. Added an official website entry to the Server Settings page.
4. Added entries for all Custom Server features to the mobile function menu, making it more convenient for you to enter the Custom Server.
New Items in Shop
Lightforge Loot Crate: Celestial Anthem is now available for a limited time!
"With the sea of stars as the backdrop, the flow of people never ceases. Cloaked in the echoes of the cosmos, sing a long song that spans light-years."
Available: After the maintenance update on August 24 (PT)

The Celestial Anthem Themed Lightforge Loot Crate brings the Legendary Fashion Set "Cosmic Hymn," the Legendary Furniture Formula "Spear Knight," the Epic Hype Mech Skin "Mecha Vanguard - EBR-14," and the Epic Hype Deviation Cosmetic "Light Chaser - ZapCam." Born in this celestial realm, flowing through this universe...
For more details, check the Lightforge Loot Crate announcement: Once Human Lightforge Loot Crate Probability Announcement (August 25)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/9fb3b2fae2c2bd5b9ec75ba3baac2d533ecf1029.png"]
New Battle Pass Final Prayer Arrives!
"The bell tolls over the ruins, and the final prayer will guide the wanderers through the end."
Available: After the maintenance update on August 24 (PT)

A new Battle Pass theme update is here, with a sea of cosmetics for you to obtain! The Battle Pass Advanced edition brings the Epic Fashion Set "Final Prayer," the Epic Weapon Skin "Divine Judgment - ACS12", the Epic Solo Action "Consciousness Stream Creature", and multiple Territory Formulas, Namecards, Avatars, and other themed rewards.
• The upgrade progress bar rewards now include the Rare Deviation cosmetic "Tar Ambusher," unlocked with Battle Pass progress.
• The Advanced version upgrade progress bar adds the Epic Hype Deviation cosmetic "Gluttonous Hot Dog," unlocked with Battle Pass progress.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/b294ab09bf07f36dcdbaede809986540d9150869.png"]
S4 Battle Pass Cosmetic "Frosty Glory" Returns for a Limited Time!
The S4 Battle Pass cosmetic "Frosty Glory" is also returning! Head to the in-game Battle Pass return page to check the acquisition rules and reward details.
\[Amethyst Reaper] Now Available for a Limited Time
A dim purple light cuts through the dark night as the reaper emerges from the shadows.
Release Date: August 24 (PT)

\[Amethyst Reaper] Themed cosmetics are now available for a limited time, including the Legendary Cradle Skin "Fleeting Wings", the Epic Hype Fashion Set "Soul Reaper", and the Epic Hype Weapon Skin "Apostle - M416" among others.
• "Fleeting Wings" Exclusive Special Effect: When a Loot Crate is detected nearby or the pollution value exceeds your resistance, "Fleeting Wings" will display a special effect.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/84c8114c69cae9049c45aaa5297b519355f41cf1.png"]
Lightforge Legacy is now permanently open!
The all-new "Lightforge Legacy" is now permanently open, featuring territory cosmetic rewards. Territory cosmetics released at least one year ago will have a chance to join the Lightforge Legacy.
• Draw records from the Lightforge Legacy and the Limited Prize Pool are not inherited from each other, and guarantee progress is calculated independently.
• Drawing can reward you with the grand prize and multiple territory cosmetic rewards.

• In the Redeem Shop, you can redeem all Lightforge Collection Territory cosmetics for the corresponding period. The prize pool and items will be updated regularly. Please refer to the in-game page for details.
New Star Pack System Adjustment
Available: After the maintenance update on August 24 (PT)
The New Star Pack's selectable content has been streamlined: purchase now to instantly receive 60 Crystgin and choose two bonus rewards, easily embarking on your apocalyptic exploration journey!

• Selection Range Adjustment: The pack's selectable content has been streamlined, removing the 2 candidate rewards with the lowest selection rates. Metas now choose from a curated selection, making the process more focused and decision-making easier.
• Quick Select Pop-up: The Shop will provide new Metas with an exclusive recommendation pop-up that clearly displays the New Star Pack's pick-2-of-4 rewards and the purchase entry.

• Limited-Time Display: The recommendation pop-up will automatically appear only once. New Metas can view it within 2 weeks via the limited-time icon in the top-right corner of the Shop. After the icon disappears, the pack can still be found and purchased on the Shop > Super Value Deal > New Star Pack page.
For more Gift Pack content, optional cosmetics, and purchase rules, please refer to the New Star Gift Pack page in the in-game Shop.
Shop Item Adjustments & Some Cosmetics Removals
To restore a clean, simple experience for the Shop, we will make an overall adjustment to the Shop after the version update on August 24 (PT), including:
1. We will withdraw items with lower purchase frequency to improve browsing and selection efficiency. For details on the withdrawn items, see >>> 商城调整蓝帖

Please note that this removal does not mean these items are permanently gone. They will still be made available again in the future through occasional returns, the Wish Bazaar, and other ways. If any of the items being removed catch your eye, feel free to grab them while you can, and stay tuned for future Shop updates and events.
2. Optimize the Shop's hierarchical structure by removing the original three-level category tabs and replacing them with top category filters.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f4d3617abd925b67a9af1a991518a085df36e77d.png"]

3. A new "Personal Hub" page has been added. After the update, you can click the button on the currency bar in the upper-right corner of the Shop to expand the Personal Hub, where you can view your current currency, coupons, wishlist items, subscribed items, and more in one place.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/9089899d1cdccf30e474709b2b4b12f9c17ba419.png"]
Meta Pass Subscription Now Live!
The Meta Pass subscription feature is rolling out across multiple platforms for your convenience. Enable auto-renewal for the first time and you can claim extra 80 Crystgins as a bonus gift!

• Subscription Channels: Due to differences in payment channels, the auto-subscription feature will first be enabled on selected platforms in this update and will gradually expand to more platforms in subsequent versions. Please stay tuned for future announcements. Whether your channel supports auto-subscription is subject to the actual display in the in-game Meta Pass interface and the corresponding payment channel.

• How to Enable: Go to the in-game Meta Pass interface, check the "Auto-Subscribe" option; select a payment channel that supports this feature to complete the purchase, and confirm the authorization as prompted on the page.

• Auto-Renewal: Once your authorization takes effect, your Meta Pass will be automatically renewed upon expiration according to the rules of the corresponding channel, and you will continue to enjoy Meta Pass benefits. The actual charge time, amount, and rules before and after renewal are subject to the display on the payment channel page.

• First Subscription Reward: The first time you successfully enable the Meta Pass auto-subscription, you will receive extra 80 Crystgins. Repeated subscriptions or subsequent auto-renewals will not grant this reward again.

• Manage Subscription: You can manage your subscription at any time through your payment channel. Canceling the subscription will not affect the benefit days you have already claimed and activated. The steps for managing subscriptions via the payment channel may vary. Generally, you can check and manage your subscription products through the payment channel's Account Settings > Subscriptions. If you have any questions, feel free to contact the payment channel or in-game Customer Service at any time.
Experience Optimizations
Item Balance Adjustments

1. Sparkling Pumpkin Soup will now restore Energy, consistent with the buffeffect of dishes. Generally, only food dishes provide combat stats buffs (except Whimsy Drink and Whimsical Drink). We sincerely apologize for the previous issue where Sparkling Pumpkin Soup incorrectly added a beverage stats buff.
2. Robot Fish now consumes Durability, deducting 10% of its Durability per minute.

Please note: The obtained Robot Fish will be quickly damaged after entering water due to no durability after this update. It is recommended that all Metas disassemble them into materials to avoid losses. We will issue Robot Fish ×3 to all Metas after the version update.
Combat Balance Adjustments
In this update, we will adjust QBJ97 - Fiery Trees and Silver Flowers and the Ghost Link Set to optimize their overall experience.
We have identified the following issues with the recent weapons and gear:
1. The Unstable Bomber and missile trigger chances of QBJ97 - Fiery Trees and Silver Flowers are too low, which affects its performance in short bursts, target switching, and damage output stability.
2. The 3-piece set effect of the Ghost Link Set has relatively demanding trigger conditions.
3. The QBJ97 gun model has excessively high overall recoil.

notes.title: Based on these, the following adjustments will be made

items.text: *For specific effects, please refer to the actual values in the game after launch.
Cosmetics

1. Optimized the corner rendering of Golden Shore Pool: changed the four pool corners from rounded to right angles to improve the issue of possible gaps when connecting with wall corners and the ground.
2. Added a clean preview mode to the cosmetics interface, allowing you to hide the UI to preview and share screenshots.

3. Vehicle Skins - Tidal Hunt, Golden Radiance, Blue Blade, Hellfire Howl, and Lightspeed Era: equipping front bumper guards, rear bumper guards, and outer wheel hub guards will now match the corresponding skins.

1) Adjusted the entry point for the cosmetic preset feature. Open the Cosmetics interface and click "Outfits" to enter the outfit plan preset interface. When saving a preset, an outfit preview card will be displayed.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e76b6d6b2a3262ed6ad9659c37cf8e5f8daeeeb6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c860ff75578cb49af43e43fa8d1cd75967a3897d.png"]
2) Metas can now also save their show/hide settings for cosmetics in presets.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/3d5466a3673199155725faf56d365e6bdbd89efa.png"]
3) Cosmetics presets will now override hairstyle, hairstyle dye, and fashion dye. Newly created appearance presets no longer include hairstyle.
Appearance Sharing
The appearance sharing feature now adds sharing and importing via a text cipher, in addition to the current QR code sharing.
Events
1. Optimized some tasks and rewards in the event "Mayfly's Exploration Guide".
2. The Beginner Growth event will end after the version update on August 24 (PT), and the Redeem Shop will also close at the same time.
3. Optimized the event interfaces for Gather Friends and Accept Invitation to make them easier to read and use. Already linked Metas data will not be affected.
4. The Block Adventure event will end after the version update on August 24 (PT).
Permanent Server
1. Manibus Permanent Server monthly Challenge Task adjustment: Clear The Prime War on Pro difficulty 5 times in total, and earn a rating > 2,000 in a single match.
2. Added task for Permanent Server monthly challenge: Obtain 5,000 Mod Dust in total. Completion grants 100 Mitsuko's Marks.

Please note: This adjustment was released on August 11 (PT): New tasks on all permanent servers, "Obtain a total of 30,000 Starchroms"; the task "Spend a total of 30,000 Starchroms" will close at the 6:00 AM server time reset on September 1, 2026.
Tasks
Optimized the task guidance and story performances in the Manibus and The Way of Winter scenarios, and added expressive animations to Metas' dialogues.
Vehicle (non-RaidZone only)
1. Added a vehicle recovery feature. Metas can now recover vehicles through the "More" interaction on the vehicle, preventing them from being left parked in the wild for a long time.
2. Metas can now share vehicle driving permissions with friends and hive members in Settings.
Controller Controls
1. Classic Hotbar Returns

We've received a lot of feedback from players hoping for the return of the classic hotbar. In this maintenance update, we've brought it back! It now coexists with the wheel control mode, so Metas can choose the control mode they prefer.
Added "Wheel" and "Horizontal Hotbar" as selectable options in the Settings screen.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/db8219a47d4ec1866754877aba8373d234325ff2.png"]
Horizontal Hotbar Mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/7b12416051a585ab8b660e3596e18caaa32559ba.png"]
2. Custom Button Mapping

To give Metas a more comfortable controller experience, we've added the long-awaited controller custom button mapping feature. Each Meta can now define their own button operations according to their habits.
You can go to Settings > Controller > Button Details > Custom Button Settings.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f8709e2dd100cb7e2f059b964caab6328873b378.png"]
Custom Button Modifications
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a92252335477e0db8c749b0db5b545ffab447f3c.png"]
3. Reload and Interaction Button Optimizations
For the long-standing priority issue between "Reload" and "Interact with Target", you can now set in the controller custom button settings whether they use the same button or two separate buttons.
Reload and Interaction on the Same Button
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/86121c5fadefc31eb8a2f8b095d19dd59e966e27.png"]
Reload and Interaction on Separate Buttons
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d98c6b70ca179c149d625a6394141cd64b38210d.png"]
4. Other Controller Optimizations
1) Optimized controller cursor sensitivity, and added a new snap switch setting.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e8ce5b92c9d4aa969fae4710047b83f33f7a7802.png"]
2) The Tab menu can now be navigated continuously by holding.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f2c2508bd9e064b0a0b64416121ffb2363195153.png"]
3) Optimized the deadzone ranges of the controller's L/R sticks and triggers for more precise input.
4) Optimized the interaction range of the controller's universal interaction.
Bug Fixes
Cosmetics
1. Fixed an issue where the Fallen Abyss Set's female skin paint displayed incorrectly.
2. Fixed an issue where the female footed tights of the Radiant Serenade set would occasionally display incorrectly.
3. Fixed an issue where Metas could not pass through Gate: Spring's Lattice properly sometimes.
4. Fixed an issue where the third-person camera would occasionally be offset after a character woke up.
Build
Fixed an issue where the “Lightning Rod” facility would occasionally experience abnormal collisions after being placed in the “Endless Dream” scenario.
Online Trading
Fixed an issue where Chaos Mutagen could not be listed for sale in Vending Machines or Online Trading.
Controller Handling
1. Fixed an issue where some button display texts were not synchronized after remapping buttons.
2. Fixed an issue where the Settings interface displayed incorrectly in some cases during controller handling.
3. Fixed an issue where conflicts could occur after modifying special buttons in some custom controller mappings.
4. Fixed an issue where the display was abnormal when operating the wheel with the stick.
Once Human Development Team

The server maintenance and update is planned for August 5, 2026, at 4:00 PM (PT) and expected to last about 2 hours (actual server opening time may differ). Please manage your time wisely. The update size is approximately 15.55 GB on PC launchers, 143 MB on the PC client (NOTE: If the update is delayed on Steam, it may be downloaded more than once), 1.2 GB on Android, and 1.2 GB on iOS (actual size may differ). We recommend downloading the update over Wi-Fi. The next update is scheduled for August 24, 2026, at 4:00 PM (PT). Please keep track of the time, Metas.

This update will bring the following: Limited-time themed event “Block Adventure”, new monthly challenges and mod acquisition methods for the permanent server, online trading updates and optimizations, Lightforge Loot Crate "Dreamtide" , refined feature "Set personal loading screen", custom server territory settings optimization and exclusive building features, various other content, and recent bug fixes.
After this maintenance, all players will receive the following rewards: Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Stardust Secret Crate: S13 (Epic) ×1, and Blind Box - Block General Store ×1.
Period: August 5 – August 23 (PT)

1. Block Adventure: The event starts every half hour. Metas can enter Wish Island and defeat block-ified animals to accumulate progress. Once progress is complete, you can challenge the boss, "Block Wanderer." Upon victory, you have a chance to obtain a random Morphed Deviation (one of the following: Zapamander - Pink Block, Nutcracker - Dark Block, or Dr. Teddy - Guardian Block), Armor Mod Crates, Mod Dust, and other generous rewards! Each Meta can claim boss rewards 3 times per day, with a maximum of 12 claims.

2. Bonus Sign-In: Check in daily during the event to collect block-themed gifts such as the Blind Box - Block General Store, a Block Deviation Selection Gift Pack, and the Weapon Charm "Block Imp" and more.
The doors to the Block World have opened—Metas, come join in!

notes.title: Permanent Server: New Monthly Challenge and Mod Acquisition Methods

items.text: 1. Added the Monthly Challenge to Scenario Challenge. Complete Challenge Tasks to claim rewards such as Mitsuko's Mark.

notes.title: Link your account in advance and enjoy seamless cross-platform play as soon as the console version goes live!

items.text: Once Human's console version officially launches on August 25, 10:00 (PT)! Complete your account linking now, and you can sign in directly on launch day, perfectly synchronizing your existing characters and data.
1. Cross-Platform Sync: Once linked successfully, your game progress will be fully synchronized across PC, mobile, and console.

*Special Note: If, during linking, you find that both pre-linked platform accounts have characters, you can only choose one account to overwrite and link. All characters on the overwritten account will be discarded. If you wish to keep characters from both accounts, please switch to or create a new account before proceeding. Be very careful before making your choice!
2. Order of Operations: It is recommended that you complete the linking before your first sign-in to the official console version.
1) Sign in to the PC or mobile version of the game where you currently have characters.
2) PC: Go to Settings interface -> Account -> Link Account.
Mobile: Go to Settings Interface -> Bottom of the interface -> Link Account.
3) Follow the instructions to complete the account linking, and confirm the linking successful prompt.
If you encounter any issues during linking, Metas can contact official customer service or submit feedback on the feedback platform at any time. See you on console!

notes.title: Below are the details of this update

items.text: Content/Feature Updates
New Snap Point Switching Feature for Territory Construction

To help Metas build their territories with greater ease, we’ve added a snap point switching feature in build mode for wall surfaces, ceilings, roofs, stairs, and pillars. Now, while building, Metas can flexibly switch between different snap points on PC using the shortcut key (Shift + mouse wheel) or on mobile by clicking the button (switch snap point), making it easy to achieve more precise building connections!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/39e3755e2ed2dc6b71e10ef1fc072344d072e10a.gif"]
Appearance Preset Data Sharing

To let Metas more conveniently showcase their unique style across different scenarios and characters, we’ve fully upgraded the save mechanism of the character customization system and officially launched the account-wide appearance preset sharing feature!

1. Cross-Character Sharing: Character customization data now supports account-level sharing. Whether a newly created character entering a new scenario or an existing character continuing to explore, you can directly load and use the shared appearance presets.

2. Auto-Merge and Activation: After this update, each existing character under the same account will have their previously saved appearance presets automatically added to the shared list upon first log-in. (Note: Presets of characters that have not logged in will be temporarily archived. Simply log in to the corresponding character to automatically activate and merge them.)
1) Under the same gender, the common save limit for sharing appearance presets is 12.
2) Rest assured that presets added via the above-mentioned "character first log-in auto-merge" method are allowed to temporarily exceed the save limit of 12, and will not cause data loss.

3) When the total number of your sharing presets exceeds 12, you can still use, edit, or delete existing presets normally, but you cannot actively add new presets until the total number drops to 12 or below.
“Item Lock” Feature Officially Launched — Say goodbye to accidental actions, protect your precious supplies!
Dear Metas, the brand new “Item Lock” feature is now live! From now on, no need to worry about precious supplies being accidentally discarded, sold, or disassembled!
1. Metas can actively lock any lockable item. Once locked, the item will be fully protected: prevent accidental discard, accidental trade, and bulk disassembly.

*Note: Locking is based on item type. When you lock one item, all items with the same name that you own will be protected. Any future items of the same name will automatically inherit the locked status, making it a one-time setup. Lock/Unlock takes effect instantly, and an icon will appear at the top-left corner of the item icon, easy to identify.
2. What Can You Do After Locking?

RaidZone Updates
RaidZone New Gamplay "Mental Pollution" Launches!

1. Some regions will Deviate into "Mental Pollution Zones". Currently, pollution zones are divided into 2 levels. The higher the pollution level of a region, the more severe the mental pollution you will suffer. Please make adequate preparations before exploring deeper.
2. The original "Sanity" will be replaced with "Mentality". When in a pollution zone, Mentality will continuously decrease, and HP will also be lost!
After leaving the pollution zone, Mentality will grdually recover. You can also counter mental pollution by sleeping at the camp, increasing pollution resistance, or consuming mental recovery dishes.
3. To counter the harsh environment, all gear in the RaidZone will have a new "Mental Resistance" stat.

When the total mental resist of all gear equipped by a Meta is lower than the minimum mental pollution value of the current pollution zone, mentality will begin to deplete. The larger the difference, the faster the mentality depletes.

4. Added 4 survival gear: Anti-pollution Mask, Deep Isolation Set, Gas-tight Helmet, and Mental Shielding Suit. These gear provide better mental resistance but are relatively weaker in defense. This will test the tactical decisions of every Meta!
RaidZone Farming and Breeding Gameplay Upgraded

1. During plant growth, maintaining optimal light and optimal irrigation may grant additional base yield, and there is a higher probability to harvest rare Deviated Plants, or even directly obtain RaidZone exclusive material!

2. During livestock breeding, feeding preferred food will trigger surprising rewards with an extremely high probability, including double yield, higher quality milk and eggs, and a chance to obtain a combat goodie (containing gear, ammo, tactical items, tools, etc.).
2. This Update will default unlock 10 new special food formulas in the RaidZone, including Hearty Pumpkin Meat Soup, Star Sprinter Drink, etc.
1) Crafting Ingredients: Mainly rely on rare/deviated plants obtained from farming, and high-quality animal byproducts obtained from breeding.
2) After consumption, it provides effects: significantly increased ore gathering efficiency, increased plant acquisition efficiency, max stamina boost, increased sulfur gathering efficiency, etc.
3. While exploring the wilderness, there is a chance to find a rare item, the "Gardening Gloves." When equipped, plant gathering will always yield Deviated plants!
4. Merchants have updated their buyback lists, now accepting special food and animal and plant products. Metas can sell these to merchants in exchange for a large number of RaidZone Chips.

*Since Meteor Fragments serve as consumables for the Meteor Summoner in RaidZone, the merchant's selling and buyback of Meteor Fragments disrupts the game loop logic. After this update, the sale and buyback of Meteor Fragments will be removed.
RaidZone New Rare Item: Telescope

Added a new rare item, the Telescope, which is a powerful reconnaissance tool for spotting enemies before you obtain a high-magnification scope. Metas can use the telescope to observe distant enemies.
How to Obtain: Chance to obtain through wilderness exploration.
RaidZone Deviation Balance Adjustments

1. ZapCam: Increased the duration and scan range of high-speed capture, providing a longer-lasting and wider field of view when detecting and targeting enemies. As a balance, the cooldown has been extended accordingly, requiring more careful timing of its use.
Duration: 1.5s → 6.0s; Scan Width: 25m → 30m; Cooldown: 30s → 40s.
2. Mini Wonder: We found that its control uptime in combat was too high. To ensure a healthy combat experience, we have reduced its duration and slightly increased its Cooldown.
Cooldown: 30s → 35s; Duration: 9s → 6s.

3. Pyro Dino: Its suppression ability is currently too strong. To allow opponents reasonable room to dodge and counter, we have comprehensively reduced the flight efficiency of explosive fireballs, fire field residual time, and mind control duration.
Fire Field Burn Time: 13s → 5s; Flight Speed: 35m/s → 20m/s; Flight Lifespan: 5s → 3s; Mind Control Fire Dragon Duration: 30s → 20s.
Custom Server Updates
This update brings overall visual and functional upgrades to the Custom Server, making exploration clearer for Metas and display more effective for Server Hosts.
Custom Server Full Page Revamp
1. Three Core Areas of the Homepage

Homepage Recommendations: Divided into two sections: recommended quality servers and newly created quality servers. The new algorithm provides precise server recommendations, helping server hosts gain more exposure.
Modes: Accommodates all Custom Servers, supporting full search and browse.
My Servers: Centrally manage your characters across various Custom Servers, with clear cross-server switching and progress.
2. Exclusive Display Benefits for Server Hosts
Custom Cover Upload: Upload exquisite images to showcase the unique charm of your server.
Exclusive Gameplay Tags: Add category tags to your server to help Metas quickly understand rules of the modes and join the world.

3. The in-server Community Creation Program page has been fully revamped, supporting one-stop viewing of in-server data, revenue sharing and withdrawal, and server host events. The server host dashboard now presents data, level benefits, and official contact information more clearly, with a quick link to the official website's custom server main page for browsing various information.
Custom Servers Dungeon Custom Settings and Items

The gameplay mode plugin adds custom dungeons: You can edit the name, enemy difficulty, additional skills, Item drops, and access methods of existing dungeons in scenarios. Combined with custom weapons, this creates differentiated challenge and drop experiences.
New Armor: Ghost Link Hat/Vest/Pants/Shoes/Gloves/Mask, Wind Interpreter Cap, Ankh Mask.
New Custom Weapons and Armor: Ghost Link series, Wind Interpreter Cap, Ankh Mask, QBJ97, QBJ97 - Fiery Trees and Silver Flowers, SN700 - Finale.
Custom Server Benefit Event Begins
1. Experience Benefits: Challenge Gifts

During the event (Server Time: July 23 - August 20), search for "Custom Dungeon" tag on the Custom Server homepage to enter the corresponding Custom Server. Complete the two tasks: "Enter Custom Dungeons in 3 different Custom Servers" and "Complete any 1 Custom Dungeon from start to finish" Then go to the Custom Server - Event Center to check progress and claim Stardust Secret Crate S13 (Epic) ×1 and Battle Pass Exp Card ×1.
2. Server Host Incentive "Custom Server Call to Arms"

During the event (Server Time: July 23 - August 5), go to Custom Server > Community Creation Program > Event tab to participate. Based on the total log-in days of new and returning Metas within 14 days after their introduction during the event period, Worldcoin will be distributed. For details, check the in-event announcement.
Custom Server Hyper Brawl Gameplay Optimization
1. Added the ability to change the center coordinates of each stage.
2. You can use the World Map to preview the gameplay areas of each stage.
New Items in Shop
Summer Return of Lightforge Loot Crate: "Summer Wave" is Now Open! (Available after maintenance update)

Five crates: Golden Surge, Frostshade, Phaze Blitz, Astral Nexus, and Dream Waltz are returning. You can choose up to three to participate in. The original draw probabilities, redemption prices, and guarantee mechanism remain unchanged, and historical draw progress is inherited.

Keep Earning T-Crystgin!
The Limited-time Crystgin Rebate Event in the Shop is still ongoing—buy more to earn more rebates and keep the luck flowing!

Plus, four tiers of Lightforge Ingot Gift Packs are available for a limited time, starting as low as 60 Crystgin. Purchase them to receive a limited-return Lucky Bag, which can yield up to 6,666 Limited-time Crystgin! Head to Shop - Super Value Deal - Lightforge Benefits Tab to browse!

Button Adjustments
To resolve the key binding conflict between fetching water near the seaside and summoning vehicles, the shortcut key for fetching water has been changed to H.

2. Added more diverse interaction poses for chair and sofa-type furniture.
Weapon Balance Adjustments

Since the launch of SN700 - Finale, its extreme single-target explosive Hit DMG has attracted attention and affection from Metas. However, we have also observed its negative impact on certain gamepkay, especially in multiplayer Alpha battles, where excessively high burst DMG within a short time may lead to the Alpha being quickly killed, affecting some Metas experience to participate normally in combat and obtain rewards.
To maintain relative balance among weapons and enhance the multiplayer game experience, we will adjust the SN700 Finale as follows:
1. The maximum stacks of "Reverb" have been reduced from 5 to 4.
2. Each stack of "Reverb" now increases the DMG of the last bullet from 4% to 5%.
