notes.title: The Second Anniversary Celebration "Dreamy Maelstrom" Grand Opening

items.text: The dream begins, two years together. In the blink of an eye, Once Human has accompanied all Metas through its second year. Thank you for your support, feedback, and companionship along the way, and thank you to every one of you still adventuring in the world of Nalcott.

On this second anniversary, the commemorative celebration "Dreamy Maelstrom" is about to begin! We have prepared a wealth of content including a new gameplay, limited-time Deviations, anniversary check-in, surprise draws, returner and newcomer gifts, and more. May this dream bring all Metas a journey that is lively, bountiful, and truly unforgettable.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/8ba5b865c93cbe7f7164dceef164c36324342249.png"]
Event Duration: Starts after the July 9 (PT) update and continues until July 30 server time.

The Rift Space tears through the sky, monstrous tides surge forth—a brand new anniversary special gameplay begins! Metas can select enhancement abilities with each wave to gain overclock power and face hordes of enemies. Clearing waves rewards Armor Mod Crates, Anniversary Draw Tickets, Starchrom, Mod Dust, and more. Reach the top of the cross-server leaderboard for exclusive honors to contest!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e20ebe6244fa62c7acff8f5927c6be04f6f98719.jpg"]
Three Deviations arrive with the dream—the anniversary limited "Crimson Insight: ZapCam", the RaidZone expert "Mr. Wish - Penguin Hope", and the new rideable member "Behemoth".
\[Anniversary Limited] Crimson Insight: ZapCam

The limited-time Morphed ZapCam for the 2nd anniversary is here! The familiar little guy dons a brand new crimson cosmetic, with its reliable strength intact and an even more dazzling appearance. During the anniversary, Metas can bring it home through events like the Dreamy Rift and Rift Eggs.
\[RaidZone Expert] Mr. Wish - Penguin Hope

A mysterious visitor from the Mr. Wish family has also come to join the anniversary! Originally a little penguin adopted by Once Human in the real world dimension, it is a "demolition expert" from the polar regions. Due to the appearance of the Rift Space, Penguin Hope unexpectedly crossed dimensions and arrived in Nalcott, morphing into a peculiar form and gaining unique abilities! Metas can secure it through anniversary events and the RaidZone mode, embarking on a new journey together!
\[New Member] Behemoth
\[New Member] Behemoth
"Beneath a body built of cardboard and crayons beats the heart of a battle beast that never retreats."

The brand-new rideable Combat Deviation "Behemoth" is about to make a dazzling debut in this anniversary! As a battle vanguard, Behemoth can fight autonomously, and Metas can also ride it directly, actively unleashing a breath skill to turn all enemies before it into ashes! Metas can obtain it through anniversary events and wilderness gameplay.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/fdbd324f77f56e2e52fdd3558afc73edfc60298b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d002f287b390af06544777360132e92af5bcdf2f.jpg"]

During the event, Metas only need to log in daily and complete the check-in to receive the brand-new legendary blueprint "QBJ97 - Fiery Trees and Silver Flowers" featuring high-frequency triggering of the Unstable Bomber + extra missiles to help you instantly eliminate Deviants! Additionally, there are anniversary-exclusive rewards like Lightforge Ingots, the furniture formula "Pounding Heart Neon," Mr. Wish - Penguin Hope, and more! Just a tap each day, surprises accumulate, effortlessly bringing home this second-anniversary sentiment.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/bad8ff9c3a9e879dbe75382749274239bda09de4.png"]

During the event, Metas can earn tuning attempts through daily active gameplay and one-time challenge tasks. By "tuning" between channels to collect signals and fill the progress bar, reaching a full 180 points allows you to claim the grand prize! Each signal crate reliably produces Starchrom and Stardust Secret Crate - S13 (Rare); after reaching specified total progress nodes, you can also claim the anniversary set "Heartlit Rain Set", the avatar frame "A Birthday," Shiny Mods, and other gifts.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/0c78f1f3959d64ce820c80358f870050ac614b2b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/339f6ef19c0d8b9b51aff9f42c07165ab6499889.jpg"]

During the event, don't forget to invite both old friends and new companions back to the continent of Nalcott to join the grand celebration. Once the event begins, each Meta will receive 3 "Rift Eggs." By completing friend invitations and staying active together, you can accumulate hatch progress for the eggs, gradually hatching anniversary surprises one by one.

Gather friends and maintain daily active to accumulate hatch attempts for the egg, hatching them one by one to reveal surprises like the "Phantom Thief Bow" Skin, Deviation Selection Boxes, Shiny Mods, and more.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/dadc9248e38a5de34a0ec5adbbb515a23023f2b2.jpg"]

Earn draw tickets in the Dreamy Rift and RaidZone tasks to spin the wheel. Every 15 spins guarantees a cosmetic reward—including the themed Furniture "Rosetta Protocol", the Vehicle Skin "Trendy," and the Weapon Skin "Stacked Realm" series (KAM/TEC9/MPS7) await your draw.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e3f3c2595dfb226e2d6e7585008956ddb2c59225.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/9695d31d5e0aa9bdfffd343b8d0c82257f60b675.png"]

Head to the campaign island daily at server time 10:00-12:00 and 19:00-23:00 to join the collective dance. Light up the entire venue's heat to claim random gifts like a Deviation, a Legendary Food Gift Pack, a Stardust Secret Crate, and other exquisite rewards.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a9ddd5017bb86b7bd821d783163f377f1a70cd74.jpg"]

On July 10th, server time 20:00-22:00, several online lucky players will be randomly selected every 15 minutes to receive Lightforge Ingot ×10. The winning results will be displayed in the server-wide marquee announcement, letting all Metas witness this good fortune together. Remember to be online on time—perhaps the next lucky one to be blessed by the entire server will be you!

Metas, also keep an eye out for the mysterious anniversary passcode announced on official social media. Enter it in the chat channel to claim a Stardust Secret Crate - S13 (Epic), Starchrom ×1000, and a random level Mr. Wish- Penguin Hope. Let the whole server celebrate and share the luck!

The Anniversary isn't just for the Metas who have been journeying together all along; it also welcomes every old friend returning after a long absence and every new companion just setting foot on Nalcott. During the event, we will prepare exclusive reunion gifts for returning and newly arrived Metas, helping everyone join this 2nd anniversary celebration more easily. This is undoubtedly the best time to embark on your Once Human journey—don't miss it!

The anniversary-limited "Reunion Gift" will grant a corresponding amount of Starchrom based on the duration of absence, along with special rewards: a self-select legendary gear blueprint (choose from 3 powerful weapon sets), a Deviation selection box, and Nalcott pioneer supply.

We have also prepared a starter pack for Metas visiting Nalcott for the first time: a self-select legendary gear blueprint (choose from 3 sets), a Deviation selection box, and Nalcott pioneer supply. Gear, companions, and supplies are all arranged to help you quickly enjoy the adventure.

The 2nd Anniversary Celebration is about to begin. The lights of the dream have been lit, and the lively stage is set. We thank every Meta for your companionship, feedback, and support along the way. Next, let us meet again in \[Dreamy Maelstrom] and embark together on a lively, bountiful, and unforgettable dream journey!
Check the Dev Blog for more Anniversary Game Mode content>>>[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/693139048964820186"]

notes.title: First Person Mode is Now Live

items.text: Applies to: Once Human, RaidZone

Ready to see the perilous lands of Nalcott from a whole new perspective? In this update, we're officially launching the highly anticipated First Person Mode! Metas will see through their own eyes, grip their firearms, wield melee weapons, explore for supplies, and use items, experiencing the immersive sense of presence and ultimate immersion that leaps off the screen.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/97de6d274fb7a0a768221b7e3df999df7b184c7e.png"]
In First Person Mode, the following core actions are now supported with an always-on first-person camera:
1. Basic movement, jumping, and climbing;
2. Weapon operation and use, Melee Attacks, and various throws;
3. Use of items such as Medicine and Food;
4. Resource gathering and collecting supplies in the wilderness with bare hands, Pickaxe, or Electric Chainsaw/Electric Drill.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4a156112d58c2add7d55b0ccb1b89def77b63f46.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/5564dae211a283e19a163f6c79043060024db6a1.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/fa9679de46f6ff0329c0f0d4ccb7cbe3d489a2b1.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/9b2aad90d934c21b579853131f12689ffca5778e.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/846cb2d6388b86613b7ddffa6e6811264563e326.gif"]Melee attack
To ensure a thrilling combat experience even with the restricted first-person perspective, we have completely redesigned the first-person operation and slashing actions for all usable melee weapons:
1. Mobile Combat: All melee weapons support slashing while moving, allowing for more flexible positioning!
2. New actions: Based on various weapon traits, brand new first-person attack animations have been crafted.

3. Light and Heavy Attack Adjustments: Light attacks retain the original experience of consecutive multi-hit combos; Heavy strikes are now adjusted to charge by holding the button and releasing to unleash the attack, with the impact feeling fully upgraded!
*Note: If you prefer the original third-person melee experience, all operations remain unchanged in third person mode, so rest assured.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d9995888f363cd8f7e98b9d4349a76eb1307dd8c.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/974bf84abd8b3263a96553c79eb9ed998a8f28ed.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/24bfa761653b1962777629f004de899ad47bbd3e.gif"]Weapon Inspection
The inspect animations for weapons and melee weapons in first-person have been completely revamped and now support inspecting while moving, allowing you to admire your favorite gun anytime, anywhere!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e3b8c7a542708c83f798fc17bcad76835f9e5adc.gif"]
Driving Vehicles

When entering a vehicle for the first time in First Person Mode, the default camera will automatically adapt to first-person. Simultaneously, the system intelligently remembers the camera option you used before exiting the vehicle and will automatically recover that camera the next time you get in, eliminating the hassle of frequent switching.
IV. Mode Switching Methods
To let metas play more smoothly between different perspectives, we have conducted a comprehensive experience optimization for camera switching and transitions:
1. Basic Setting \[PC / Mobile]

You can modify the default camera in the settings interface. Additionally, new settings for first-person camera view and model distance from the camera have been added, allowing Metas to customize according to their preferences.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/611cc2ad66eb54f8f6dcb1358dc950bd7ea396d5.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c5a9881de03b076a7da4e0577547f894c63eb804.png"]
2. Quick Switch \[PC/Mobile]
PC: Added the shortcut key combination Alt+C, enabling one-key seamless switching between first-person and third-person during exploration.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/97b5899fca60d2929d706eb93078430afcf3c565.png"]
Mobile: Added a switch camera button in the custom layout settings.
*Note: This button is hidden by default. Metas need to go to the settings and drag it into the interface layout to use it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ca4181622a0c347014493bf052452efac7d0af30.png"]
PC: The Function Wheel has added a switch camera function, allowing quick switching between third-person and first-person via the wheel.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/264d3ce89ebc7cb312c9c3c5e0ee7a829971b9dc.png"]
4. Special Scenario Notes

Currently, in certain special scenarios (e.g., some story cutscenes, specific Deviation skill activations, expressions, and interaction actions), to ensure the integrity of the presentation, the camera and character actions will temporarily and automatically switch back to third-person. Once this state ends, the system will smoothly transition and automatically switch back to first-person for you.

*If you encounter a scene in the game where you feel "it shouldn't have switched back to third-person here, it ruins the immersion", please provide feedback to us via Customer Service or the Feedback Platform. We will continuously monitor feedback to optimize the switching experience!
Plans

Refinement of the first-person perspective is also ongoing. The following scenarios currently do not have first-person implementation and are expected to be gradually added in the September version. Thank you for your patience:
Glide, underwater exploration, climbing ladder and zipline interactions, Deviation skill activation animations, and some other special status effects.

*Metas playing on mobile, please note: To ensure normal use of the First Person Mode, you must first go to the App Store to download and install the latest version client (some channels may be delayed due to review processes).
For more details, please check [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/693139048964820962"]

notes.title: New Armor Shiny Mod & New Way to Obtain

items.text: After this Maintenance Update, we will launch Armor Shiny Mods. As the pinnacle pursuit of the Mod system, Shiny Mods feature unique pins and display effects, serving as important out-of-match evolve and collection display assets for all Metas. Currently, Shiny Mods primarily rely on a probabilistic transformation when obtaining duplicate Lv 17 Mods, making the overall process highly random. After this Maintenance Update, Metas will be able to obtain corresponding Mod and Shiny Mod rewards through clear challenge objectives and collection progress. We aim to preserve the rare display value of Shiny Mods while providing Metas who wish to pursue them long-term with clearer objectives and a more stable direction for their efforts.
This Optimization for Shiny Mods mainly includes two obtainment paths: rewards from Scenario Honor - Scenario Rating, and rewards from Mod Collection Progress.
1. New Method to Obtain Mods via Scenario Honor Rating
Metas can obtain Mod rewards in Scenario Honor - Scenario Rating. Upon reaching the corresponding rating requirements for each scenario, the corresponding rewards become claimable.
1) Shiny Mod rewards are account-level and shared by all characters;
2) As long as the current rating meets the corresponding requirements, rewards can be claimed immediately; there is no need to wait until the Scenario Honor Rank Settlement.
3) Scenario rating mod rewards can only be claimed once within 30 days. Each reward has an independent cooldown timer; after claiming, it will immediately enter a cooldown reset countdown.

*Please note: If you did not sign up for a new scenario flow before this update, and your current rating meets the reward requirements after this update, you can immediately claim the scenario rating mod rewards.
To balance the experience of obtaining scenario ratings across different scenarios, the rating metrics for scenario honor have been adjusted as follows:
1. In the Prismverse's Clash scenario honor, the rating cap for defeating players is adjusted to 105 points.

2. In the Evolution's Call scenario honor, winning a stronghold conquest with a single score exceeding 30,000 will increase the individual rating by 20 points; the rating cap for defeating players in stronghold conquest is adjusted to 210 points.
II. New "Collection Progress" Mod Rewards

To make the stage progress clearer during the Mod evolving process, we will add new "collection progress" mod rewards. Metas can claim corresponding one-time rewards based on the mod collection progress for different weapon builds and armor parts:
1) The collection progress in the mod interface has been optimized into aclickable button. Clicking it will display the complete collection progress requirements and reward overview.
2) The collection progress will be split into multiple tabs based on "Weapon build" and "Armor part", each displaying the corresponding progress requirements.
3) For each tier of collection progress reached, you can claim a one-time reward, which will not reset.
Additionally, we have corrected the issue of ambiguous text semantics in the mod function guide.
Original: When you have already obtained a Lv. 17 Mod, obtaining the same Lv. 17 Mod again has a certain chance of transforming it into a Shiny Mod. Shiny Mods cannot be obtained repeatedly.

Modified: When you have already obtained a Lv. 17 Mod, obtaining the same Lv. 17 Mod again has a certain chance of transforming it into a Shiny Mod. You will not receive two identical Shiny Mods. Obtaining the same Shiny Mod again will cause it to be decomposed into Mod Dust.

Developer Notes: In the current Mod system, only the highest level Mod of each type is displayed. Obtaining duplicate Mods of the same Level or lower-level Mods will directly decompose them into Mod Dust. This is the general rule of the Mod system. In the previous description, our intention was to emphasize that Shiny Mods also follow this rule, but there was an issue with unclear semantic description, which caused confusion among the Metas. In this version, we have provided a more precise Text description rather than making a deliberate hidden change. Thank you for your understanding and support. In the future, we will also open more channels for obtaining Shiny Mods to meet everyone's collection/character growing needs.
For more details, please visit the Dev Blog >>> [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/670620415866966678"]

notes.title: New enemies: Acting Physician & Lady Sea Nettle - Danger Approaches!

items.text: *Only for non-RaidZone Mode

Recently, the ecology of Nalcott has undergone new changes once again. In the abandoned medical facilities of the workshop area, there have been sightings of what appears to be unattended physician garments moving autonomously. Additionally, in shallow water areas, a new type of Deviant that relies on "water" for movement has emerged.

Frontline investigations have confirmed that these two types of anomalous Entities have been named: Acting Physician and Lady Sea Nettle. They possess distinctly different methods of disguise, behavioral logic, and combat mechanics. Metas, please remain highly vigilant!
Acting Physician

"Health and safety alert: At medical facilities within various strongholds on Nalcott, signs of autonomous activity have been detected in some discarded blue medical coats. Any unattended medical garments with a faint blue radiance inside are potential high risk entities."

Recently, Metas have frequently encountered an anomalous entity disguised as an unattended physician's garment in environments such as hospitals, medical rooms, and operating rooms within strongholds in the workshop area—the "Acting Physician". Based on preliminary tracking, the following known intelligence is now disclosed to all Metas:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/520552d28291cd8fce594d6a3ff84fa6f9319f0b.png"]
Appearance

Disguised state: In its disguised state, the Acting Physician resembles a surgical coat or patient coat spread on the ground, with occasional, extremely faint static sparks appearing at its edges. When a Meta approaches, a piercing blue light will illuminate the inside of the coat, accompanied by orb lightning rapidly inflating the coat to reveal its full form.

Exposed state: After entering its exposed state, a blue-glowing computer terminal becomes visible on its chest and abdomen area. Its head is equipped with a medical headlamp, and four mechanical tentacles extend from the lower hem of its coat, with sparks and electric currents continuously erupting from their tips. Rather than a "physician," it resembles a set of surgical equipment driven by Deviant power.
Behavior

The Acting Physician exhibits an abnormal, obsessive research interest in the "gastric health" of Metas. It seems to be attempting to understand the relationship between human starving, energy, and physical status. However, its method of expressing this "academic passion" is to directly seize nearby targets and conduct surgical research!

The Acting Physician's feet feature a suction cup structure, letting it occasionally adhere to walls or ceilings. If a target gets too close, it will attempt to grab and forcibly drag them into the "surgery" process! A caught Meta can break free from control by timely QTE struggles.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c5b6e2df737d37fab876cc356e0d4c6a0b517aff.png"]
Combat Mechanics
Core Mechanics - Terminal Weakspot
The terminal is its true form! Destroy the computer terminal when it's exposed. Otherwise, it cannot be completely defeated!

When fighting the Acting Physician, the most important objective is not its housing, but its computer terminal. The terminal is only exposed during the casting of certain skills. If the terminal is not destroyed in time, the Acting Physician will trigger a recover when its HP is low. After the terminal is destroyed, the Acting Physician loses its recover ability and grabbing ability, and can be killed normally.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/78b97d2e3077cb3669828f5ec7fb5671053df135.png"]
Energy
The Acting Physician's attacks will prioritize stealing the target's energy upon hit. If successful, it will recover its own HP; if the target's energy is 0, it will deal massive DMG.

Metas, please ensure you have sufficient supply before combat and pay attention to energy changes during the fight. Simple advice: when facing the Acting Physician, being filled up is always a good idea.
New enemy: Lady Sea Nettle
"The water sac is the true form. That beautiful woman is merely a shell it controls." — Frontline researcher's notes

The erosion of Stardust upon the Nalcott never ceases. As this power further seeps into aquatic ecosystems, a new Deviant form has emerged in shallow water area. It lurks in shallow water areas, appearing elegant and harmless in form, yet constantly seeks water to absorb.
Appearance

Lady Sea Nettle's shell has a near-human silhouette, with a graceful figure and a dark, flowing gown trailing on the ground, moving with light and elegant steps. Her entire head is completely enveloped by a transparent sea nettle jellyfish. At the center there is a core that continuously emits an eerie blue light, pulsing slowly deep within the water sac like a cold, icy heart.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/5d4710b1e747d4b830218f84f021d5f5c08ab313.png"]
Behavior

Her head is a special water-storage structure. All her actions are driven by "water." The fuller her water sac, the more active and aggressive she becomes. When her water level drops, her condition noticeably deteriorates, as if she were a living engine fueled by water.

Lady Sea Nettle obtains water from all available sources—rivers, rainwater, and unfortunate prey that venture too close. Upon discovering prey, she will prioritize draining the target's hydration. When the target's hydration is insufficient, she will then proceed to drain their HP.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/8e3ae0fe9343e85649d508f7cefa698b34ee2c63.gif"]
Combat Mechanics
The Combat with Lady Sea Nettle is, in essence, a battle of offense and defense centered around "water".

During combat, be mindful of avoiding her tentacles. Lady Sea Nettle uses water mist sprayed from her tentacles to restrict the target's movement, then stabs her tentacles into the target's body to begin siphoning moisture. The danger increases with each second of being drained. However, maintaining sufficient hydration can provide more room for error in combat. She prioritizes draining hydration. If you maintain good hydration, even if caught, you will have more opportunity to break free and counterattack.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/3a21c239f2132e5538bb3bd11c64f977629c692b.gif"]

At the same time, closely observe the state of the water sac in her head. When full, the sac is plump and swollen, protecting the internal core. When the water is depleted or the head sac is damaged, the sac rapidly shrivels, and the blue core is exposed, like a deflated plastic bag clinging to the surface of the blue core—this is her most vulnerable moment and your only opportunity. Preventing her from reabsorbing water and trapping her on dry land will be the key to her defeat.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a3556390e25462e72ed772424135cc92adc4b371.gif"]
The true threat of the Acting Physician and Lady Sea Nettle may only be fully revealed when encountered face-to-face..
For more details, please check [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/693139048964818203"]
"A thousand colors for a thousand people, all defined by you."

From now on, cosmetics are not just about "owning" but also "color mixing": Metas can consume the corresponding currency/item to freely combine and dye the supported fashions, letting each beloved fashion glow with colors exclusively yours.
*Due to production progress, we have currently opened the legendary sets up to June 11th. More set dyes will be gradually released in the future. Stay tuned!

Free Dye: Supports personalized dye customization for designated fashion items, allowing the same outfit to achieve entirely different styles, eliminating the worry of wearing the same outfit as others and letting you create a unique, one-of-a-kind look.

Color Combinations: Try pairing different areas of the outfit, from elegant to vibrant, from plain to colorful. Freely combine shades, warm and cool tones, and thematic styles, with every detail showcasing your taste.

Real-time Color Try-On: The Dye interface supports real-time preview and one-click comparison. Check the effect before dyeing, confirm after satisfaction, and repeatedly adjust without making mistakes. Easily find the color that best suits you.

Phased Support: As custom dye requires adaptation processing of Fashion resources, currently released Fashion items will be supported for dye in batches and gradually. We will complete support for all sets as soon as possible. Please wait patiently.
The dye system will continue to open more dyeable Fashion items and dyes with each version update. Please stay tuned to tune your exclusive colors!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/710940839332edb2178f2aa5cfd4d414296deaec.png"]

On the daily adventures of the Metas, how could music be absent? After this update, we will launch the \[Music Player] feature, and 5 new songs will be added to both the Jukebox and the music player song libraries, making melodies your best partner on your survival journey!

1. Quick Summon, One-Click Play: Metas can find and open the music player interface in the Function Wheel. You can freely select and play in-game tracks. Whether exploring the wild to collect supplies or taking a break in your Territory, your exclusive BGM will be with you.

2. Scene Customization, Immersive Experience: To ensure an immersive game atmosphere, we have added custom settings for the personal music player under Settings - Interface. notes.title: RaidZone New Weapon: Light Machine Gun - QBJ97

items.text: "Unleash firepower, suppress the strong! Use an unending rain of bullets to build the sturdiest offense and defense for your teammates."
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/90263900ac7ce4b15a90c77fa8f67e7a7a07fcea.png"]

The RaidZone Armory officially welcomes a new member — the long-range suppression light machine gun QBJ97! As a heavy firepower weapon designed specifically for sustained combat, it will provide a brand new option for Metas' tactical combo.

• Weapon Trait: The QBJ97 excels with its massive ammo capacity, extremely long effective range, and high firing stability, capable of unleashing a continuous stream of firepower. However, please note that its heavy weapon body comes with the cost of a slower reload speed and sluggish weapon-switching actions.

• Combat guide: It's the perfect choice for mid-to-long-range point defense and Legion fire support! Whether facing a high-defence Rosetta or needing to quickly destroy sturdy enemy vehicles like armed helicopters, the QBJ97 can play a decisive role. Due to its restricted mobility, it is recommended that Metas pay close attention to controlling engagement distances and seek safe fortification positions for output when using it.

• How to obtain: Metas can obtain the physical entity of this weapon by collecting it through wilderness exploration. After obtaining it, conduct Reverse Engineering at the workbench to successfully unlock and master its crafting formula!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4466598ac56e23e26e0c1c0417af7ab36a29caf6.gif"]
1. Stealth Tactical Upgrade: Crouch Stealth Mechanic

Added the crouch stealth feature. Now when the character is in the crouched state, footstep sounds and their corresponding footstep visualization marks will be completely hidden. Use fortifications and field-of-view deadzones to become a silent hunter in the RaidZone!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f5a333ef140e07f74eb5652983603eb5cc1b06bf.gif"]
2. Combat Information Game Optimization: Health Bar Display Adjustment

We've observed that excessively long HP bar display durations can easily cause Metas to reveal their positions during gunfights or when repositioning, slowing down the overall combat pace. Therefore, we have optimized the HP bar display logic for reticle aim and when taking damage:
1) The duration for which the HP bar is displayed after being triggered has been significantly reduced from 8 seconds to 3 seconds.
2) The HP bar will be hidden immediately after the damage animation finishes playing, making your tactical repositioning safer and more concealed.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ab9dc222060a128c86ff85f05cda2550e057e7cd.gif"]
3. Action Fluidity Improvement: Melee Glide Cancellation

Say goodbye to stiffness! To improve RaidZone experience, a character's action backswing after performing a melee attack in mid-air can now be directly canceled by the "Glide" action. This allows for smoother execution of tactical combos like "attack-glide-charge" in the air.
4. Weapon Combat Balance Adjustments: Sniper Rifles

To ensure a fairer competitive experience in PvP scenes and prevent long-range Weapons from exerting unreasonable suppression in close-quarters encounters, we have appropriately limited the non-ADS firing capabilities of certain sniper weapons:

For the SN700 and AWS.338 Sniper Rifles, we have increased their bullet spread while Hip Firing and in OTS (third person aiming), reducing their long-range blind-fire precision. This encourages Metas to use ADS to obtain more accurate Fire.
5. Explosive Hit Logic Optimization

We have optimized the collision detection algorithm for explosive attack boxes. This resolves the issues from previous versions where the visual explosion location did not match the actual hit detection location and where damage could be "swallowed," ensuring every blast's DMG is precise and reliable.
Fixed an issue where it was possible to create an extra Team under certain conditions.
Celebrating the anniversary, the Custom Server also receives a major update:

1. Synchronized addition of the new RaidZone “Crimson Revelry”(the original RaidZone Lunar Revelry) scenario. Server Hosts can set the start time and duration for Crimson Revelry, adjust the Lord of Moonlight's HP Multiplier, DMG Multiplier, Movement Speed, Aggro Range, and Alert Sensitivity. Combined with the original RaidZone settings, this allows for designing a richer and more diverse experience.
2. Free Camera: Server Hosts now have the privilege to enter Free Camera mode, allowing them to freely observe Nalcott.
3. Weather Settings: Server Hosts can modify the weather effects in their game to capture or record rich content materials.

4. Social Settings: Server Hosts can set the camera perspective for Metas within the server. They can either let Metas choose their perspective freely or restrict gameplay to First Person or Third Person only.
1) New Deviations: Behemoth and Crimson Insight: ZapCam.
2) New Weapons: QBJ97 - Fiery Trees and Silver Flowers, SN700 - Finale.
3) New Items: Aero Leap, Blackfell Extraction Permit, Securement Silos STIGMA Access Card, etc.

notes.title: First Person Mode & New Survival Scenario \[Isles of the Abyss] Pioneer Test is About to Begin

items.text: With this update, we will launch the Pioneer test for First Person mode and the new survival scenario, \[Isles of the Abyss]. Metas who signed up through the earlier recruitment can switch into the Pioneer test via the button in the top-left corner after the test begins.
First Person Mode Pioneer Confidential Test

This test will reintroduce you to the apocalypse from a First Person perspective—gripping weapons with your own hands, facing melee threats, exploring supplies and unknown regions, and feeling the immersive oppression closer to the battlefield itself.
Test Duration: June 10, 21:00 (PT), expected to last 7 days.

Available scenarios: For this test, First Person mode will be available in the Manibus and Endless Dream scenarios, giving you a chance to experience the apocalypse from a very different point of view.
First Person Preview - See Once Human from a New Perspective
What will feel different in the First Person mode? Here is an early look:
1. Feel every shot in your own hands.
Shooting is no longer just watching your character fire a weapon. You aim, shoot, and reload from your own point of view. Every action feels closer to your eyes and closer to the fight.
2. Combat feels more intense.
Enemies can appear at the edge of your vision, and bullets can fly right past you. In first person, combat pacing, distance judgment, and spatial awareness all feel different from third person.
3. Exploration feels more immersive.
Move through the vast landscapes of Manibus and the dreamlike light and shadow of Endless Dream in first person as you explore and gather supplies. Even familiar places will feel new again.
4. Survival Items feel more immersive.
In the First Person mode, even familiar survival actions like eating, using consumables, or throwing items at a target feel more immersive.
5. More comprehensive combat preparation experience.

To allow Metas to freely equip and participate in combat in the test environment, we will additionally distribute initial Supplies, Gear Blueprints, and Gear Mods to ensure Metas can efficiently participate in various mode content during the testing process.
After the First Person mode is launched, you can switch to your preferred perspective at any time during the game.
Second Pioneer Confidential Test for the New Survival Scenario \[Isles of the Abyss]
This ocean world full of mystery and adventure awaits Pioneer Metas to explore and share feedback. We welcome you to join!
Test Duration: June 17, 18:00 (PT), expected to last for 20 days.

This scenario will present Metas with a brand-new maritime survival challenge, featuring the complete Isles of the Abyss map. You will need to explore a cluster of scattered islands, gather resources amidst dynamic weather and day-night cycles, build facilities, and confront threats from the environment and mysterious enemies.

This test is the second Pioneer Test, aiming to validate the core game mode loop, system stability, and story pacing in the early stages of the scenario. We highly value your feedback, which will be used to fine-tune subsequent versions, bringing a better experience to Metas.
To Let Metas have more seamless cooperation during RaidZone exploration, we have optimized the squad cooperate system.

1. Squad mark sharing: points marked by squad members in the wilderness and on the map are now shared and visible to all. Whether marking supplies or warning of enemy threats, your teammates can see them instantly in their field of view and on the map, making strategic deployment clear at a glance!

2. Added online voice chat support: team mode now supports online voice chat. During intense combat, you can call for fire support from teammates anytime, anywhere, significantly improving team cooperation efficiency and survival rate.

items.text: The shadow of Aberrant Progeny is fading, yet the skies of Nalcott have never truly known peace. Expected Duration: Starts after the May 27 maintenance update (PT). The end time will be announced later.
Available Scenarios: Manibus (excluding novice), Evolution's Call, Prismverse's Clash, The Way of Winter, Endless Dream, Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve
After the update, servers with Visional tags will automatically switch to S4 \[Gravity Abyss], concluding the \[Aberrant Progeny] vision. Related special items will no longer be produced.
S4 Gravity Abyss New Gameplay
Gravity Imbalance

When the Vision begins, the inverted star emerge once more, and the Gravity Imbalance effect will envelop certain Stronghold regions. Metas can check the these locations through map pins. Explore the corresponding regions for a chance to obtain Mods, Gravity Crystals, and other rewards.
Riftwalker Relic

After the Vision begins, the Riftwalker will soar over the wilderness, scattering mysterious artifacts from the sky: Echoite Broken Relics and Riftwalker Relics. Their drop locations will be marked on the map, where Metas can head to contest them.

Riftwalker Relic offers substantial rewards but also presents greater challenges. Whenever a Meta approaches a Riftwalker Relic, elite enemies will be summoned, and the relic will begin to slowly ascend. Only by defeating the enemies will the relic's ascent stop. They contain generous rewards such as Mods, Morphed Deviations, and Abyssal Cores.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ae7609835f7658aaa04cfe70689f6d2840df14e8.gif"]
Aerial Hunt

Fifteen minutes after the Vision begins, the Riftwalker will traverse Nalcott, simultaneously appearing above three random Settlements on the map. The failed airship platform that once attempted to secure the Riftwalker will manifest above these Settlements. Metas can enter the platform for combat via the summoned portal, or directly teleport there by clicking the pins on the map.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/017e6f89704775b2c18938c8f4ad29b6e412adbf.gif"]
The Riftwalker possesses multiple combat forms, requiring close coordination from Metas to defeat it. Metas who successfully overcome the Riftwalker's trial will receive even rarer rewards.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4e2aabb8b483b35ff0000b1226a77674b7cbe62f.png"]Gravity Integrator Mode

Metas can obtain the \[Gravity Integrator Formula] through this game mode, unlocking the tense and exciting Gravity Integrator challenge. The higher the Gravity Integrator ascends, the richer the rewards become.
Floating Building
Metas can obtain the \[Anti-Gravity Foundation Formula] in the wilderness. After learning the Formula, they can initiate Floating Building, and its construction consumes Gravity Crystals.
Weightless Item

Metas can obtain the \[Energy Raiser Formula] through wilderness exploration. After crafting it at the Supplies Workbench, it can be used in non-weightless regions to grant Weightless ability. The Energy Raiser only functions during the Vision's active period.
Game Mode Rewards
Abyssal Core

The Abyssal Core is a rare crystallization of the Riftwalker, with a chance to obtain it in the Riftwalker Relic and Aerial Hunt Game Modes. Abyssal Cores are categorized into three rarity tiers: Epic, Legendary, and Mythic. Higher rarity yields rarer rewards upon opening, which may include Shiny Mods, Abyssal Essence, high-Level Morphed Deviations, and other rare rewards.

Metas can also choose to consume varying amounts of Gravity Crystals to perform different levels of resonance. A deeper of level resonance has a chance of granting double rewards! Abyssal Cores can also be freely traded among players. Whether you opt for steady gain or take a bold gamble is entirely your choice.
Abyssal Essence

Abyssal Essence is an exclusive item that has a chance to drop from opening Abyssal Cores. After collecting Abyssal Essence, you can visit the Event - Visional Redemption - Redeem Shop to redeem precious rewards such as Lightforge Ingots, selected Shop Fashion/Furniture/Weapon Skins, Shiny Mods, top-tier Deviations, and more!
Morphed Deviation

In S4 \[Gravity Abyss], all Morphed Deviations and Mods from the Visional Wheel S1 will return. Additionally, we will introduce brand new Morphed Deviations, offering Metas a richer collection and customization experience.
This time, three brand new Morphed Deviations will be added: The Digby Boy - Gravity Abyss, Atomic Lighter - Gravity Abyss, and Zapamander - Gravity Abyss.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/8f2baf2919300f650f69042a47ea4d8960aed08d.png"]The Starfall Inversion Deviations from S1 will also return together, and Metas can obtain them through various modes.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/5545bd66b4f877784341e188aa973674682339f7.png"]New Mods

S4 will introduce the new "Aero" Suffix Mod, while the Downstar Mod will return as well. The Downstar Mod provides a strong advantage when fighting across elevation differences, whereas the Aero Mod can be activated in any aerial state (including jumping), offering superior flexibility and stability. When acquired, these Mods let Metas select the one that suits their needs.
In this Vision event, we will also release Armor Shiny Mods for the first time, which Metas can obtain through the Abyssal Core.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/8d0f05a8fff535276d8f918f9e9667a518e0f876.png"]New Event
Click the "Event Interface - Visional Wheel" page to participate in the current vision campaign. The following content will be available:
Gravity Abyss: Metas can learn about the basic rules for this Vision through this event.
Abyssal Collection: By collecting Gravity Crystals to earn Progress, you can obtain rare rewards such as Territory Collectibles.
Vision Collection: Collect all Visional Suffix Mods and Morphed Deviations to obtain rewards like Weapon Skins.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/0aa2b252a6c19e7987a727c94b36534f4bde6090.png"]

As the Visional Wheel spins once more, new aerial challenges, exploration objectives, and growth rewards will gradually unfold. We look forward to all Metas embracing new battles in the weightless skies, and welcome everyone to continue sharing your experiences with us through the Community and Feedback PlatformThank you for your ongoing support. Let's meet again in the "Gravity Abyss."

To allow you to choose whether or not to participate in the Visional Wheel without changing servers, after this update, new servers will include both a Normal World and a Visional World. Visional events will only happen in the Visional World and will NOT affect the Normal World. You can switch between the Normal World and Visional World based on your preference.

notes.title: New Shop Feature: Wishlist Now Available!

items.text: The new Wishlist feature is now live. Mark the items you want!

1. Add items to your Wishlist: When browsing unowned cosmetics or items in the Shop, you can add them to your Wishlist by tapping the star button on the left or the secondary button in the purchase pop-up. The Wishlist has a capacity limit. If you obtain an item, it will be removed from your Wishlist automatically.
2. Privacy settings: Tap the star button in the top-right corner of the Shop to view and manage your Wishlist. You can also choose who can see it: Private, Public, or Friends Only.
3. View friends' Wishlists: If a friend has public Wishlist items, a special Wishlist icon will appear on their namecard. Tap it to view their Wishlist and send a gift with one click!
• Gifting has been improved, making it easier to send the right gift!

1. Improved friend list sorting: When sending a gift, friends who have added the item to their Wishlist and friends who are eligible to receive the gift will be shown first. No more struggling to find the right friend!
2. Personal messages: A text field has been added to the gift confirmation screen. When sending a cosmetic gift, you can also include a personal message!

3. Duplicate gift prevention: The system will automatically check whether a Wishlist item has already been purchased or owned. If your friend already owns the item, it will no longer be shown to others. If a duplicate gift is detected when your friend claims it, the duplicate item will be returned, and Crystgin will be refunded based on the purchase price or the deducted pack price.

• Gift history added: Tap History in the top-right corner of the gifting screen to view detailed records of all gifts sent and received between you and your friends, including time, item, and user.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d91a436fd74d77b5ebb8016eed13f527d6b49a1d.png"]Meta Pass Monthly Try-On Update
Meta Pass try-on benefits have been fully improved. Starting June 1, server time, the Monthly Limited-Time Trial cosmetics will rotate, helping you stay at the forefront of Nalcott fashion!
We remain committed to maintaining dynamic combat balance, preserving freshness and strategic depth to deliver an evolving battle experience. This update includes the following adjustments:
1. We have identified the following issues with the recent weapons and gear:
1). AUG - Electron Cloud lacks flexibility when repeatedly generating magnetic fields, making target switching less efficient.
2). For Compound Bow - The Burden of Betrayal, Echo DMG is a core part of its damage output, so Crit Rate has a major impact on its consistency.
3). Compound Bow - The Burden of Betrayal deals too much burst damage against Metas.
4). Glide Pants consume too much Stamina, while their buff duration is too short.
Based on these issues, this update will adjust and improve the effects of AUG - Electron Cloud, Compound Bow - The Burden of Betrayal, and Glide Pants.
2. Optimized the effects of P90 - Holographic Resonance and R500 - Memento.
For more information, see the https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/664988379448869084
To ensure a smooth transition, we will issue 3 Blueprint Conversion Attempts to all players after this update.

releases.displayName: Notice on the Meta Pass Update and Reward Reissue

items.text: Dear Metas,

In the May 13(PT) version update, we fully upgraded the Meta Pass to improve both its overall experience and value. Since the update, we have received questions from many Metas about how remaining Meta Pass days and unclaimed rewards from the previous version would be handled. We would like to share the reissue and remaining-day conversion rules below:

1. Unclaimed daily rewards will be sent by mail: If you had any unclaimed daily rewards in your Meta Pass before the update, those rewards will be sent to you in full by in-game mail. This applies whether or not your Meta Pass is still active after the update. No rewards will be lost, so please check your mailbox.

2. Extra compensation for remaining days: If your purchased Meta Pass still had valid days remaining after the update, we will provide compensation based on the rule of "1 remaining day = 1 corresponding reward." Each Meta can receive up to 15 compensation rewards. These rewards will also be sent by in-game mail.

All compensation has been calculated automatically by the system and sent through in-game mail. However, due to the large amount of data involved, there may be rare cases where rewards were missed. If you have checked your mailbox and did not receive the reissued rewards you were eligible for, or if you have questions about the number of compensation rewards you received, please contact us through the in-game Customer Service channel. After receiving your feedback, we will review the logs as soon as possible. If we confirm that any rewards were missed or that the compensation amount was incorrect, we will send you the missing rewards promptly. Thank you for your understanding and support!
Once Human Development Team
The server maintenance and update is planned for May 13, 2026, at 4:00 PM (PT) and expected to last about 2 hours (actual time may differ). Please manage your time wisely.

This update brings new weapons and gear, an overhaul of the Chef class, new optimizations to the Tech system, the start of Lightforge Loot Crate: Ember Conclave, an upgraded Meta Pass with better cosmetic try-on benefits, and various optimizations and bug fixes.
After this maintenance, all players will receive the following rewards: Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Stardust Secret Crate: S12 (Epic) ×1, and Colorful Badge ×30.

notes.title: No Escape from the Storm Clouds!: New Weapons and Gear

items.text: The following weapons and gear will be available in all scenario servers except RaidZone. New weapons and gear for RaidZone will be detailed in an upcoming announcement. Stay tuned!

To make combat more diverse and exciting, this update will bring new weapons and gear. We hope every Meta will enjoy the challenge and visceral firepower they offer while exploring and surviving in Once Human.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/64eb5c3bb8942890a1955413c66dd1b2bed0aeb2.jpg"]
New Weapon: Assault Rifle - AUG - Electron Cloud
Wield the power of lightning with this weapon! Master the rhythm of reloading and firing to unleash devastating ion storms upon your enemies.
Core Mechanic: Attacks have a chance to apply Power Surge. The first weapon hit after reloading will create a spherical magnetic field at the target location.

Chaotic Storm: Applying Power Surge to a unit within the magnetic field will generate an Electric Orb that moves erratically. The Electric Orb rebounds upon hitting the spherical magnetic field, dealing Shock Elemental DMG to enemies hit.
Stat Buff: When equipped, this weapon increases all Shock Elemental DMG.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/553085cece03112f702b79b03c7dad4f8118b1af.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d2bd513ba6936d711cfcdf0b4c2097464729baae.gif"]
New Weapon: Compound Bow - The Burden of Betrayal
The perfect combination of sniping and AoE damage! This compound bow fully utilizes the Bounce mechanic to blow up groups of enemies with Explosive DMG when fully charged.
Extreme Bounce: Attacks are guaranteed to trigger Bounce, and the numbers of bounces and targets are increased.
Echo Tag: Reload Speed is increased. When Bounce hits a target, it applies 1 stack of Echo. When fully stacked, the target will be visually highlighted.

Explosive Charge: When fully charged, Bounce DMG and Crit Rate are increased. When Bounce hits a target, it deals additional Bounce DMG equal to the number of Echo stacks on the target, multiplied by a fixed factor. (There is a cooldown for triggering this on the same target. After triggering, a certain number of Echo stacks are removed from the target.)
Single-Target Specialization: If Bounce is triggered by a direct hit, but there are no other targets nearby, the number of bounces back to the original target is increased.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e75b61bc0e71384327dd0422df20cc2fcf635cae.gif"]
New Armor: Glide Pants
These bottoms are customized for high-mobility builds and will completely transform your combat pace!
Tactical Slide: When equipped, the basic evasive roll will be replaced with a slide. After sliding, Reload Speed and Movement Speed are temporarily increased.

Perfect for Archers: If you are currently wielding a bow, sliding automatically loads 1 ammo, and increases bow draw speed for a duration. Pair with Compound Bow - The Burden of Betrayal for fluid combos!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e301dfd9a8f9437cd749c429c5ed83d0c7fcc77f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/2ba7325390e25e76a851ceb0f76a7f1e67d3c14d.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/b8b5abda67fb7d68f57ac5f16ec93bec2870ab19.gif"]
New Armor: Magnetic Moment Top
A powerful field control core for Status builds!

Gravity Field: When equipped, enemy units inflicted with Power Surge will be transformed into "magnets" that continuously pull in other enemies within a certain range. Pair with AUG - Electron Cloud to easily group enemies together and wipe the field.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/cad5aa3d6f26b9098e1e5401da514c800f8a416b.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/cabca5a219ab0d715cccd16d41852c48433e5186.gif"]
We've received lots of community feedback on the class system. This update will bring comprehensive optimizations to the Chef class. Details are as follows:
Core Abilities

Dish Management: Chefs can now receive cooking orders from other Metas via the Campfire Stove. By completing these orders, they will receive lots of character EXP, Star Chef Popularity, and Energy Links.

* Campfire Stove Management Rules: After placing a Campfire Stove, Chefs can sell basic and creative dishes they've unlocked at customized prices. They can also deploy Chefosaurus Rex and add ingredients to the Campfire Stove to fully automate cooking. Other Metas can place orders by interacting with the Campfire Stove or finding it on the World Map using the Vending Machine view. Completed dishes will be sent to the buyer via in-game mail. If the dish isn't finished within the allotted time, the payment will be refunded to the buyer via in-game mail.
* Star Chef Popularity Rules: Chefs can spend Star Chef Popularity at a Campfire Stove to upgrade their kitchen or redeem special items. There are two kinds of upgrades available:

Upgrades to Orders and the Campfire Stove (only applies to the Campfire Stove and system orders): Campfire Stove: Long-Term Storage, Campfire Stove: Capacity Expansion I and II, Order Upgrade: Quantity Increase I and II, Order Upgrade: Rarity Upgrade I and II, and Order Upgrade: Express Orders I and II.

Upgrades to Dish Effects (applies to all stoves owned by the Chef): Grilled Dish: Slow Roast, Frozen Cuisine: Intense Chill, Canned Goods: Mini Canner, Grilled Dish: Grilling Master, Stardust Dish: Shell Break, and Spicy Pepper.

Items that can be redeemed with Star Chef Popularity include: Star Chef Trophy (limited to one per character), Portable Fridge, and various basic and deviated ingredients (up to 99 of each ingredient per day).
Class Traits

1. Ordering Terminal: To make food trading and distribution more convenient, Metas surviving on Nalcott have established Ordering Terminals at neutral settlements, Securement Silos, and some Strongholds. Chefs can rent an Ordering Terminal and link it to a Campfire Stove they have placed. Other Metas can then place dish orders through the Ordering Terminal during the rental period.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d5cf57eb5c7458f22ef611b1b5fb2263a75feb59.png"]

* Rental Rules: All Ordering Terminals start in an unowned state by default. Only Chefs can join an auction to rent an Ordering Terminal. Bids are made using Energy Links. The Meta who bids the most Energy Links will gain ownership of the Ordering Terminal for 7 days. After the rental period is over, the Ordering Terminal will revert to an unowned state, and a new auction will be held. If ownership conflicts arise due to a server merge or other reasons, the Ordering Terminal will revert to an unowned state.

notes.title: Performance Upgrade! Worldstones' True Forms Revealed

items.text: Worldstones are not isolated structures, but colossal organic entities spanning multiple dimensions, which they connect via complex biometallic conduits.

Volunteers who step into their beam lattices will be drawn into their internal systems, using the conduits to instantaneously travel between realms. This process is immune to all forms of interference and is currently the most reliable form of interdimensional travel.

In the past, Worldstones were obscured by a cognitive barrier, causing all observers to perceive them as pristine and golden octahedral crystals. Following the irreversible shattering of the barriers, these grotesque entities' true forms—composed of concrete, metallic conduits, and biological tissue—have been revealed. Far from beautiful, they nevertheless strive to help every Meta.

Worldstone Performance Upgrade: The appearance of Worldstones has been improved to better fit Once Human's bizarre lore and atmosphere. Now, when approaching a Worldstone, you will have an immersive exploration experience that's more authentic and mysterious.

notes.title: \ New Territory Occupation Dismantle Restriction Mechanic

items.text: To create a fair and strategic competitive experience, we are adding a dismantle restriction mechanic to territory occupations:

When the occupier successfully occupies another Meta's territory, they will be placed under a 3-minute dismantle restriction. During these 3 minutes, the occupier cannot dismantle anything in the occupied territory. This gives the defender valuable time to regroup and counterattack, while making territory contests more strategic!

\ Fully Upgraded: Three Modes, Three Ways to Play

To better support different survival and combat preferences in RaidZone—whether you favor lighter exploration or intense, high-risk competition—this update formally splits RaidZone into three independent modes. With clearly differentiated rules, each mode offers a more focused and better-matched gameplay experience.

notes.title: The rules for each mode are as follows

items.text: 1. Casual Mode — Easy Entry, Low-Pressure Survival
Scenario Duration: 14 or 28 days. Choose the one that best fits your needs when you sign up.
Territory Attack/Defense (Raiding) Window: 4 hours
Territory Maintenance: Not required
Death Penalty: Only weapons and armor are dropped on death
Recommended for: Metas who want a lighter survival pace, a gentler introduction to RaidZone, or a less punishing PvP experience. This mode gives you more room to explore, develop, and settle in!
2. Standard Mode — Classic Combat, Balanced Progression
Scenario Duration: 7 days
Territory Attack/Defense (Raiding) Window: 8 hours
Territory Maintenance: Required
Death Penalty: Full drop on death
Recommended for: Metas who enjoy classic survival PvP and the thrill of taking loot from others. This represents the core RaidZone experience, designed to balance combat pressure with progression.
3. Hardcore Mode — Maximum Pressure, Maximum Challenge
Scenario Duration: 7 days
Territory Attack/Defense (Raiding) Window: Up to 12 hours
Territory Maintenance: Required
Death Penalty: Full drop on death

Recommended for: Hardcore Metas who want relentless pressure and high-stakes decision-making! A longer defense window means harsher raids and fiercer counterattacks. If you want the toughest survival experience, this is it!
The RaidZone scenario selection screen will also be divided into Casual, Standard, and Hardcore sections, allowing you to choose a server by mode.
Note: Existing legacy servers will be shown under Standard Mode.

\[Custom Server] Hyper Brawl mode enters early access testing

Want an all-out fight with rules you set yourself? The brand-new Custom Server mode, Hyper Brawl, is now officially available in early access testing. Server hosts can start it with one click by selecting \[Once Human: RaidZone (Hyper Brawl)] in the settings menu.
In this mode, the Server Host becomes the true "director" of the battlefield, with a high level of control over how matches play out:

Define custom combat zones: Use the dedicated panel to freely set the size of the combat area on the map. Whether you want a map-wide chase or a close-quarters arena-style brawl, the choice is yours! All player spawns and respawns will be confined to the selected area, making battles more focused and intense.

Control the pace of progression: Think the pace is too slow, or want a much more brutal survival experience? Server Hosts can freely adjust progression speed within the zone and shape exactly how fast and how intense each fight becomes.

Advanced incentive settings: To make battles even more exciting, advanced settings also let Server Hosts customize contest objectives and create exclusive leaderboards. Clear loot goals and top-ranking bragging rights will give every Meta another reason to fight harder!

During early access testing, we invite everyone to try Hyper Brawl for themselves and share feedback through the feedback platform and community channels, so we can keep improving Custom Servers together!
\[Custom Server] New Custom Server Features

1. Added a customizable announcement that shows when players enter the server. This helps the server host to promptly relay information to players on the server.

notes.title: Lightforge Loot Crate Guarantee System Sharing Optimizations

items.text: To make it easier for Metas to get the cosmetics they want, we're updating the Lightforge Loot Crate guarantee system so progress can be shared more smoothly.
After the April 22 version update (PT), all Lightforge Loot Crates will display a shared-progress indicator.

1. Similar crates will now share the same guarantee progress. For example, after a 10-draw in a crate with "Lightforge Gem guaranteed within 20 draws," all crates of the same type will update to "Lightforge Gem guaranteed within 10/20 draws." Switching crates will not reset your progress!

2. Different crate types will still track guarantee progress separately. For example, guarantee progress for a crate with "Lightforge Collection guaranteed within 30 draws" is independent from a crate with "Lightforge Gem guaranteed within 20 draws."

3. Your previous draws won't be wasted. Any guarantee progress you built up in Lightforge Loot Crates before the April 22 update (PT) will be preserved and continue by default until that guarantee cycle is completed. Once the corresponding grand prize is obtained and the cycle refreshes, your progress will move into the shared guarantee system automatically. You can also choose to forfeit the old guarantee calculation through the shared-guarantee pop-up and start directly from your shared counter for that crate type.
4. Even if a crate is removed, your guarantee progress remains. Your draw history will stay on record and carry over the next time you open a crate of the same type.
For more details, check the Lightforge Loot Crate announcement: 星铸宝箱公告

Since you arrived in Nalcott, the Tech system has been an essential part of survival and a major goal during exploration. However, the current Tech system mainly serves as a way to unlock abilities through leveling and does not fully deliver the experience or value it was meant to provide. With this Tech system overhaul, we hope to better reflect the survival experience of Metas in Nalcott and give each scenario its own distinct pace of progression.
Major Update: Complete Tech System Overhaul

The new Tech system completely changes the old progression pace, officially shifting from level-based unlocks to exploration-driven growth. Every trip out into the world can now lead to discoveries that truly matter!
1. Tech Tree and Unlock Methods Updated

The Tech tree has been rebuilt around four core branches: Survival, Production, Combat, and Building. Characters now start with basic Tech unlocked by default, and future unlocks are no longer limited by scenario phase or character level. You can obtain new Tech in the following three ways:

l Reverse Engineering: Collect facilities and items marked as "cultural artifacts" in the wilderness, then bring them back to the Synthesis Bench for reverse engineering. This can directly unlock crafting abilities or grant Tech Points, making progress much more efficient!

l Tech Invention: Combine materials at the Synthesis Bench to conduct invention experiments. A successful attempt gives you both the formula and the finished item. Even if it fails, part of the materials will be returned.

l Tech Point Allocation: Spend Tech Points to manually unlock the Tech you want. Tech Points can be earned by leveling up, repeating research, defeating Elite enemies, and more. (To reduce grinding, Tech Points can no longer be obtained from exploring Mystical Crates.)
2. Specialization System Removed and Facility Enhancements Upgraded

The original Tech Specialization system has been completely removed! Its effects have now been fully integrated into Tech tree nodes, Tech enhancements, wilderness exploration, and the new facility enhancements

To help you gain full crafting capability earlier, we have removed some mid-tier crafting facilities, including the Intermediate Supplies Workbench, Intermediate Weapon Bench, Small Synthesis Bench, and Intermediate Stove. Their formulas have been merged into advanced facilities, and the unlock nodes for those advanced facilities have been moved earlier. At the same time, we have significantly upgraded the current facility enhancements:
l Enhanced Electric Furnace: Sulfur Chemist, Petroleum Process, and Art of Stardust Decay will now be unlocked here.
l Custom Disassembly Bench: Combines all disassembly enhancement effects.
l Stardust Fusion Stove: Combines cooking-related enhancement effects, including Enhanced King of Cuisine and Permanent Save.
l Enhanced Supplies Workbench: All effects have been further improved, and crafting time has been greatly reduced.
l Power Generation Facilities: Increases to the facility limit are back and can now be unlocked through Tech level and enhancements.
*Note: Some overly niche or balance-breaking specialization formulas have been removed. Any specialization bonus facilities you have already built will remain.
3. New Tech Enhancement System

Raising your Tech level grants enhancement points, which can be used to enhance specific Tech and unlock extra effects. Enhancement results are fixed and cannot be reset, but enhancement effects can be traded, encouraging Metas to exchange what they have with each other.
Building and Facility Optimizations
l Load and body type mechanics clarified: Default Load has been adjusted to 100. Body type now affects characters as follows:
n Heavy Build: Load bonus +10, Movement Speed -5%
n Normal Build: No change
n Light Build: Load bonus -10, Movement Speed +5%
Combat and Gear Optimizations

l No level requirement for gear: Gear is no longer restricted by character level. More high-quality lost gear will now appear in the wilderness, bringing more surprises during exploration. Your starting weapon has also been changed to the Rustic Crossbow.

l Eternaland gear import rules adjusted: To make sure every Meta starts each scenario from a relatively fair position, gear brought in from Eternaland will now be automatically marked as "lost gear." It cannot be repaired, reverse engineered, or traded. The "All-Purpose Hand" will also be unable to repair lost gear inside a scenario.

l Gear crafting simplified: Gear can now be crafted directly from materials, with no need for prefabricated components. New dedicated materials have also been added, such as Wood Weapon Body and Armor Lining.

l Ammunition types simplified and output increased: Rifles, submachine guns, and light machine guns now all use medium-caliber ammunition. Advanced ammo formulas have been adjusted, and output has been greatly increased! To keep damage balanced, the HP of high-level enemies has also been slightly reduced. A new drink that boosts weapon damage has been added as well.
l Tactical items reworked: Repeated item types have been streamlined, and the low, medium, and high tier split has been removed. Crafting formulas have also been adjusted.
l Vehicle adjustments: Vehicle repair costs have been adjusted.
Wilderness Exploration and Gathering Optimizations

l Ore streamlined: Tin ore and aluminum ore will no longer spawn in the wilderness. Two new metal ingots have been added and can be obtained by processing iron. The Deviation "The Digby Boy" will no longer collect tin ore. Tin and aluminum ore have also been removed from the outputs of the Mining Platform and Digger Biomechanical, and the output efficiency of other ores has been adjusted.
l Tool adjustments: The number of gathering tool types has been reduced, tool gathering range has been adjusted, and the efficiency of high-tier tools when mining iron ore has been greatly improved.
l Material unification: All tiered materials have been merged into a single tier.

notes.title: Changes to Starchrom and Blueprint Acquisition

items.text: Starchrom and blueprints have always been at the heart of Once Human, but the current system still has several problems. Blueprint acquisition is too restrictive, the progression paths are too complicated, and the Wish Machine draw system is hard to understand. Because of that, we plan to adjust how Starchrom and blueprints are acquired after the update on March 25 (PT), so you can obtain and develop gear more easily and more freely, and spend more time enjoying exploration and combat.
1. Blueprint system overhaul: Use Starchrom to activate and upgrade directly
1) Simpler blueprint unlocks and upgrades

Blueprints will now be activated directly from the Blueprint screen using Starchrom. You will no longer need to draw and combine blueprint fragments. Both weapon and armor blueprints can be unlocked directly with Starchrom, with costs varying by type. Blueprint upgrades will also be handled directly on the Blueprint screen using Starchrom. The expected Starchrom cost to unlock and upgrade blueprints will remain the same. This change is mainly meant to make the rules simpler and the process clearer.
You will still be able to use the Blueprint Conversion feature to transfer star levels between blueprints of the same rarity.
2) Wilderness reward updates

In the wilderness, exploration points, crates, and other sources that previously awarded blueprint fragments will now award Starchrom directly. This includes mysterious settlement treasures, first-clear dungeon rewards, tasks, and other gameplay sources. All blueprint fragment rewards will be replaced with an equivalent amount of Starchrom.
3) Closure of the Blueprint Shop
With blueprint acquisition being fully streamlined, the Blueprint Shop will be removed. If you plan to use it, please spend your Starchrom accordingly before the update.
4) Stellar Stairway system changes

Stellar Stairway and Asterism will be removed. Sources that previously awarded Asterism and Asterism Crates will now award Starchrom and Starchrom Crates directly. The monthly Starchrom acquisition rules will remain unchanged. You will be able to check the Starchrom cap for the current cycle on the Blueprint screen.
* Starchrom earned from events, the Battle Pass, Collection Level, and similar sources will not count toward the monthly Starchrom cap.
5) Conversion of existing materials
Once these blueprint-related changes go live, affected items in your Backpack will be automatically converted to an equivalent value. Details are as follows:
Blueprint Fragments: Converted into different amounts of Starchrom based on rarity and slot. Formula: Starchrom = Fragment Exp × 1.85

Asterism: After the Stellar Stairway adjustment, the current month's Asterism acquisition rate will be directly converted into the current month's Starchrom acquisition rate. Any unclaimed Stellar Stairway Starchrom Crates will also be converted directly into Starchrom.

Wish Stones will be converted into Mitsuko's Marks.: 2. Wish Machine rework: The Wish Machine is one of Once Human's signature features, and as developers, we also love how it looks and feels. But using it to draw blueprints is clearly too complicated, especially for newer players. So we plan to rework the Wish Machine while keeping the mini-game interaction and the fun of random rewards, and shift its focus to activity rewards instead. This rework is expected to go live after the April 22 update (PT).: 1) Wish Machine draws will be temporarily disabled after the March 25 update (PT): After the update on March 25 (PT), the Wish Machine will be temporarily disabled, and it will no longer provide blueprint fragments. The Wish Machine can also no longer be unlocked using Memetic Points. However, Metas who have already obtained the Wish Machine formula can still build it.: 2) New activity rewards will be added to the Wish Machine on April 22 (PT): After the April 22 update (PT), the Wish Machine will offer a new set of activity rewards that do not consume Starchrom. By taking part in daily gameplay and completing activity tasks, you can earn draw chances and get useful supplies and cosmetic rewards. The Wish Machine formula will also be unlocked by default, making it easier to build whenever you need it.: 3) Due to the Wish Machine being disabled, the Lucky Streak task in the Exploration Guide's Weapon Amplifier module will be changed to the Craft Armor task.

Currently, the Super Anomaly types (Coherence, Void, Phase, Balance) in Nalcott tend to force Metas to adopt specific builds, limiting their freedom. To encourage a larger variety of builds and tactics, we've decided to remove this limit.
New Mechanic: The current Coherence, Void, Phase, and Balance Super Anomaly types will be replaced by a new general resistance mechanic.
Freedom of Combat
Choose Any Weapon: You no longer have to use specific types of weapons to take on certain enemies. For example, you no longer have to use Fortress Warfare weapons to counter Balance enemies.
Tactical Freedom: The new system will emphasize player skill and tactical coordination. Any weapon type can effectively counter the enemy if used correctly.
Simplified System
Cradle Adjustments: Cradle Override nodes related to Super Anomaly enemies will be removed, freeing up valuable node slots that you can freely customize.
Dungeon Affixes Removed: Affected dungeons will no longer have weapon restriction affixes, making your adventure much more convenient.

notes.title: Revamped Territory Terminal Interface and Functions

items.text: Redesigned Interface: Optimized the Territory Terminal's interface to display information more clearly.
Precise Repairs: No more wasted resources due to the Quick Repair function! After the update, you can choose between repairing all structures or just specific categories (such as walls).

Intelligent Maximum Repairs: A new Max Repairable Parts option will be added. If enabled, the terminal will automatically repair as many damaged structures as possible based on the amount of materials in your territory's inventory, ensuring that every resource counts.

Added a setting that divorces body type from body weight. After enabling it in the Settings, your character's body type will always appear as customized and will not be affected by changes in body weight.
To reduce the storage space used by the mobile version and optimize the game's performance, we've added a new resource clearing function.

If the redundant data on your device exceeds a certain threshold, a prompt on the login screen will direct you to Settings > Memory Optimization to free up space on your device and make the game run more smoothly.
Batch Upgrade Feature: In RaidZone, you can now upgrade structures in batches right from the Territory Terminal.

Simplified Controls: Specify the grade and type of structure for batch upgrades. (For example, you can upgrade all wood walls to stone walls.) This reduces the need for manual replacement, streamlining your base construction.
Extended Maximum Duration: Territory reinforcement maximum duration has been increased from 24 hours to 72 hours, giving you extended protection during your offline hours.

Anti-Waste Mechanic: A new overflow protection system has been added. The system will prevent you from adding materials that would extend the reinforcement duration beyond 72 hours, eliminating any risk of wasting reinforcement materials.
Merged Features: To streamline access, we are merging the Hive and Team functions, making it easier to manage your teams.
Offline Retention: You will no longer automatically leave your team after going offline. Instead, you will remain in the team in an offline state, so you can return to combat anytime.
