Collect decor items and light up the Wish Tree alongside all Metas! Let's usher in the holiday season together!

1. How to Participate: Submit decor items in the Decorate Wish Tree event to receive Wish Strike Tickets, which can be used to play the Wish Strike minigame.

2. Earning Points: In the minigame, you earn points by defeating alpacas with hammers. Each alpaca is worth a different number of points. The more difficult the alpaca, the more points it'll yield when defeated.
3. Rewards: After playing the minigame, you'll receive rewards based on your final score. The more points you earn, the more rewards you'll receive!

* This event has a non-replacement prize pool, meaning that rewards obtained are permanently removed from the pool and cannot be won repeatedly. You can keep winning rewards until all rewards have been claimed. Select View Rewards on the Wish Strike screen to check your reward progress.

Rewards include Starchrom Crates, Butterfly's Emissary Crates, mod parts, and other rare rewards, as well as the limited furniture item Firmarbor: Eternal Life, Christmas Deviation Selection Gift Boxes, New Year Cosmetic Selection Gift Boxes, and Wish Stones! 1. Gathering Node Mechanic Adjustments and Optimizations
We've removed some gathering nodes that interfere with PvP or cause visual clutter, while ensuring that farming is minimally affected:
a) More Realistic Environments: Removed unnecessary Stone, Sulfur, Shellfish, and Kelp nodes along the coastline, improving the appearance and realism of coastal environments.
b) Simplified Nodes: Removed Tin Ore nodes that would occasionally appear on the map.

Upgraded Meteor Summoner
The Meteor Summoner can now blow up ore deposits! If you destroy an ore deposit when driving the Meteor Summoner, it'll even yield additional resources!
Territory Construction
1. Optimized trap facilities.
a) We've noticed that the Shotgun Turret has a high barrier to entry in actual use, so we've made the following adjustments to improve its usability:

i. More Ways to Obtain: Added more ways to obtain the Shotgun Turret. You'll have a chance of obtaining a Shotgun Turret when searching trash cans, storage crates, and defeating Deviants in the wilderness.

ii. Reduced Build Cost: Optimized the Shotgun Turret formula. It no longer requires Wood or Memory Chips, and its Steel Ingot cost has been reduced from 60 to 40. However, it now requires Military Parts to build.
iii. Improved Mechanics: The Shotgun Turret no longer needs electricity to operate. Just place it, and it'll start working. This should make it easier to set up your territory's defenses.
b) The Rifle Turret no longer requires Auto Turret Controllers to repair, reducing its overall repair cost.
c) Improved the Flamethrower's combat performance, increasing its direct damage by 4 points.
d) Reduced the Flamethrower's build cost. Its Steel Ingot cost has been reduced from 40 to 20. This should make it easier to set up your territory's defenses.
e) The Flamethrower Fuel Canister can now be crafted at a Primary Supplies Workbench, making it easier to access in the early game.
2. Optimized the load-bearing issue with doors and windows. Doors and windows no longer cost any load-bearing coefficient.
Wilderness
Fixed an issue with the pick-up animation.
Added Endless Dream scenarios with the Lunar Revelry Visional tag.
1. Changed the layout of Deviation information panels, adding Skill Rating and other details. The highly requested filter function is also in development, so stay tuned!
2. Reduced the frequency at which By-the-Wind would spawn in the wilderness in some situations.
3. Following your feedback, we've made the following balance adjustments to the damage of some Deviations and Gyms:

a) Currently, the difficulty of acquiring healing items early on means that the Fresh Green and Hot Spring Gyms are overly difficult. This update will reduce the damage dealt by the sidekick Deviations in these gyms.
b) Significantly increased the strength of Dr. Teddy's Psi Skill. Each heal amount has been increased from 161% to 180% of Attack, and the number of heals has been increased from 3 to 6.
c) Corrected the damage of Snow Globe's Psi Skill. Each hit now deals 160% of Attack as damage.
d) Changed the duration of Rebecca's Psi Skill to 9 seconds.
e) Fixed an issue where the area of effect of the meteor in Invincible Sun's Psi Skill was too small.

We will monitor the impact of these balance adjustments to assess if further changes are necessary. To ensure a smooth transition, we will issue Binding Grenade V ×5, Skill Mutagen - Rapid Charge ×3, Skill Mutagen - Psi Ray ×3, Skill Mutagen - Blink Strike ×3, Skill Mutagen - Group Elemental Overload ×3, and Skill Mutagen - Group Physical Enhancement ×3 to all Metas in Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve servers after this update.
4. Adjusted the completion conditions for tasks related to the Deviation League in the Main Story Task.
1. Optimized some female character animations.
2. Optimized the default pose of male characters in the interface.
To help you capture stunning shots of the scenery and your adventures in Nalcott, we've upgraded the Camera system as follows:
1. Hide Deviants: While in Camera mode, you can now choose to hide Deviants, allowing you to frame a perfect shot without their interference.

2. Increased Camera Freedom: Increased the maximum zoom-out distance and height adjustment range. You can now achieve a wider field of view and more varied composition angles, enabling you to capture more exciting shots.

3. Cloud Gallery Optimizations: Optimized the interface of the cloud gallery. The gallery is now more visually appealing and user-friendly, making it easier to review and manage your precious memories.
4. Improved Interactions: We've implemented targeted optimizations for issues with illogical interaction prompts. Interactions should now be more intuitive, improving the general gameplay experience.
1.Non-RaidZone only: Increased the territory structure limit from 700 to 1,400. Increased the territory furniture limit from 250 to 900.
2. Following your feedback, this update will optimize the basic controls of Construction mode as follows:
a) When copying a structure or facility, its skin and wallpaper will also be copied, so you won't have to reapply them.
b) The system will now remember and automatically apply your last chosen skin, even if you switch to a different type of structure. This makes construction more convenient.
c) When upgrading a structure's material or level, its original skin and wallpaper will no longer be removed.
d) If a structure appears worn down due to low Durability, removing its skin or wallpaper will now retain its worn-down appearance, matching its actual Durability value.
e) The visual effect of selecting a structure has been changed from a blue fill to a green outline, providing clearer visual feedback.
f) Hovering on a structure will no longer hide its skin or wallpaper, ensuring visual consistency.
g) Optimized the icon style of the Foundation category in the Construction menu, making it clearer and easier to identify.

3. Non-RaidZone only: Changed the Building Master Memetic to only increase the Max Durability of all structures by 50%. Changed the Stone Structures: Intense Defense Memetic to only increase the Max Durability of stone structures by 150%. If you've already activated these two Memetics, you'll receive an item that lets you reset your Memetic build.
Optimized the friend invitation feature. You can now invite a friend to join your team from their namecard.
In response to your feedback, we're increasing the rewards granted by the Dream Zone Invasion game mode:
1. Greatly increased the amount of Reality Fragments obtained.
2. Increased the chance of obtaining mods. Added a chance to obtain two mod crates at once on higher difficulties.
Changed the locations of some side story task NPCs in the Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve scenario.

We've added an AI assistant to the Co-Dev Feedback Platform. Designed to respond promptly to your suggestions and feedback, the AI assistant has been trained on popular suggestions and developer responses. If you submit a suggestion that it's familiar with, the AI assistant will provide our latest progress on that issue. Any feedback you submit to the AI assistant will also be recorded and forwarded to our team, just like standard feedback. We recommend using the AI assistant to submit suggestions and feedback from now on.

To help you submit feedback and obtain information more easily, the AI assistant will suggest optimization details based on your feedback. You can then select a specific item to check the latest progress on that optimization.
NOTE: The AI assistant is only equipped to provide details and progress of optimizations related to its suggestions. To check on bug fix progress, please refer to our bug fix announcements.

notes.title: Additional information about the gray-box test

items.text: 1. What content does the new novice tutorial include?
A: The new novice tutorial features changes to its missions and narrative, allowing players to experience the appeal of various scenarios under Once Human's "eternal return" setting.
2. Which global regions are included in the gray-box test?
A: Gray-box testing of the new novice tutorial will be held in the following regions: North America, Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia, Republic of Korea, and Japan.
3. What is the purpose of this gray-box test?
A: The new novice tutorial may affect server stability. Therefore, we are holding a gray-box test to monitor and optimize server performance.
4. When will the new novice tutorial officially launch?
A: If gray-box testing proceeds smoothly, the new novice tutorial is planned to launch in late December, making it available to all players on all global servers.
* We will announce any changes to the launch schedule beforehand.
5. Can I voluntarily sign up for the gray-box test?
A: No, you cannot. About 20% of newly registered accounts in select regions will be randomly selected for the gray-box test. Voluntary sign-up is not supported.
6. How will I be affected if I'm randomly selected for the gray-box test?

A: You'll be able to play the game as per normal. The only change is that you'll experience the new novice tutorial. During gray-box testing, some bugs or irregularities may still be present. Please report any issues or provide feedback via the Co-Dev Feedback Platform so we can optimize the feature.

notes.title: New PvE Scenario "Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve" Now Live

items.text: The world is mutating and Deviations are spreading. In this brand new scenario, Deviations break free from the Cradle and appear before you in more expressive and dynamic forms.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/bfe1d09a881633e590ce41fb74555859e2c9ed2a.png"]
Delve into a Deviation ecosystem
Craft specialized capture devices and study how Deviations appear across the world to successfully secure each one you encounter.
Awaken Deviation abilities

Having broken free from the Cradle, Deviations will now travel and fight alongside you as lively companions! Whether in exploration, combat, or territory work, each Deviation has unique abilities that you must unleash to their full potential!
Customize your Deviation team
Strategy is everything! You can form a team of up to three Deviations. Mix and match their unique traits to create battle squads for various situations.
Engage in Deviation battles
Challenge the NPC-run arenas, or go head-to-head with other Metas in thrilling real-time matches! The key to victory isn't strength, but your bond with your Deviations!
Secure the Chaos Deviations

Hidden across the world are powerful Chaos Deviations with strange forms and terrifying power. They are the source of this world's troubles! Your task is to uncover their mysteries and secure them for good!
Deviation Fusion
Through the fusion system, you can fuse Deviations with each other, or even with animals and furniture, to create unique entities with interesting traits.
New Combat Deviations
Whalepup, Soul Summoners, Zapamander, and Director Fox are now available. For details, check [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/528735466048979297"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c31a614f36e5e391328d6d68dda00c4fd562e513.jpg"]
Optimizations Based on Early Access Feedback
1. The Symbiosis Level cap has increased from 5 to 10, and early level progression now requires far less Deviation Value. Memetics now unlock based on Symbiosis Level rather than scenario phase.
2. Updated how Deviation Value is calculated. Deviation Value now increases with Deviation Level, and the base value for Grade S Deviations has been reduced.
3. Updated the names and levels of Gyms in Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve.
4. Improved icon display for Gyms and Arenas on the world map; added a new details screen that allows you to view enemy lineups and rewards.
5. Added an icon above Deviations summoned through wishes at the Wishing Statue.
6. Added a new side story task, Call of Chaos. After completing the side story task Mastery of Securement, you can accept this task by entering the Wish Arena.
7. The store functionality for each leader will be unlocked after successfully challenging the respective leader.
For more optimizations, refer to the Deviation scenario dev blog: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/528735466048981612"]
Adjustments to "Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve" Vision Mechanics
Vision Tag S2 "Lunar Revelry" will be adapted for Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve. The rules are as follows:
In this scenario, the mod system is disabled. To ensure Metas can still obtain mod rewards related to the vision gameplay, the following changes will be made:
1. Lunar Loot Crates will no longer yield Lunar & Crescent Mod Selection Crates. They are replaced with a fixed amount of Lunar Whispers.

2. Metas can go to Events > Visional Wheel > Lunatic Medley > Redeem to exchange Lunar Whispers for the Lunar & Crescent Mod Selection Crate. This exchange is available only in the Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve scenario. The Lunar & Crescent Mod Selection Crate can be used in other scenarios.

Due to the high rating of original Visional Deviations, the previous acquisition methods negatively affected the pacing of the Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve scenario. The following adjustments have been made:

1. Visional Deviations with the Lunar Oracle attribute will no longer appear in Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve scenario. The original acquisition channels, including Lunar Loot Crates in the wilderness, Lunarspawns, and Lord of Moonlight drops, are replaced with Lunar Oracle Mutagens corresponding to each deviation.

2. In the Visional Wheel > Shop of the Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve scenario, the original Starfall Inversion Visional Deviation Selection Gift Pack has been replaced with a Starfall Inversion Attribute Mutagen Selection Gift Pack.
3. Metas can use Mutagens in this scenario to fuse Deviations, allowing them to obtain the Lunar Oracle attribute or the Starfall Inversion attribute.
4. Lunar Oracle Mutagens and Starfall Inversion Mutagens cannot be taken outside the scenario. The Lunar Oracle attribute and the Starfall Inversion attribute cannot be transferred through fusion.

Special enemies in the visional mode Lunar Revelry, including basic visional enemies in the wilderness, Lunarspawns, and the Lord of Moonlight, have had their difficulty adjusted to fit the Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve scenario.

After this update, Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve scenario servers with the Visional Wheel S2 - Lunar Revelry tag will open. You can view the server launch schedule on the Scenario Sign-up interface to plan ahead.

notes.title: Once Human X Palworld collaboration event is now live! Enjoy a variety of collaboration content. (Non-RaidZone modes)

items.text: Collaboration Event Period: After the October 29 update – January 20 (PT)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/51e56f2cf0d31137ae07968532485416e0e255fb.jpg"]
Main Collaboration Content
1. Palworld Collaboration Deviations have arrived in Once Human. Adorable Cattiva, Chillet, and Chillet Ignis are waiting to join you on your adventures across Nalcott.
2. All Palworld collaboration cosmetic items are available for free, including fashion sets, furniture, weapon charms, namecards, and avatars. Come get them!

3. The collaboration map Paradise Island is now available. Collaboration Pals and adorable Deviations from Once Human will appear on Paradise Island. Visit the island to take photos and enjoy the attractions! Explore the island to find Loot Crates, and join special hourly events to earn gifts from the Pals or dance for prizes! Don't forget to visit the island during the collaboration event to claim exclusive rewards!
4. Transform into Pals and adventure with your friends. During the event, you can obtain 5 different Transformation Cookies to transform into collaboration Pals and Deviations.

After transforming into Chillet or Chillet Ignis, other Metas can ride on your back for adventures in the wilderness!: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/619b010413bff2032cc9ee9bdc02acd40f25fe39.gif"]

Transform into Cattiva to increase gathering efficiency in the wilderness. Become the hardest-working Pal in Nalcott!: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f78e78ca8ee025c9b8f8e2159f41a678d25f5699.gif"]

Transform into Rain Man or By-the-Wind to move while levitating.: After transforming into Chillet, Chillet Ignis, or Cattiva, use the Expressions Wheel to switch to exclusive Pal actions. Transform together with friends and enjoy a new kind of adventure in Nalcott!: Crossover Event: (Access the event through the event screen. PC default shortcut key: F3. On mobile, tap the relevant button on the main interface.): 1.Joint Check-in: Log in to claim all collaboration Pals, along with collaboration sets, charms, and other rewards. Don't forget to remind your friends to log in too!: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d74b990a3aa9cd2db25c82c88442f38b2712cbbe.png"]: 2. Paradise Island Experience: Join activities on Paradise Island to earn abundant rewards. Activities include:
Explore and collect Loot Crates while taking in the island's breathtaking scenery! Don't forget to snap photos with your friends and Pals as you hunt for treasure across Paradise Island!

Join Cattiva's Island Party! Every even hour from noon to midnight, Cattiva will ride the Wanderer and distribute gifts to Metas across the land! Gifts may include random Palworld collaboration Deviations, cosmetic items, Morphed Deviations, Paradise Coins, and more!

Take part in the Great Party at the Paradise Plaza! Every odd hour from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM, a party will be held at the plaza in the center of Paradise Island! Dance with Pals and Deviations, and use your bubble gun to fend off invading Deviants! Take part to earn collaboration Deviations, actions, Paradise Coins, and more!

Sign up for the Deviation Master World Championship! Want to be the very best Deviation trainer in the world? Register with Pyro Dino at the Paradise Plaza!: There are many more surprises on Paradise Island. Paradise Coins can be redeemed for Legendary blueprints, Pal furniture items, Starchrom, and other valuable rewards. Don't forget to redeem them!: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/cc6fc0295bc898d42ca09b328af79723c7f9df83.png"]: 3. Factory Tycoon Event: The Pal factory is open! Become a factory manager and rise as a business tycoon in Nalcott! Event activities include:

Evaluate your friends' working potential and hire them to work in your factory. Dispatch capable employees to earn Tycoon Coins for you. You can also use Tycoon Coins to train hired workers into top-tier staff who earn even more Tycoon Coins!: * If a dispatched friend is a returning Meta during the event and links your invitation code, both will receive special rewards. Invite your friends back to the game!: * You may also hire Once Human residents to work, which will not affect your participation: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/aa09e3026d735a8896547906a469635d586b775d.png"]

Factories feature multiple workstations that can be unlocked using Tycoon Coins. Proper staff placement is the key to success! Random events may occur during work. You can check the daily report to manage progress. Also, don't forget to commend outstanding workers!

As the manager, your daily activity will also generate Tycoon Coins. Wealth begins with hard work!: Tycoon Coins can be redeemed in the shop for rewards such as Lightforge Ingots, Wish Stones, Furniture Dye, Starchrom, and more!: 4. Photo Studio Event: Great memories deserve to be captured together! The Pals have come to Nalcott with a mission to bring home their beautiful memories there! Join the fun!: 【10】
Transform into a Pal and take themed photos. Each week introduces a new photo theme, with 6 themes in total. Join by transforming and matching the theme.

Create postcards to preserve your memories! Many postcard templates and decorations are available. Themed postcards can enter the community contest for a chance to win up to 3,280 Crystgin!: * You may also freely take photos and create postcards, but only theme-compliant postcards can enter the weekly community contest.
Qualifiers Time: After the update on October 29, 2025 – 08:00 on December 10, 2025 (PT)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/120542d171fe30070b91971ea9a88ca3dbcf0c28.png"]
It's time to become the strongest Deviation trainer in Nalcott! The Deviation Master World Championship has officially begun and all Metas are invited to this grand event!

During the Qualifiers stage, to identify the most promising trainers, the event organizer Ms. Pyro Dino has arranged the competition in a fair and balanced format. Metas, enjoy the thrill of the matches!
Access the event through the event screen. PC default shortcut key: F3. On mobile, tap the relevant button on the main interface.
Fair, Quick Deviation Battles

Select your preferred Deviation to battle directly through the event screen. All Metas will fight with fair and balanced stats, ensuring that performance depends solely on skill and lineup strategy. New Deviations will be introduced each week during the Qualifiers stage to expand your lineup. Be sure to make full use of their potential!
Ascend to the Top in Live PvP
From Bronze to King, witness your rise to glory. Enjoy the excitement of battling and outsmarting other Metas!
Rise in All-Region Rankings to Win the Crown of Glory

Each match will grant points. The top 64 Metas in each region will receive the official Deviation Master medal of honor and will advance to the next stage. Compete with the best trainers worldwide and rise to the top! The next stage rules will be announced soon, so stay tuned.

We have prepared a special event invitation for all Metas. Accept the invitation to instantly claim rewards such as the Pal collaboration charm and Deviations. The event page will also generate rankings based on your region performance. Come take part in the event!
New Invasion Gameplay
When a Dream Zone Invasion begins, Metas must defend against it. You will face challenges such as clearing monsters or destroying facilities. Your strength will be fully tested!
1. The Dream Zone Invasion starts after Phase II of the season. The difficulty increases as the season progresses.
2. The occurrence of a Dream Zone Invasion depends on the number of Dreamers defeated.
3. The Dream Zone Invasion happens in three different scales: small, medium, and large. Larger invasions cover larger areas.
4. The Dream Zone Invasion has three difficulty levels: Basic, Normal, and Hard. The higher the difficulty, the tougher the challenge.
5. Explosive Tactical Items are especially effective in invasion zones.
6. Invasion gameplay rewards include the Morphed Deviation: Radiant Variant - Lonewolf's Whisper.
7. If you successfully stop a Dream Zone Invasion, the area returns to normal. If the invasion is not dealt with, the area will become a Dream Zone.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/496a30eb8cb1c6bbb4654339accb62a0618378f5.png"]
New Territory Facility: Dream Door
1. The Dream Door remains active by consuming Wakeful Sand.
2. While active, the Dream Door will automatically generate various resources needed in the scenario.
3. A new Eternal Hunt scenario objective is now available. You can check your personal progress at the Dream Door. Higher progress unlocks more rewards and advanced Dream Door functions.
4. The dungeon entry function of the Silver Gate has been moved to the Dream Door.
Invasion-related scenario challenges have also been added. All improvements to invasions will be applied to both new and existing servers. Stay tuned for more upcoming adjustments.

Our Metas have been asking for flying vehicles and they're finally here! In this update, a brand new vehicle with both ground and air capabilities will be introduced, letting you take off and soar freely across the skies of Nalcott!
Enjoy full 360 degree aerial control for dives, spins, and advanced stunts. Create your own aerial performance in the sky!
It supports multiple riders! Fly with friends and take in the stunning views from above!
Rear-seat players can shoot freely while flying. PvP and PvE are both elevated with true three-dimensional combat. Control the airspace and seize the advantage!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/702ff911a8d7b93499a8bfc8ced239b037f2b324.gif"]
In PvE scenarios: Unlock the relevant Memetic to activate the flying vehicle in the Small Garage.
In RaidZone Mode servers: A designated trade zone will appear randomly where aircraft can be purchased. You can craft them using Memory Chips.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/6c01e5ca6c13a58d962ce3f4919a9c23df1726bc.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/da7a626faafaa38698dd320f86381982539977ed.gif"]

notes.title: New Eternaland Mode, Island Paradise, Enters Online Do-Dev Testing

items.text: A mysterious new device called the Paradise Facility has appeared on Eternaland. It can capture scattered Island Paradises floating nearby, letting you create your own gameplay features and start your creative journey. Other players can travel between Eternalands through the Paradise Facility and visit your Island Paradise to experience your designs.
Island Paradise online co-dev testing will open after this update. You're invited to be among the first to build, explore, and enjoy the fun of creative gameplay!
During the test, you can build content using four template types:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/8162e5a007a7d6b6bbada7bb0bad6196925825ef.png"]
Racing: Build custom tracks, select preset vehicles, then race with other Metas at high speed.
Parkour: Create skyscraper-style parkour courses and race across rooftops to see who reaches the finish line first.
Labyrinth: Build your own labyrinth and explore freely while searching for coins.
Other: Build any type of scene your imagination inspires.

1. Four structure skins (Wall 02, Half-Wall 02, Door Frame 02, Window Frame 02) will now be unlocked by default as base skins with updated names. You can find them under Cosmetics > Wall Skins. Base skins can only replace structures of the same material, such as Wood to Wood.
2. Added a one-click withdraw function for storage crates that hold general items.
3. In non-RaidZone modes, you can now place a bed in your territory to set your teleportation arrival point. If no bed exists, it will default to the original spawn point.
4. Added snap-point indicators during structure preview. Aim the crosshair at a snap point for precise placement.
5. Improved snapping for roofs, ceilings, and walls, removing some unreasonable snap points.
6. Improved snapping accuracy for fences.
7. Structures now display a blue highlight when canceling pre-placement, allowing better visibility during building.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ab42c7d2b40c07219ab8fed62c747b2e5478e5b0.gif"]
8. At the edges of the Foundation and Ceiling, the snap points for pillars have been expanded (3.6 meters expanded to 5 points, 1.8 meters expanded to 3 points).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/8face15ce9e845dd2937baeb745a52e082dcb7f6.png"]
Lunar Revelry Now Supports Customized Parameters
1. You can choose to trigger Lunar Revelry based on in-game time or real-world time, and set how long the effect lasts.
2. You can adjust basic stats for the Lord of Moonlight and frenzied Deviants, including HP Multiplier, DMG Multiplier, Movement Speed, Aggro Range, and Alert Sensitivity.
3. You can set spawn intervals and quantities for special elite enemies in Lunar Oracle.
These settings are only available on servers with the Lunar Revelry visional tag.
Custom Server's RaidZone Mode Now Supports Customized Parameters
1. You can configure multiple territory protection periods and set structure damage reduction during protection.
2. You can freely adjust the Building DMG Multiplier and Corrosion DMG Multiplier.
3. You can adjust the opening time and refresh interval of the Rosetta Echoite Transporter route, as well as the number of Echoite crates dropped.
4. You can apply buffs to all players at specific times and customize buff duration. Two buffs are available this time:
Endangered Frenzy: The lower the HP, the higher the damage dealt.
Inertial Imbalance: Reduced gravity and gliding speed, increased carry weight, and no injuries or broken bones from falls.
These settings only apply to RaidZone Mode servers.
Deviant Drops and Functional System Updates
Custom Deviant Drops: You can define unique drop rewards and rules for different Deviant types.
Respawn Point Optimization: You can set a specific respawn region or exact respawn location for players.
Inactive Character Retention: Custom server hosts can turn off automatic character deletion to retain inactive characters.
Added Custom Server Leaderboard
1. Hosts can freely set leaderboard categories, rules, and rewards to organize ranking challenges!
2. Hosts configure leaderboards in the Server Host Privileges interface. Other Metas can view them in the event screen.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d6f534002424473a7a7f958ecb9f70bf345a687d.png"]
Added Distributable Items

Chaosium Heart, Lunar Essence, Lunar Whisper, B.P.: Holographic Resonance, B.P.: Pathfinder, B.P.: Gravity Tide Cap, B.P.: Gravity Tide Top, B.P.: Gravity Tide Pants, B.P.: Gravity Tide Shoes, B.P.: Gravity Tide Gloves, B.P.: Gravity Tide Mask, B.P.: Bloodstained Tracker Boots, etc.

notes.title: Lightforge Loot Crate Draw Display Optimized

items.text: After the update on October 29 (PT), the Lightforge Loot Crate draw result screen has been visually improved. Results will now be displayed more clearly. Rest assured, the optimization only affects visuals and does not change any actual draw rates!

1. Improved the display when receiving duplicate skins. Lightforge Relics gained from dismantling will be shown at the bottom right of the draw results. The total amount earned will still appear at the top right, making it easier to see what you actually gained.

2. When drawing a Lightforge Collection item, a "Super Lucky" tag will appear. When drawing a Lightforge Gem: if obtained within draws 1-10 of the round, it shows "Super Lucky"; if obtained within draws 11-17, it shows "Lucky." Wishing you all the best of luck!

Combat

notes.title: 1. Updated the roles of Rustic Crossbow and Recurve Bow

items.text: 1) The Recurve Bow Blueprint is now unlocked by default and can be crafted at the campsite.
2) The Rustic Crossbow must now be crafted at the Primary Gear Workbench and is no longer craftable at the campsite.
3) The Rustic Crossbow node in Memetics must be unlocked to obtain its blueprint and crafting formula.
2. Updated Rustic Crossbow stats to match its new role.

3. Knockdown/Kill feedback now displays specific vehicle names.
4. Offline Metas will no longer show their held items.
5. Increased climbing speed and Movement Speed while critically injured.
Combat
1. Added new Blueprint Collection rewards and increased the maximum rewards you can earn. Some earlier rewards will move into Mitsuko's Mark Shop for exchange.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/93d9158c8de18b98f2a41aa6b5bbe67afca19e10.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/7e2a95f658e22ce296f22d6c603a328305f568d6.gif"]
2. We continue to roll out planned balance updates. The October 29 update (PT) includes the following adjustments:
1) Savior Set improvement: When the shield amount stays above 40 percent, landing shots will refresh the shield and damage buff duration without reducing any HP.

2) Outer Space enhancement: Upon hitting a target affected by Power Surge 12 times, summon lightning on the target to deal Shock Elemental DMG of 500% (previously 300%) Psi Intensity (40% DMG to players).
After these adjustments, we will continue monitoring each build's effectiveness and usage rates to assess whether further adjustments are necessary.
To ensure a smooth transition, we will issue Blueprint Conversion Attempt ×3 to all players after this update.
We updated bullet behavior. Long-range shots still travel and drop over distance, while short-range hits feel faster and more responsive.

1) We added a new instant-hit range to almost all guns except shotguns and a few special weapons. Within this range, bullets hit the target immediately and ignore bullet speed or drop. The range is about 15 meters, although the exact distance depends on the weapon type. (Shown as the blue straight line in the image below.)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/dacc89e58a670139a34d9f72e876de289c872312.png"]

2) Beyond that instant-hit range, bullets continue to fly as physical projectiles, so they still take time to travel and will drop over distance. Long-range shots remain challenging, but bullets now drop slightly less than before. (Shown as the green curve in the image below.)
4. Jumping while aiming will no longer trigger climbing, so your firing rhythm stays smooth during combat.
5. You can now swing melee weapons while jumping.
Vehicles
You can now use medicine, drinks, and food while sitting in any passenger seat of a vehicle.
Social
Improved private chat to make it much easier to reach your friends:
1) You can now start a private chat instantly by @mentioning any online friend in Chat > Private. After receiving a message, you can reply directly or @mention them again.

2) You can now pin up to 6 friends using the Pin button on their namecard. After that, open a private chat instantly through the Enter interface or by pressing their avatar, whether they are online or not.
Squad recruitment messages now show across your entire scenario, not just within the same server.
Shop
1. Improved the color of some parts on the female version of the Dreamsilver: Nocturne set.
2. The cosmetics screen now includes a catalog for weapons and vehicles.
3. Photo mode now includes new character lighting options.
4. Character facial expressions look more natural during idle animations.
5. A cooldown display now appears for Steam purchases to prevent repeated orders during network delays.
Events
We optimized the event tab organization to improve navigation. Your event participation and benefits will not be affected.
Squad Sign-up

notes.title: 1. Added a new squad recruitment screen

items.text: 1) It shows squad sign-up information and suggests squads that match your preferences.
2) You can browse and join other squads.
2. Simplified the squad creation process. After creating a squad, a dedicated squad group chat becomes available so communication is easier.
Deviation
1. After you defeat or obtain a Deviation, its distribution shows directly in the Symbiosis Field Guide or on the World Map.
2. In Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve only: hold E during summoning to select and recover specific Deviations using the radial menu.
Report
Improved the search function in the report screen. It now supports fuzzy name search with even a single character or letter and shows matching report entries.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/53b1c4d7b310b47bfc6b819970a8720ebcd6d553.gif"]
Other
1. Improved material and dismantlable item info so you can directly see what materials you get after dismantling.
2. The item info screen now includes a quick button that jumps to chat and lets you @V to ask about how to acquire that item.
3. The custom material list now pins owned materials at the top by default and supports filtering and sorting.
Shop
1.Fixed an occasional issue where eyelashes clipped through the Final Curtain mask.
2. Fixed the issue where the rarity display of some vehicle stickers was abnormal.
Territory Construction
1. Fixed an issue where the displayed keybindings did not update after customizing them in the building interface.
2. Fixed an issue where the foundation did not follow the cursor during movement.
3. Fixed an issue where animal models could get stuck in foundations and float or move abnormally after a territory reload or teleport.
4. Fixed an issue that caused incorrect fusion errors for Butterfly's Emissary.
Combat
1. Fixed a rare issue where weapon models sometimes disappeared after using the guitar.
2. Fixed an issue where Treants kept moving under specific conditions while facing players.
Game Modes
Fixed an issue where elevator switches disappeared under certain conditions.
Once Human Development Team

The Version 2.1.5 server maintenance and update is planned for October 15 at 4:00 PM (PT) and is expected to last about 2 hours (actual time may differ). Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience. The update size is approximately 4.63 GB on PC launchers, 2.9 GB on the PC client,343 MB on Android, and 328 MB on iOS (actual size may differ). We recommend downloading the update over Wi-Fi. NOTE: If the update is delayed on Steam, it may be downloaded more than once.

This update introduces new weapons and underwater combat to RaidZone mode, the Bug Hunt reward event, a new Battle Pass: Heartbeat Rush, Lightforge Loot Crate: Scorching Craving, C key customization, and various optimizations and bug fixes.
After this maintenance, all players will receive the following rewards: Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Starwish Token ×300, Cosmetic Token*180, and Detoxident ×3.
We've made targeted optimizations to address issues with the territory construction system, as follows:
1. In Construction mode, the required materials for the new structure are now displayed when replacing an existing structure.
2. Non-RaidZone only: Optimized and standardized the appearance of the Territory Construction and The Prime War interfaces.
3. Optimized the collision detection of some sloped roofs.
4. Added inverted versions of the Left Fan Wall, Right Fan Wall, Left Crescent Wall, and Right Crescent Wall. Corresponding cosmetics will also be added to the basic Territory Bundle.
5. You can now view animal details from the Storage Crate and Vending Machine.
6. Optimized the snap points and the overall snapping feel of all structures.
7. Optimized the collision detection range between structures and gatherable nodes on the ground. Trees and other ground objects will no longer prevent structures from being placed.
8. Optimized the collision detection between structures. The collision detection range has been relaxed to allow a reasonable amount of interlocking between certain structures.
9. Optimized the construction validation logic. Now, the construction order does not affect normal construction.
10. All building components can now be rotated manually when not snapped, and will snap appropriately based on the rotation angle.
11. To improve the construction experience, we've optimized the following structures:
a) Foundation
i. When snapping columns to foundations, the number of snap points has been increased from 4 to 9, allowing you to attach more columns.
ii. Optimized the snapping of columns to rectangular foundations.
b) Ceiling
i. When snapping columns to ceilings, the number of snap points has been increased from 4 to 9, allowing you to attach more columns.
ii. Optimized the snapping of columns to rectangular ceilings.
c) Wall
i. Optimized the snap points of all walls.
ii. Triangle walls and inverted triangle walls can now snap to each other (e.g., Wood Wall 03 and Wood Wall 05 can snap together to form a square).
iii. All sides of full-size walls (including door and window frames) can now snap to other walls of any size (e.g., each side of Wood Wall 01 can snap to four 1/8-sized walls).
iv. The bottom edge of walls can now snap to other walls or ceilings.
d) Roof
i. Added snap points to the sides of roofs, allowing them to snap horizontally.
ii. Optimized the snapping behavior of some roofs when attached to the same structure.
e) Stairs
i. Fixed misaligned and floating snap points to make snapping behavior more consistent.
ii. Stairs can now be snapped to the center of doors.
f) Column
i. The sides of columns can now be snapped to walls.
ii. The tops and bottoms of columns can now be snapped.
iii. Optimized the snapping of columns to composite wall structures. Columns can now snap correctly to the edges of existing complex wall structures.
g) Floating Foundation i. Optimized the snapping feel between floating foundations for a smoother experience.
12. Growshroom will now only gather fully grown fruit.

notes.title: Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve – A new scenario in Early Access

items.text: Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve, a brand-new scenario, will be launched in Early Access! Become the first explorers to venture into a world of Deviation companions!

* Early Access Details: Due to significant gameplay differences between scenarios, we've decided to preview new scenarios in Early Access before their official launch to ensure the best quality. Our aim during Early Access is to gather as much feedback as possible to make the game more fun and engaging. Therefore, we hope you'll share your thoughts and suggestions through the Feedback Platform. We'll check your feedback regularly and use it to optimize the scenario. Thank you for helping us to improve Once Human! (Feedback Platform:反馈平台链接)
Delve into a Deviation ecosystem

Deviations can be found in every corner of this world. It's clear that they're the ones in charge! Some Deviations may even hide their tracks following special rules. You must craft unique capturing items and learn each Deviation's habits to secure them all!
Awaken Deviation abilities

Having broken free from the Cradle, Deviations will not join you as lively companions! Whether in exploration, combat, or territory work, each Deviation has unique abilities to unleash. Our old friend Chefosaurus Rex deals Burn damage over time. The Digby Boy is no longer limited to mining, but can continuously knock back enemies and provide a shield when you're low on HP. Meanwhile, Enchanting Void can transform into a black panther with unpredictable attacks. Unleash the potential of your Deviations!
Customize your Deviation team
Strategy is everything! You can form a team of up to three Deviations. Mix and match their unique traits to create battle squads for various situations.
Engage in Deviation battles
Challenge the NPC-run arenas, or go head-to-head with other Metas in thrilling real-time matches! The key to victory isn't strength, but your bond with your Deviations!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d3a3148d8d3a7977bb6d2a8ca5b0684b778f1abe.jpg"]
Secure the Chaos Deviations

Hidden across the world are powerful Chaos Deviations with strange forms and terrifying power. They are the source of this world's troubles! Your task is to uncover their mysteries and secure them for good.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/62a3f7a84bc250de7e26454bb45bca8e481c61fb.jpg"]
Deviation Fusion

The highly anticipated Deviation fusion system will make its debut in Early Access for Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve! You can fuse Deviations with each other, or even with animals and furniture, to create unique entities with interesting and amusing traits.
* Deviation fusion will be available in all non-RaidZone scenarios.

The Visional Wheel turns, and a crimson moon rises once again, bringing stronger forces to bear upon Nalcott. The Blood Moon will manipulate Nalcott for its amusement, provoking conflict among humans with tempting treasures. Only by defeating its avatar, the Lord of Moonlight, will you earn the ultimate reward.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/5067a4720f2b41fa8a15ac1bc60ce09aced90951.png"]
Visional Wheel Period: September 24, post-update (PT) – End time TBD
Affected Scenarios: Manibus (excluding novice), Evolution's Call, Prismverse's Clash, The Way of Winter, Endless Dream

Every day from 7:00 PM to 7:00 AM (30 minutes in real time, double that of S0: Lunar Oracle), as day turns to night, the Blood Moon will rise over Nalcott. During this time, Deviants will grow stronger, and Meta-Humans will be infected with Lunacy, diminishing their Sanity.

1. While in Lunacy, Metas of at least Lv. 20 with Lunar Whispers will be subject to the moon's gaze. When the gaze's intensity reaches a certain level, the Lord of Moonlight will try to attack you and steal some of your Lunar Whispers before fleeing. Watch the map to pursue it!
2. The Lord of Moonlight will summon Lunarspawn to defend itself. When it's near death, it will also use an Adrenaline Shot and gain the ability to clone nearby Metas to confuse you.
3. The Lord of Moonlight's strength scales with the number of participating Metas. In some situations, the Lord of Moonlight has a chance to transform into a stronger \ Lord of Moonlight.
4. After the Lord of Moonlight is defeated, the Lunar Whispers it stole will be recovered by their original owner, who will also receive a certain percentage of bonus Lunar Whispers.
5. The Lord of Moonlight drops a chest upon defeat. Metas who participated in the battle and the original owner can open the chest.
6. In Endless Dream, the Lord of Moonlight is unaffected by Dream Zones, keeping its difficulty in line with other scenarios.

Airdrops

Aerial Loot will be renamed to Echoite Crates after this update, bringing new and improved airdrop mechanics! Fights for resources are about to become more exciting and strategic! The highlights are as follows:

1. Optimized the airdrop mechanic. Now, Rosetta Echoite Transporters will spawn on the map, flying between large strongholds and dropping Echoite Crates at random. Predict their flight paths, then deploy and wait along their routes. Strategy is the key to victory!

2. Echoite Crates will deploy a parachute and descend slowly after being released. When an Echoite Crate lands, Metas can open it and retrieve its contents. Once an Echoite Crate appears, you can view its location on the map.

3. Added a new item: Airdrop Flare. It can be obtained as a chance drop from Rosetta Boss Elites or by opening Realm Crates. The more advanced the Realm Crate, the more likely it'll contain an Airdrop Flare.

4. Using an Airdrop Flare will summon an airdrop at its location. After some time, one Echoite Crate will drop at the marked point. Be careful, because using an Airdrop Flare may expose your position!
New Weapons - RaidZone Mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/218d5174a8b84c9ecfc5893b0baee344ee629038.png"]
1. Nail Gun
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f0eb943441d48216436d64a6440616cdc6efb3e6.png"]
Submachine gun. Has a slow fire rate and short range, but it's cheap and easy to make, making it perfect for close-quarters combat in the early game.
This weapon can be unlocked with very few Memory Chips and crafted at a Primary Gear Workbench or better. Its Memetic is located below the Rusted Blade.
The Nail Gun uses exclusive ammunition, Nail Gun Bullets, that can be retrieved like arrows.
DMG per shot: 13
Fire Rate: 400
Magazine Capacity: 18
2. SKS
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/bf0c9f74f874cc7315ccfd066c1d088f4308ff5d.png"]
Sniper rifle that uses medium-caliber ammunition. High recoil but fast max Fire Rate, ideal for mid-range burst suppression.
Its Memetic is located below the MPS7. It can be crafted at an Intermediate Gear Workbench or better.
DMG per shot: 30
Fire Rate: 257
Magazine Capacity: 15
3. PDW90
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a9701363aab45c84b6fc36cae527d1cfd9012fd4.png"]
Submachine gun that uses small-caliber ammunition. Boasts rapid fire and a large-capacity magazine, with a compact design perfect for close-quarters combat.
Its Memetic is located below the Tactical Rifle Scope. It can be crafted at an Advanced Gear Workbench.
Damage per shot: 12
Fire Rate: 800
Magazine Capacity: 50
Combat
1) Added the Nail Gun, SKS, and PDW90 Memetics.
2) Removed the SOCR Memetic. You can no longer craft SOCR weapons, but can still find them in the wilderness.
3) Moved the KAM Memetic below the PDW90, replacing the SOCR's role. Its rarity has been increased from Rare to Epic, and its DMG increased from 15 to 18. You can still use any KAM weapons you own.
a) All weapons' OTS field of view +20%
b) All weapons' ADS field of view -10%
c) All weapons' bullet velocity (excluding sniper rifles) +20%

Currently, players prefer over-the-shoulder (OTS) aiming for mid-range combat as it has low bullet spread and a wider field of view. We want players to use different aiming methods based on distance, mixing and matching them with various weapon accessories and ammo types. Hence, we've increased the initial bullet velocity for all weapons (except sniper rifles) and adjusted the bullet spread for both OTS and ADS views.

In November (PT), we'll introduce phased bullet trajectories. At close range, all weapons will fire in a straight line, providing more immediate feedback during close-range combat. At medium to long range, bullets will still have travel speed and bullet drop. Stay tuned!

Currently, light machine guns don't feel very different from assault rifles in combat, but have a larger bullet spread. This doesn't justify their high crafting cost. We'll optimize light machine guns to provide sustained suppression at medium to long range, synergizing with their high bullet velocity and large magazine capacity. Their bullet trajectory and recoil will also become more stable the longer you fire:
a) MG4
Magazine Capacity: 60 → 100
Reload Speed: 33 → 12; Duration: 4.2s → 5s
Switching Weapons Duration: +10%
OTS/ADS Movement Speed: -10%
During continuous fire, bullet spread gradually decreases, and recoil gradually stabilizes.
b) KVD - Boom! Boom!
Magazine Capacity: 65 → 100
Switching Weapons Duration: +10%
OTS/ADS Movement Speed: -10%
During continuous fire, bullet spread gradually decreases, and recoil gradually stabilizes.
New bonus: Stability +8
Removed Stability and Mobility penalties.
Force Bonus: 10 → 20
Force Bonus: 20 → 30
Force Bonus: 30 → 45
Item Storage Optimization
The storage system for production facilities has been optimized:
1) If your backpack is full, you can no longer claim items from the production queue.
2) When dismantling a facility, both in-progress and completed items will drop on the ground.
3) Canceling production will refund materials based on their source. If your backpack is full, the materials will drop on the ground.
Fair Play Optimizations
1. Optimized the wall-penetration detection to fix false positives when opening or closing doors, and fixed cases where character displacement during construction could trigger false bans.

2. Enhanced detection for abnormal behaviors such as melee abuse, pulling other players, and teleport exploits. We will continue to optimize these systems and patrol actively to eliminate unfair play. Metas, thank you for helping us keep the game fair and healthy. Stay alert for malicious behavior!
Combat
Fixed an issue where the Reflex Sight displayed incorrectly after using Festering Gel's battle skill.
Construction
1. Optimized controller navigation in the Visibility settings menu.
2. Added a mirroring feature in Construction mode; shortcut key: H.
3. In the construction screen, mirrored structures now show only a single base structure, with a mirroring icon in the lower-right corner.
4. Skins selected during construction now support mirroring as well. If a skin has no mirrored version, it will default to the base structure.

*Note: To adapt to the mirror model, we have adjusted the initial coordinates of certain mirror structures. This may affect the orientation of existing constructions such as stairs and other structures. Metas can dismantle and rebuild them to recover normal functionality.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a77ca777497a868b4d99365ec0d5903eb34f19b2.gif"]
For more information, see
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545620793932906561"]
5. For non-RaidZone modes: Added the Storage Terminal facility. Once placed, you can centrally manage all storage crates in your territory and quickly store or retrieve items.
Shop Experience Optimizations
1. Fixed color discrepancies on stocking fashion items.
2. Added quick navigation options to weapon, vehicle, and territory cosmetic screens. You can now use shortcut keys or click "Purchase" to jump straight to the selection screen.
3. Optimized the female character's slow-walk animation and the male character's default standing pose in the cosmetic screen.
4. Added directional hair color swatches. Set previews now include matching hair colors in the shop and cosmetic screens.
5. Unified teeth whitening for a more consistent appearance.
Custom Servers
1. Added an initial backpack setup feature. Server hosts can provide Metas with newcomer benefits.
2. Added a Server Host Shop, where server hosts can list items for sale to other Metas.
3. Increased the server declaration character limit to 2,000.
4. Added an option for custom server hosts to set the maximum size of Hives.
5. Updated default parameter templates with two new types: Free Build and Melee Combat.
6. When joining a new custom server, you can now keep your previous character customization.
7. Added server recommendations. You will now see popular and trending custom servers suggested for you.
Scenario
Scenario History now displays Scenario Honor information during settlement.
Combat
1. Loadout and weapon accessory/cosmetic configuration save optimizations:
1) Loadout saves now also include weapon accessory setups.
2) The loadout detail page no longer lists individual mods separately. It now uses the same display style as the gear screen, giving you a clearer full-set preview.
3) When replacing a weapon with another of the same blueprint, its mods, accessories, and cosmetic settings will automatically transfer.
2. Added unique hit sound effects when damaging buildings or vehicles with firearms.
1) Reduced reticle overexposure when aiming in certain situations.
2) Scope lenses now reflect the environment and light sources when not aiming.
Game Modes
1. Improved immersion by increasing Rosetta and Vultures' turning speed. They now turn toward the source of footsteps and gunfire more quickly.
2. For non-RaidZone modes: Securement Silos will now match the number and strength of stage Deviants based on participant count, and a Primary Gear Workbench has been added for gear repairs.
3. For non-RaidZone modes: Optimized the appearance of certain Deviants and items in Endless Dream.
Social Feature Optimized
Added a batch management feature for friends.
Mobile-Specific Optimizations
Added destruction effects for territory objects when they are damaged.
Other
1. Added walking navigation lines and improved navigation guidance.
2. Optimized the visual effects of waterfalls in the wilderness.
3. Added controller focus navigation support in the Blueprint, Mod, and Fashion screens.
4. For non-RaidZone modes: Adjusted several term names in the Endless Dream scenario as follows:
1) "Nightmare Chronicle" is now "Nightmare Tube."
2) "Eternal Dreamer Kin" is now "Eternal Dreamer."
3) "Sand of Clarity" is now "Wakeful Sand."
4) "Reality Anchor" is now "Reality Resetol."
Shop
1. Fixed an issue where the Folk Guitar model disappeared when attacked during performance.
2. Fixed occasional invisibility failures with certain fashion items.
3. Fixed mosaic-like reflection issues on the Golden Radiance vehicle skin at certain angles.
Build
1. Fixed an issue where discarding more than a set amount of building items would cause them to disappear.
2. Fixed abnormal collision issues with solar panel components in some strongholds.
Social
1. Fixed an issue where, after leaving a Hive, the player did not also leave the Hive
group chat.
2. Fixed an issue where Deviations could not be shared in some situations.
Social
1. Fixed an issue where, after leaving a Hive, the player did not also leave the Hive group chat.
2. Fixed an issue where Deviations could not be shared in some situations.
Non-RaidZone Modes - Stages
1. Fixed an issue where Deviants could sometimes clip through walls or pathfind incorrectly.
2. Fixed an issue where Rosetta in Securement Silo - SIGMA could reach unintended areas.
Non-RaidZone Modes - Classes
1.Fixed an issue where the Beastmaster could sometimes summon more animals than intended.
2. Fixed an issue where the Gardener's Greenhouse Core interface was misaligned when switching output.
Other
Fixed an issue where settings sometimes were not saved correctly after logging in again.

The Version 2.1.3 server maintenance and update is planned for September 10 at 4:00 PM (PT) and expected to last about 2 hours (actual time may differ). Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience. The update size is approximately 1.48 GB on PC launchers, 77 MB on the PC client (see note below), 220 MB on Android, and 213 MB on iOS (actual size may differ). We recommend downloading the update over Wi-Fi. NOTE: If the update is delayed on Steam, you may be able to launch the game without downloading any content. The update of 1.48GB will then be downloaded and applied within the game client. After updating, an additional download of 2.1 GB may be required.

This update introduces a gameplay upgrade to Starfall Inversion with improved drops, interactive conversations with V, Lightforge Loot Crate: Astral Nexus, and optimizations and bug fixes to permanent servers, the class system, and more.
After this maintenance, all players will receive the following rewards: Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Starwish Token ×300, and Detoxident ×3.
Below are the details of this update for Once Human (henceforth "regular mode") and Once Human: RaidZone (henceforth "RaidZone"):

notes.title: Starfall Inversion gameplay upgrade with improved drops!

items.text: During a Starfall Inversion, high-altitude Elite Deviants will randomly spawn in the wilderness. Defeat them to obtain surprise rewards!

* Replies are visible to everyone in the World chat channel.

1. After this update, World merges on permanent servers will end.
2. Optimizations to sign-up cooldown rules for permanent servers and servers in their settlement phase:

a) When you first sign up for a permanent server or server in its settlement phase, the cooldown starts at 12 hours. This cooldown will grow incrementally each time you sign up for any such server within one natural month.
b) To ensure a smooth experience, the sign-up cooldown period will be reset every 1st day of the month (UTC+8).
For more information, refer to the Dev Blog on permanent servers:
1. Gardener class optimizations
a) Greenhouse Cores can now operate on any water resource (Boiled Water, Purified Water) and can also be connected to pipes for automation.

b) Changed the Gardener's starting items. After selecting the Gardener class, you can choose one of the following to receive: Portable Planter Box - The Scorcher, Portable Planter Box - Agent, or Portable Planter Box - Digger. You will also receive a Portable Planter Box.
c) Optimized the Portable Planter Box's seed breeding function. It can now breed seeds of a single type in bulk.
d) Added the ability to breed fruit seeds.

e) To prevent mistaken operations, if you are disassembling in bulk at the Disassembly Bench and your Backpack contains biomechanical parts, a second confirmation window will pop up. If you choose Cancel, the corresponding biomechanical parts will not be selected.
f) Optimized the appearance of the Gardener's flower grafting.
2. Chef class optimizations
a) Unlocked Creative Cooking recipes of a single type can be cooked in bulk. Bulk production will be handled by Chefosaurus Rex.
b) Unlocked Gourmet Atlas recipes can be crafted immediately if conditions are met.
c) Optimized the display of dish bonus attribute values. The final bonus attribute values will now be highlighted.

d) Added a new Memetic formula: Fruit Soda. You can now use any fruit to make soda with its ingredient effects. The Blueberry Soda and Orange Soda Memetic formulas have been removed. Items already crafted are not affected.
e) Due to player demand for Sanity recovery during combat, we've adjusted the effects of the following ingredients that offer continuous Sanity recovery:
i. Apple Previous: Gathering Stamina cost -5%. Now: Sanity recovers very slowly (1% Sanity per second).
ii. Goat Milk Previous: Sanity slowly recovers when out of combat. Dish Durability -10%. Now: Sanity gradually recovers (3% Sanity per second). Dish Durability -10%.

iii. Deviated Mushroom Previous: Sanity recovers slowly when out of combat. Non-crop ingredient effect duration -50%. Now: Sanity recovers slowly (3% Sanity per second). Non-crop ingredient effect duration -50%.
3. Beastmaster class optimizations
a) Optimized the following/teleporting status of summoned animals in some situations. When you ride a vehicle, animals will be automatically recalled.
b) Optimized the displayed information of animals in your territory. You can now view an animal's habits and preferences on its Animal Details panel.
c) Optimized the combat performance of bears, wolves, and other large animals. They will no longer obstruct bullets. This change won't apply to PvP scenarios.

1.To make it easier to relocate your territory, we've optimized the foundation requirements during relocation. Now, when placing your territory, the system will no longer strictly check if every foundation is touching the ground. Instead, it will automatically use the foundation closest to the ground as the support point and adjust the entire structure to fit. After placement, you can also manually adjust the structure to fit the terrain of its new location.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/6d8739e5f23ae0aecd20a92e3457d4f330be75c5.gif"]

2. Outdoor facilities will no longer be removed when relocating. Instead, they will be adjusted to fit the elevation of the new terrain. If the new location is in a no-build zone, outdoor facilities will be dismantled and their materials refunded. Note that the new terrain's elevation may change the direction of water flows, and available resources may affect facilities' operation status.
3. Optimized the territory protection mechanic in The Way of Winter. You will no longer die because of extreme weather when in your territory, at a campsite, or in a neutral zone.
1. Optimized the performance during the Airplane Ancient One game mode.

2. After defeating a Deep Dreamer, the reward drops would sometimes overlap with its model, making it difficult to interact with them. Therefore, we've increased the interaction distance for Deep Dreamer drops.

3. Starting now, the Loot Crate rewards in the "Dream Zone Trace Box" of the "Endless Dream" scenario have been adjusted so that only players who participate in the kill can receive them. Please note that unopened Loot Crates will disappear after remaining in an unopened state for half an hour, so make sure to claim them in time.
To make it easier to locate your own Vending Machine in a Harvesters' Market, we've added a map icon for it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e05f0a974f36e97be52b2c6016e6b954ccb1055a.jpg"]

To further ensure the fairness experience in RaidZone Mode, we have optimized the detection mechanisms for weapon fire rate, vehicle attack range, and DMG. Thank you, Meta-Humans, for providing valuable information. We will continue to monitor and strive to create a better gaming environment for you!
1. Added Mining Workshops for ore extraction. You can find Mining Workshops in the wilderness using their map markers (see image below).

items.text: Dear Metas,

We've identified an issue where Abyss Glance's and Snowsprite's Ice Crystals gained an extra damage bonus if they exploded while the player was wielding Raining Cash. This is due to a delay in the calculation of the Ice Crystals' damage, causing it to use the player character's status when the Ice Crystals exploded.

Unless otherwise stated, weapon passive effects should only apply to the player character. Therefore, we are adjusting Raining Cash's damage bonus so that it only applies to damage dealt by Raining Cash. This fix will not affect the damage values of Raining Cash or other weapons.
In future updates, we will further review other damage effects to ensure that damage is always calculated correctly. Thank you for your feedback!
Once Human Development Team

This update includes the surprise Scenario Honor system!
Grow your Scenario Rating and ascend through the Scenario Honor ranks to earn scenario-exclusive Honor Badges, Emblems, Star Cups, Prismatic Nicknames, Scenario Marks, and Asterism Crates!

The Scenario Honor system resets annually every 12 months, with the next reset planned for August 2026. The following content will be reset: one-off Honor Rank reward records, Honor Rank history records, and Prismatic Nickname validity period. Other rewards obtained through this system (scenario-exclusive Honor Badges, Emblems, Star Cups, Scenario Marks, and Asterism Crates) will be retained as per the corresponding rules.

Honor Badges have an exclusive coating effect. Complete just one Coating task, and you'll receive a scenario-exclusive badge coating for a limited time after Scenario Honor is settled! And if you complete all Coating tasks, you'll unlock even more spectacular coatings! Coatings can be unlocked repeatedly to extend their validity. Start climbing the ranks now!
Reward Cycle
1. In Once Human, a reward cycle starts when your character joins a scenario and lasts until the start of the settlement phase.
After this update, scenario servers that are nearing their settlement phases may have relatively brief initial reward cycles. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
2. In RaidZone mode, a reward cycle starts when your character joins a scenario and lasts until the server resets.
Reward Requirements
1. Your character must be at least Lv. 20 and have joined the scenario before settlement is complete.
2. If you exit the scenario midway through a reward cycle, you cannot complete settlement, and your run will not be recorded.
If you join a scenario server that has already entered its settlement phase, you cannot complete settlement. Please take this into consideration when choosing a server.
Reward Issuance Rules

1. If you have met the reward requirements and completed settlement, you can claim your rewards by navigating to the Scenario Rating interface and selecting Honor Rewards. Don't worry if you forget to claim your rewards before exiting the scenario. Honor Badges (including coating effects) and Prismatic Nicknames will be automatically unlocked. Emblems, Star Cups, Scenario Marks, and Asterism Crates will be sent to the corresponding character via in-game mail.

2. Rewards are determined by the highest rank attained by your character within a single scenario. Rewards can only be claimed once during the next Scenario Honor cycle, lasting from August 2025 to August 2026.
The display location for Scenario Marks will be replaced with Scenario Honor Badges. Remember to make changes accordingly.

releases.displayName: Development Update | Update Preview: August Balance Adjustments

items.text: Dear Metas,

Every month, we implement new balance adjustments to improve Once Human's combat experience. In the August 28 update, our main focus is optimizing the Frost Vortex keyword effect. We'll also adjust the strength of some weapon blueprints, while buffing the Deviations: Polar Jelly and Lonewolf's Whisper.

notes.title: I. Frost Vortex Optimizations and Blueprint Effect Adjustments

items.text: We've noticed that the Frost Vortex keyword effect isn't performing as intended in some situations for the following reasons:
1. It doesn't generate vortexes in optimal locations.
2. The damage is delayed and has slow damage build-up, requiring multiple vortexes to deal maximum damage.
To resolve these issues, we are optimizing the Frost Vortex keyword effect as follows:
1. Optimize the locations where vortexes are generated so they're more likely to hit enemies or Deviants.
2. Reduce the damage delay, shortening the interval between generation and dealing damage.

3. Increase the damage of a single vortex. A single vortex will be able to deal more damage than three vortexes did previously. To compensate, we will slightly reduce the chance of triggering a vortex with Frost Vortex weapons. This change will enhance Frost Vortex's overall damage and damage build-up speed.
We will also adjust Frost weapons and gear to improve the experience of using Frost builds.

notes.title: III. Polar Jelly and Lonewolf's Whisper Buffs

items.text: We've noticed that Pyro Dino tends to outperform than other Deviations, causing balance issues. These adjustments will buff Polar Jelly and Lonewolf's Whisper. In subsequent updates, we will enhance the other Deviations in batches, based on priority, to ensure they meet player expectations.
To ensure a smooth transition, we will issue 3 Blueprint Conversion Attempts to all players after this update.

That's the end of our developer update on upcoming balance adjustments. If you have any suggestions or questions, please contact us via the Co-Dev Feedback Platform or our community channels. Thank you for your understanding and support!
Once Human Development Team
Dear Meta,

We've been paying close attention to your feedback since the launch of Once Human: RaidZone. The August 28 update will include optimizations to the anti-cheat system, vehicle mechanics, survival experience, and server rules. Below is a preview of the upcoming RaidZone content. We can't wait to share these improvements with you!

Maintaining fair competition is one of our biggest priorities in Once Human: RaidZone. We have rigorously tackled cheating through continuous upgrades to our monitoring system, reverse-tracing of external cheats, and iterative improvements to our AI detection models. To further strengthen our anti-cheat efforts, we will introduce the following optimizations in the August 28 update:
Increased Transparency on Sanctioned Accounts
1. Banned players on your current server will be displayed in a marquee, ensuring cheaters have nowhere to hide.
2. Character ban status will be displayed in the Friends list and search results, allowing you to identify sanctioned accounts more easily.
Player Moderators
3. To allow players to contribute to maintaining fairness, we will soon start recruiting player moderators through our community channels.
As guardians of the Once Human experience, moderators will assist us in identifying and analyzing rule-breaking behavior.
Successful applicants will receive an exclusive in-game Moderator Badge and earn rewards—including in-game items and limited merch—based on their contributions to game moderation.
Recruitment details will be available in an upcoming dev update. We encourage all interested players to apply!

We're also working on comprehensive upgrades to the in-game reporting system, including a streamlined reporting process, new violation categories, and improved progress tracking. These changes are scheduled for the September version update. Cheating not only undermines fair play but also negatively impacts the open-world experience for all players. We have a zero-tolerance policy against cheating and will continue to invest in our anti-cheat efforts. We also look forward to working with you to safeguard Nalcott through moderation and reporting.
To allow you to traverse the wilderness more freely and smoothly, this update will introduce the following optimizations to the vehicle mechanics:
1. Bicycles that spawn on the map will have full Durability by default and can be used straight away without repairs.
2. Increased the maximum Durability of bicycles to make them last longer and more resistant to destruction.
3. You can no longer carry a pillion rider on bicycles.
4. Vehicles can now destroy most barriers in the open world by colliding with them, reducing situations where you're stuck on obstacles during exploration.
To give you more freedom of exploration while preserving its challenge, this update will introduce the following optimizations to the survival mechanics:
1. Durability
Reduced the Stamina cost of sprinting by 25%.
Removed the Stamina cost of gathering.
Increased the Stamina recovery speed by 25%.
Developer Message: We want Stamina management to be mainly focused on rolling, gliding, and other actions relevant to combat or escaping, rather than regular exploration and gathering.
2. Hydration and Energy Effects

Negative Effects: Previously, Load would gradually decrease when Energy was below 30%. Now, Load will only be reduced when Energy reaches 0. Previously, Stamina recovery speed and Movement Speed would be reduced when Hydration was below 30%. Now, only Movement Speed will be reduced when Hydration reaches 0.

Positive Effects: Previously, the Stamina cost of sprinting was reduced when Hydration reached 60%. Now, this will only apply when Hydration reaches 100%. Likewise, a Force recovery effect will only apply when Energy reaches 100%.

Developer Message: These changes aim to reduce the basic survival pressure, so you don't have to constantly monitor your Energy and Hydration to avoid penalties. At the same time, we want to offer bigger incentives for maintaining full Energy and Hydration to reward careful management of these parameters.
3. Returning from Blackout

Previously, after returning from a blackout, Energy and Hydration would be restored to their pre-blackout levels, which imposed a heavy burden on players with limited supplies. Now, Energy will be restored to approximately 50% and Hydration to approximately 70% after a blackout.
4. Sanity
In RaidZone scenarios, all Sanity-related negative effects will be temporarily disabled, and players' Max HP will remain fixed.

notes.title: IV. Phase Progression and Ending Adjustments

items.text: To deliver a more consistent experience, this update will optimize RaidZone's phase and ending rules as follows:
1. RaidZone servers opened after the August 28 update will have Scenario Challenges unlocked by default and consist of a single phase rather than multiple phases.
2. RaidZone servers opened after the August 28 update will no longer have triggerable endings or end early due to triggered endings.
To meet the needs of different players, this update will introduce a new server category for restart cycles, consisting of two types, as well as adjusted server opening rules.
